Adjacent to the stairs is a custom built-in desk area with white cabinetry and open shelving displaying decorative items. A rustic wooden bench sits in the foreground on light hardwood flooring. The walls feature textured wallpaper and small framed artwork.

transitional_874.jpg.title: Custom Kitchen Window Seat with Storage
transitional_874.jpg.description: Built-in kitchen storage solution featuring a window seat with cabinet storage below and flanking bookcases with shutter-style doors. The space includes a large window with natural light and a decorative bowl of fruit on the windowsill. The room features a vaulted ceiling with exposed beams and hardwood flooring.

scandinavian_599.jpg.title: Modern Garage with Glass Door
scandinavian_599.jpg.description: A contemporary garage design featuring a full-glass panel garage door with black frames, integrated into a modern farmhouse-style structure. The building has white exterior walls with wooden accent panels and modern sconce lighting. A luxury vehicle is visible through the transparent door. The architecture combines modern and traditional elements with clean lines.

coastal_354.jpg.title: Modern Minimalist Kitchen with White Island
coastal_354.jpg.description: Contemporary kitchen featuring a clean-lined design with a prominent white waterfall island. Light wood cabinetry spans the walls, complemented by integrated black appliances. The space features high ceilings with exposed white beams and pendant lighting. Natural light enters through a window above the sink area.

eclectic_513.jpg.title: Modern Mountain Deck Home
eclectic_513.jpg.description: Exterior view of a contemporary mountain home featuring a spacious elevated deck with metal railings. The house combines two different colored sections - a tan/beige portion and a darker charcoal section. The architecture includes clean lines and a modern aesthetic, complemented by surrounding evergreen trees and natural vegetation.

victorian_305.jpg.title: Modern Kitchen with Stainless Steel and Cherry Cabinets
victorian_305.jpg.description: A kitchen interior featuring dark cherry wood cabinets, stainless steel appliances, and diagonal tile flooring. The space includes a corner layout with a pass-through archway and natural light from a window. A radiator and portable AC unit are visible.

transitional_860.jpg.title: Modern Living Room with Built-in Entertainment Center
transitional_860.jpg.description: Elegant living room featuring a custom built-in entertainment center with warm wood shelving and white marble fireplace surround. The focal point includes a mounted flat-screen TV above a gas fireplace, flanked by symmetrical built-in shelving displaying decorative objects and photos. A large circular chandelier hangs from a coffered ceiling. The seating area includes upholstered chairs in neutral tones, and the space is accented with fresh greenery.

victorian_463.jpg.title: Modern U-Shaped Laundry Room
victorian_463.jpg.description: A well-designed laundry room featuring a U-shaped layout with dark wood cabinetry, white marble countertops, and subway tile backsplash. The space includes modern front-loading washer and dryer units, under-cabinet lighting, and a large window providing natural light and scenic views.

craftsman_864.jpg.title: Modern Glass Shower Enclosure
craftsman_864.jpg.description: A contemporary bathroom featuring a frameless glass shower enclosure with marble-look tile walls and mosaic floor. The shower area includes built-in storage niches and decorative border accent tiles. Natural light enters through a window visible through the glass panels.

coastal_432.jpg.title: Modern Luxury Master Bathroom
coastal_432.jpg.description: An elegant master bathroom featuring a double vanity with wooden cabinetry, marble countertops, and arched mirrors. The space includes a frameless glass shower enclosure with sage green tile, wall-mounted sconces, and clean modern fixtures.

eclectic_275.jpg.title: Charming Vintage Interior
eclectic_275.jpg.description: A cozy interior showcasing a vintage-style room with an eclectic mix of furniture and decor. A green and beige armoire stands prominently, flanked by a window with beige curtains and blinds. A small round table draped with a white cloth holds a lamp and decorative items, adjacent to a patterned armchair with a green cushion. The overall aesthetic is warm and inviting, blending elements of traditional and shabby chic styles.

asian_278.jpg.title: Herringbone Tiled Shower
asian_278.jpg.description: A well-lit, modern bathroom shower showcases a unique design with seafoam green herringbone tiles covering the walls and a pebble-style mosaic floor. A built-in seat with a light-colored top provides a comfortable resting spot within the shower. The shower features both a fixed overhead showerhead and a handheld shower wand, both finished in chrome. A glass enclosure with chrome hardware adds to the sleek, contemporary feel of the space. The adjacent bathroom area features a wooden vanity with a light countertop, suggesting a clean and minimalist aesthetic.

southwestern_722.jpg.title: Rustic Adobe Interior with Fireplace
southwestern_722.jpg.description: A cozy interior scene featuring a rustic adobe-style room. A large fireplace is prominent on the right, with a warm fire burning inside. A primitive wooden chandelier with lit candles hangs from the ceiling. A ladder leans against the wall near a small window that looks out onto a green yard and a building. There's a rustic cooking area with pots and a woven basket filled with potatoes. A small child's chair and a dark fur rug are visible on the floor. The walls are uneven and textured, adding to the rustic charm of the space.

industrial_501.jpg.title: Modern Lakeside Home Exterior at Dusk
industrial_501.jpg.description: Exterior view of a modern, three-story lakeside home at dusk, featuring large glass windows, wooden frame elements, and a partially covered rooftop structure. A wooden walkway leads up to the entrance. Warm interior lighting is visible through the windows.

scandinavian_360.jpg.title: Modern Living Room with Wood Accents
scandinavian_360.jpg.description: A brightly lit modern living room features a hardwood floor, a white sofa and armchairs, and an exposed wood beam ceiling. A metal and wood staircase is visible to the left. Large windows offer a view of the green outdoors. Two wooden chests are placed in the room.

southwestern_865.jpg.title: Chic Powder Room with Patterned Tiles
southwestern_865.jpg.description: This image showcases a stylish powder room featuring a striking blue wooden door, a decorative mirror with an ornate frame, and a unique amber-colored pendant light. The wall is adorned with patterned tiles, adding a touch of elegance and character to the space. A modern sink is placed on a vanity, complemented by a towel and a decorative bottle.

french-country_400.jpg.title: Elegant Entryway with Natural Light
french-country_400.jpg.description: This is an interior shot of an elegant entryway with natural light streaming through a partially opened wooden-framed glass door. The view through the door reveals lush greenery outside. The entryway features white walls, light wooden flooring, and a staircase with a dark metal railing on the left. A tall, rectangular mirror leans against the wall on the right, reflecting the outdoor scene. A decorative vase with greenery sits near the mirror, adding a touch of nature to the indoor space. Wall-mounted sconces provide additional lighting. The overall design creates a welcoming and bright atmosphere.

modern_449.jpg.title: Tranquil Raised Bed Garden
modern_449.jpg.description: A meticulously designed garden features a series of raised garden beds arranged in a geometric pattern, filled with lush green plants. The beds are complemented by a light-colored gravel pathway, punctuated by large stepping stones leading to a grassy area. A wooden fence and a pergola covered in greenery provide a backdrop. Landscaping details include ornamental grasses, small trees, and a water feature, creating a serene and functional outdoor space.

tropical_242.jpg.title: Tropical Garden Entrance
tropical_242.jpg.description: A well-manicured tropical garden entrance featuring a stone walkway leading to a wooden gate. The garden is lush with various plants, including crotons with vibrant red, orange, and yellow leaves, as well as palms and other greenery. The background shows a white building facade.

craftsman_723.jpg.title: Green Tiled Bathroom with Glass Shower Enclosure
craftsman_723.jpg.description: A well-lit bathroom featuring a green tiled shower enclosure with a glass door, accented by black hardware. Inside the shower, a mosaic tiled floor complements the green walls, and a glass block window provides natural light. A window is next to the shower. Outside the shower is a vanity with light green cabinetry, a white marble countertop, and a black framed mirror above. A towel hangs from the cabinet, and a decorative light fixture is mounted on the wall. The overall color scheme is harmonious, blending light greens, whites, and black accents.

rustic_465.jpg.title: Rustic Home Bar with Reclaimed Wood
rustic_465.jpg.description: A rustic-style home bar is featured in this interior shot. The bar is built with reclaimed wood that has a weathered, grayish-blue finish. The bar area includes cabinetry with drawers and doors, a dark countertop, and a small sink with a faucet. A mirrored backsplash enhances the area and reflects the outdoor scenery visible through a nearby window, where a taxidermied bird is perched. The shelves above are stocked with an assortment of liquor bottles. On the lower surface, there are wine bottles, glasses, a framed picture, and books. The design also includes metal accents, such as the mesh panels on the cabinet doors and the slim, black metal framework around the mirrored backsplash and shelving. The edge of a sofa with a textured pillow and a blue throw is visible on the right, suggesting a comfortable seating area nearby. A patterned rug with red tones is visible in the bottom left corner.

transitional_727.jpg.title: Elegant Kitchen Interior
transitional_727.jpg.description: A bright and airy kitchen features a light blue island with a white marble countertop, surrounded by wooden bar stools with grey fabric seats. The kitchen boasts white cabinetry with brass hardware and a custom wood range hood. The backsplash is a patterned tile in shades of white and grey. Glass-front cabinets display various decorative items. A dining table with wicker chairs is visible in the foreground. The floors are dark hardwood, and the room opens into another area with a console table and artwork.

rustic_303.jpg.title: Modern Rustic Kitchen Interior
rustic_303.jpg.description: A contemporary kitchen features dark wood cabinetry paired with light marble countertops, and a striking metal range hood. The kitchen island offers bar seating with black leather stools. A decorative chandelier hangs above, complementing the natural light from the window. The design merges rustic elements with modern aesthetics.

mediterranean_186.jpg.title: Elegant Driveway Gate
mediterranean_186.jpg.description: A stylish driveway gate made of wood and wrought iron adorns a residential entrance, set against a backdrop of lush greenery and warm evening light. The gate features a robust wooden frame and dark, decorative iron bars. The overall design creates an inviting yet secure feel.

mid-century-modern_282.jpg.title: Modern Kitchen with Warm Accents
mid-century-modern_282.jpg.description: A bright and airy modern kitchen featuring a combination of natural wood cabinetry, white countertops, and gold accents. A kitchen island serves as a focal point with bar stools, and pendant lights hang overhead. The kitchen boasts ample natural light and a clean, minimalist aesthetic.

tropical_524.jpg.title: Stylish Blue Laundry Room
tropical_524.jpg.description: A well-designed laundry room featuring custom blue cabinetry with silver hardware, a white farmhouse sink, and decorative backsplash. The room is illuminated by natural light from a large window with a woven shade, contributing to a clean and organized aesthetic.

farmhouse_549.jpg.title: Modern Industrial Powder Room
farmhouse_549.jpg.description: A contemporary powder room featuring a dark subway tile accent wall, round gold-framed mirror, and custom wooden vanity. The space is illuminated by pendant lights and showcases a vessel sink with brass fixtures. White rolled towels are neatly stored on open shelving beneath the vanity.

contemporary_623.jpg.title: Terraced Garden Steps with Natural Landscaping
contemporary_623.jpg.description: An outdoor garden staircase featuring wooden timber steps integrated into a lush hillside landscape. The steps are surrounded by diverse plantings including a palm, ornamental grasses, and autumn foliage. The design creates a natural transition up the slope with thoughtful plant placement and sustainable landscaping.

scandinavian_406.jpg.title: Modern Open Staircase with Wood Treads
scandinavian_406.jpg.description: Contemporary interior staircase featuring floating wooden treads with black metal framework. The stairs combine natural wood planks with black metal railings in a minimalist design. The space shows a clean, modern entryway with white walls and multiple levels.

french-country_366.jpg.title: Elegant Vaulted Living Room with Cathedral Ceiling
french-country_366.jpg.description: A sophisticated living room featuring a dramatic vaulted ceiling with exposed wooden beams and a statement chandelier. The space combines traditional and transitional elements with built-in bookshelves, a classic fireplace, and comfortable seating arranged for conversation. Large windows provide natural light and views to the outdoors.

industrial_267.jpg.title: Modern Farmhouse Bathroom with Oak Vanity
industrial_267.jpg.description: A luxurious bathroom featuring a double vanity with oak cabinetry and white quartz countertops. The space includes shiplap wall details, black-framed mirrors, brass wall sconces, and a glass-enclosed shower. A vintage-style runner adds warmth to the dark stone floor.

tropical_530.jpg.title: Tropical Garden Oasis with Waterfall
tropical_530.jpg.description: A lush tropical garden landscape featuring a small waterfall, tiki hut structure, and diverse tropical plantings including palm trees, bromeliads, and various tropical foliage. The scene is well-maintained and creates a resort-like atmosphere with natural water features.

contemporary_637.jpg.title: Modern Luxury Open Bathroom with Nature View
contemporary_637.jpg.description: A contemporary bathroom featuring a large open-concept shower area with dual rainfall showerheads and a freestanding sculptural bathtub. Floor-to-ceiling windows provide natural light and views of outdoor greenery. The space showcases clean lines with light marble walls and neutral tile flooring.

scandinavian_412.jpg.title: Modern Bathroom with Geometric Blue Accent Wall
scandinavian_412.jpg.description: A contemporary bathroom featuring a striking blue geometric tile accent wall in the shower area. The space includes a floating wood vanity with black hardware, white subway tile walls, and a frameless glass shower enclosure. Natural light enters through a black-framed window.

french-country_372.jpg.title: Luxury Modern Estate Aerial View
french-country_372.jpg.description: Aerial drone photograph of a luxurious modern mansion with extensive solar panel installation on multiple roof sections. The property is surrounded by lush green forest and features white exterior walls, dark roof tiles, and well-manicured grounds with an expansive lawn area.

asian_495.jpg.title: Modern Kitchen with Rich Wood Cabinetry
asian_495.jpg.description: Contemporary kitchen featuring dark wood cabinetry, granite countertops, and a functional island with built-in storage. The space includes pendant lighting, recessed lights, and stainless steel appliances. A small desk area is integrated into the cabinetry design.

industrial_273.jpg.title: Natural Garden Border with Yellow Yarrow
industrial_273.jpg.description: A lush garden border featuring clusters of bright yellow yarrow flowers in the foreground, mixed with purple asters and various ornamental grasses. The planting design creates a naturalistic, layered effect with different heights and textures. Green foliage provides depth and structure throughout.

eclectic_498.jpg.title: Modern Eclectic Sunroom with Red Velvet Accents
eclectic_498.jpg.description: A bright sunroom featuring a mix of modern and eclectic elements. The space includes large windows with geometric print roman shades, a round glass dining table with modern chairs, plush red velvet armchairs, and a metallic silver pouf. Brass pendant lighting and a decorative sunburst mirror add glamorous touches.

rustic_317.jpg.title: Modern Ranch Home at Sunset
rustic_317.jpg.description: Luxurious modern ranch-style home set against a dramatic sunset sky. The expansive property features rustic wooden architecture with multiple wings, metal roofing, and large windows that glow warmly from interior lighting. The home is surrounded by natural grassland with golden prairie grass in the foreground.

transitional_733.jpg.title: Whimsical Powder Room with Nature-Inspired Wallpaper
transitional_733.jpg.description: A sophisticated powder room featuring dramatic floral and bird motif wallpaper in deep blue with orange and brown accents. The space includes a marble countertop vanity with dark wood cabinetry, framed artwork, and modern bathroom fixtures.

mediterranean_192.jpg.title: Coastal Farmhouse Kitchen and Dining Area
mediterranean_192.jpg.description: Open concept kitchen and dining space featuring rustic and coastal elements. The space showcases a large black iron chandelier, custom range hood, patterned tile backsplash, and a farmhouse dining table. The kitchen island transitions to a dining area with upholstered chairs and coastal-inspired decor.

shabby-chic-style_286.jpg.title: Cozy Industrial Bedroom Corner
shabby-chic-style_286.jpg.description: A warm and inviting bedroom corner featuring exposed brick walls, wooden pallet headboard, and hanging Edison bulb lighting. The space combines industrial and rustic elements with modern bedding and decor. Black and white photographs and artwork are displayed on a wooden shelf against the brick wall.

modern_16.jpg.title: Modern Minimalist Bathroom
modern_16.jpg.description: A sleek contemporary bathroom featuring a freestanding white soaking tub and a walk-in shower area. The walls showcase vertical tiling in light gray, complemented by dark floor tiles. The space includes modern fixtures with a handheld shower system and a freestanding tub filler.

rustic_471.jpg.title: Modern Live Edge Bathroom Vanity
rustic_471.jpg.description: Custom bathroom vanity featuring a stunning live edge walnut slab countertop with natural edges mounted on black cabinets. The piece includes contemporary vessel sinks and modern black fixtures. The organic wood grain contrasts beautifully with the modern fixtures and dark base.

industrial_515.jpg.title: Modern Industrial Home Office
industrial_515.jpg.description: A stylish home office space featuring exposed wooden beam ceiling, dark walls, and industrial-style shelving. The room combines modern technology with rustic elements, including a sleek entertainment setup and decorative collectibles displayed on ladder shelving.

southwestern_871.jpg.title: Desert Modern Succulent Garden
southwestern_871.jpg.description: A well-designed xeriscaping garden featuring various succulents and desert plants arranged in a gravel bed. The garden includes large purple-tinted agaves, blue echeverias, white cactus specimens, and ornamental grasses. A decorative metal rooster sculpture and patio furniture create visual interest in the background.

contemporary_151.jpg.title: Modern Dining Room with Linear Fireplace
contemporary_151.jpg.description: Contemporary dining space featuring a wooden dining table set against a dark accent wall with a linear electric fireplace. The room is illuminated by a modern ring chandelier and a linear pendant light. Large windows provide natural lighting. The space combines warm wood tones with modern black elements.

tropical_256.jpg.title: Tropical Luxury Kitchen with Custom Wood Bar
tropical_256.jpg.description: A high-end kitchen featuring extensive woodwork with a curved bar counter design. The space showcases a wooden ceiling treatment, pendant lighting, and rattan bar stools. Large windows provide natural light and tropical views. The kitchen includes modern appliances integrated into custom cabinetry.

mediterranean_26.jpg.title: Modern Mediterranean White House Exterior
mediterranean_26.jpg.description: Elegant two-story white stucco home with contemporary Mediterranean influences. Features black metal-framed windows, arched doorways, and a metal roof. The entrance has a distinctive curved archway with a wooden door flanked by planters. The landscaping includes mature trees and a well-maintained lawn with border plantings. The windows are warmly lit from within, creating an inviting evening ambiance.

craftsman_4.jpg.title: Rustic Luxury Stone Bathroom Vanity
craftsman_4.jpg.description: A high-end bathroom vanity featuring a dramatic rough-hewn stone farmhouse sink mounted in custom wooden cabinetry. The space includes ornate lattice cabinet doors, pendant lighting, and a framed mirror. The natural stone backsplash and sink create a striking contrast against the warm wooden cabinetry.

mediterranean_804.jpg.title: Elegant Arched Steel-Frame Entry
mediterranean_804.jpg.description: A sophisticated entryway featuring a dramatic arched doorway with black steel-framed glass doors and windows. The space includes a marble or stone floor and a minimalist console table with decorative branches in a vase. Natural light streams through the glass panels, offering views of greenery outside.

traditional_598.jpg.title: Modern Black and White Bathroom Renovation
traditional_598.jpg.description: A contemporary bathroom featuring geometric hexagonal floor tiles in black and white, a frameless glass shower enclosure with black gridded details, white subway tile walls, and a dark vanity with light countertop. The space showcases clean lines and modern fixtures with matte black hardware.

rustic_459.jpg.title: Rustic Wooden Bathroom Vanity
rustic_459.jpg.description: A custom bathroom vanity made from reclaimed wood with a white marble countertop. The vanity features antique-style bronze hardware, multiple drawers, and a framed mirror above. The walls are covered in weathered wood planks, creating a warm, rustic atmosphere. A small decorative vase with greenery sits on the marble counter.

coastal_591.jpg.title: Modern Rustic Bathroom with Shiplap Walls
coastal_591.jpg.description: A stylish bathroom featuring dark gray shiplap walls, a custom wooden vanity with open shelving, and a white quartz countertop. The space is decorated with a geometric framed mirror, wall-mounted sconces, and a decorative deer head mount. The floor showcases patterned cement tiles, and the room includes carefully curated decorative elements like potted plants and organized toiletries.

southwestern_859.jpg.title: Modern Minimalist Bathroom With Freestanding Tub
southwestern_859.jpg.description: Luxurious contemporary bathroom featuring a concrete freestanding soaking tub, frameless glass shower enclosure, and large windows providing natural light. The space showcases clean lines with matte black fixtures and light wood vanity.

contemporary_73.jpg.title: Warm Galley Kitchen
contemporary_73.jpg.description: A warm and inviting galley kitchen with natural wood cabinetry, dark countertops, and hardwood floors. A stainless steel range hood adds a modern touch, while a small table and chair near the window create a cozy breakfast nook. A colorful rug adds warmth to the space.

farmhouse_213.jpg.title: Bright Living Room with Wooden Beams
farmhouse_213.jpg.description: This is a bright and spacious living room featuring two gray sofas, a light wood and metal coffee table, and a cream armchair. The room is open to the kitchen, creating a sense of connectivity. The focal point of the room is the wooden beams on the ceiling, adding a touch of rustic charm to the modern space. The large windows allow plenty of natural light to flood the room, enhancing the neutral color palette.

tropical_518.jpg.title: Bright and Modern Kitchen
tropical_518.jpg.description: This image showcases a bright and modern kitchen with a focus on clean lines and neutral tones. The kitchen features white cabinets, stainless steel appliances, and light wood flooring. A central island with a white countertop is surrounded by four bar stools, providing ample seating. Above the island hang three pendant lights with glass shades. The overall design is contemporary and inviting.

modern_313.jpg.title: Modern Kitchen with Contrasting Cabinetry
modern_313.jpg.description: A well-lit modern kitchen features a contrasting cabinet design with white upper cabinets and wood-toned lower cabinets. A stainless steel range hood is positioned above a double oven gas range. The backsplash is a unique elongated hexagon tile, and the countertops are a clean white. The space is accented with gold hardware and a small potted plant.

farmhouse_561.jpg.title: Elegant Kitchen with Wood Beams and Island Seating
farmhouse_561.jpg.description: This is an inviting kitchen space featuring a blend of rustic and classic design elements. Overhead, exposed wooden beams provide a warm, natural contrast to the light-colored ceiling. The kitchen island, with a dark wood base and a marble countertop, offers seating for three. A black range is centered against a black backsplash, creating a focal point. Custom-painted cabinets in a light green hue blend harmoniously with the light walls, while hardwood floors add to the warmth of the space. Pendant lights hang above the island, providing focused illumination. The scene creates a cozy yet sophisticated atmosphere.

modern_307.jpg.title: Warm and Elegant Living Space
modern_307.jpg.description: A bright and airy living space featuring a light wood floor, a central fireplace, and a blend of modern and natural elements. The room is well-lit with ambient lighting, highlighting the light wood tones and natural materials. A dining table with a unique pedestal base is paired with an orange chair. A sofa curves around the right, and a vertical wood panel wall adds texture and warmth to the space.

mid-century-modern_12.jpg.title: Modern Outdoor Privacy Screen
mid-century-modern_12.jpg.description: This image showcases a modern outdoor space featuring a decorative concrete block privacy screen. The screen is made up of repeating square blocks with a geometric pattern of intersecting circles and crosses, painted in a dark, charcoal gray. The screen is installed next to a wooden fence made of horizontally arranged planks. In the foreground, there's a raised garden bed constructed from wood, filled with small rocks and a sparse patch of greenery. The scene is set outdoors with a partial view of a building overhead, suggesting a patio or yard setting.

scandinavian_348.jpg.title: Modern Cabin Deck with Adirondack Chairs
scandinavian_348.jpg.description: This image features a modern cabin deck furnished with two wooden Adirondack chairs and a small black side table. The deck is covered with a black and white striped rug and is surrounded by trees. The cabin has large glass doors and windows that allow natural light to enter the interior. String lights are hung around the deck, adding a touch of ambiance to the scene.

southwestern_695.jpg.title: Natural Rock Garden with Bluestone Patio
southwestern_695.jpg.description: A landscaped garden corner featuring large natural boulders, ornamental grasses, and yellow and purple flowering plants set against bluestone patio pavers. The design incorporates mulched beds and creates an organic transition between hardscape and softscape elements.

farmhouse_207.jpg.title: Bright Bathroom Vanity with Double Sinks
farmhouse_207.jpg.description: A bright, modern bathroom featuring a white vanity with double sinks. Each sink is equipped with a chrome faucet, and a small potted plant sits beside each one. A white towel hangs on a chrome rack to the left. The countertop is a clean white material, and the mirror reflects a doorway leading to another room. The overall aesthetic is clean, minimalist, and well-lit.

contemporary_67.jpg.title: Contemporary Bathroom with Marble Accents
contemporary_67.jpg.description: This is a picture of a contemporary bathroom with a clean and modern design. The walls are painted in a light gray, creating a calming atmosphere. The floor is covered in dark gray rectangular tiles, providing a strong contrast to the lighter walls. The toilet is a white, two-piece model with a standard tank and elongated bowl, positioned neatly between a built-in shelving unit and the bathtub area. A niche in the wall above the toilet displays decorative items on glass shelves, adding a touch of elegance. The vanity features a sleek, white countertop and a dark wood cabinet with minimalist hardware. On the countertop, there's a rectangular sink and a vase with white orchids, bringing a natural element into the space. The bathtub is encased in a white surround, and the walls around the tub are covered in marble-like tiles with gray veins. A clear glass panel serves as a shower screen. A similar niche with glass shelves is also visible in the shower area, mirroring the one above the toilet. Overall, the bathroom combines functionality with a sophisticated aesthetic.

mediterranean_810.jpg.title: Elegant Laundry Room Design
mediterranean_810.jpg.description: The image showcases a beautifully designed laundry room that blends functionality with sophisticated aesthetics. The focal point is a striking patterned wallpaper in neutral tones that adds depth and visual interest to the space. Below, a dark countertop provides a practical work surface, complementing the white cabinetry that features built-in laundry hampers. The cabinetry is illuminated by subtle under-cabinet lighting, enhancing the clean, organized feel of the room. The tile flooring is a dark, solid color that contrasts well with the lighter elements, grounding the design. Decorative accents, such as a gold geometric sphere and a small green plant, add touches of elegance and freshness. Overall, the design maximizes space with efficient storage solutions, creating a stylish and functional laundry area.

coastal_585.jpg.title: Elegant Walk-In Closet
coastal_585.jpg.description: A brightly lit, narrow walk-in closet featuring white cabinetry, glass-fronted doors, and a central mirrored section. Four drawers are stacked in the center, topped by a small decorative item. The floor is a warm brown wood-look material, and the overall aesthetic is clean and organized.

mediterranean_623.jpg.title: Elegant Dining Room with Brick Ceiling
mediterranean_623.jpg.description: This is an image of an elegantly designed dining room featuring a unique brick ceiling. A large, light wood dining table is the focal point, surrounded by upholstered chairs and a bench with a patterned cushion. A distressed cabinet stands against the wall, displaying decorative plates behind glass doors. A black chandelier hangs above the table, adding a touch of drama. Natural light floods the room through a large window draped with sheer curtains. The color palette is primarily neutral, with various shades of beige, gray, and white creating a serene atmosphere.

traditional_567.jpg.title: Elegant Living Room Scene
traditional_567.jpg.description: A well-lit and elegantly decorated living room showcases a classic interior design. A marble fireplace with an ornate iron screen takes center stage, topped with a framed mirror. A grey velvet chaise lounge sits in front of the fireplace, adorned with bolster pillows, a decorative cushion, and a chunky knit throw. Flanking the fireplace are two oval sconces with golden accents. A floor lamp with a grey lampshade stands to the left, while a decorative rug anchors the furniture. A small side table displays a tray with a glass and decorative objects. The walls are painted in a warm, neutral tone, and the wooden floors add to the room's sophisticated ambiance.

shabby-chic-style_251.jpg.title: Elegant Staircase Design
shabby-chic-style_251.jpg.description: A close-up of an elegant staircase featuring dark wood treads and white risers. A dark wood newel post with intricate turning stands at the base of the stairs, complemented by white balusters. The handrail follows the stairs' ascent, also in a dark wood finish. The flooring mirrors the treads, creating a cohesive design. The wall is painted in a light neutral tone, emphasizing the staircase's design.

mid-century-modern_527.jpg.title: Modern Minimalist Bathroom with Wood Vanity
mid-century-modern_527.jpg.description: A contemporary bathroom featuring a wall-mounted wooden vanity with a white countertop, circular mirror, and modern pendant lighting. The space includes a glass shower enclosure with wood-look shower floor and white subway tile walls. The floor features white hexagonal tiles, and there are matte black fixtures throughout.

craftsman_38.jpg.title: Luxurious Modern Master Bathroom
craftsman_38.jpg.description: Spacious master bathroom featuring a large double vanity with extensive storage, freestanding soaking tub, and elegant crystal chandelier. The space showcases horizontal shiplap wall treatment, recessed lighting, and high-end finishes throughout.

contemporary_186.jpg.title: Modern Luxe Grey Bathroom
contemporary_186.jpg.description: Contemporary bathroom featuring a sleek design with dark grey tile walls, wood-look flooring, and frameless glass shower enclosure. The space includes a freestanding soaking tub, floating white vanity, and minimalist fixtures. A horizontal window provides natural light.

modern_1000.jpg.title: Modern Minimalist Bathroom Suite
modern_1000.jpg.description: Luxurious contemporary bathroom featuring a freestanding soaking tub, double vanity with sleek gray cabinetry, and large windows providing natural light. The space showcases concrete-look walls, light flooring, and modern fixtures with a clean aesthetic.

tropical_281.jpg.title: Luxury Modern Beachfront Villa
tropical_281.jpg.description: Contemporary two-story luxury residence with extensive glass facades overlooking an infinity pool. The architecture features clean lines, multiple outdoor terraces, and is surrounded by tropical palm trees. The property includes a manicured lawn and a stunning blue mosaic-tiled swimming pool that appears to merge with the horizon.

asian_324.jpg.title: Modern Dual Vanity Bathroom
asian_324.jpg.description: Elegant modern bathroom featuring a double vanity setup with two framed mirrors and pendant lighting. The space showcases a dark wood vanity with built-in storage shelves displaying white towels. Each sink station has its own contemporary faucet and minimal accessories. The wall treatment appears to be large format tiles in a neutral tone.

eclectic_1003.jpg.title: Modern Mountain Deck Home
eclectic_1003.jpg.description: Exterior view of a contemporary mountain home featuring a raised composite deck with metal railings. The house has a two-tone exterior with beige and dark grey siding, along with architectural details including a peaked roof and timber accents. The property is surrounded by lush greenery and evergreen trees.

contemporary_838.jpg.title: Modern Home Office with Built-in Bookshelf
contemporary_838.jpg.description: A sophisticated home office setup featuring a custom built-in bookshelf with black metal framing and wooden shelves. The desk area is integrated into the shelving unit, with a contemporary black office chair. A vase of red poppies adds a vibrant pop of color. The space is anchored by a blue patterned area rug and includes a modern table lamp.

asian_442.jpg.title: Modern Coastal Living Room with Organic Elements
asian_442.jpg.description: A sophisticated living room featuring vaulted ceilings with exposed beams, large windows with sheer curtains, and a mix of modern and organic furniture. The space centers around a striking black coffee table and includes cozy seating with plush cushions. A decorative wooden wall art piece adds texture and warmth to the space.

southwestern_118.jpg.title: Spanish Colonial Dining Hallway
southwestern_118.jpg.description: A warm, inviting dining area and hallway featuring terra cotta flooring, wooden furniture, and decorative elements including a hanging lantern and ornate wall mirror. The space combines rustic and colonial elements with modern comfort.

shabby-chic-style_537.jpg.title: Luxurious Master Bedroom with Tufted Headboard
shabby-chic-style_537.jpg.description: Elegant master bedroom featuring a large upholstered bed with tufted headboard, glass doors leading to outdoor space, hardwood flooring, and a sophisticated brass chandelier. The room showcases wallpapered walls in a subtle pattern, custom window treatments, and a bench at the foot of the bed.

mid-century-modern_241.jpg.title: Mid-Century Modern Living Room with Blue Sectional
mid-century-modern_241.jpg.description: A well-appointed mid-century modern living room featuring wood paneled walls, exposed ceiling beams, and built-in shelving. The space is anchored by a large light blue sectional sofa and features a geometric patterned area rug. The room includes period-appropriate furniture and lighting fixtures with clean lines and organic shapes.

victorian_259.jpg.title: Traditional Carriage House Garage
victorian_259.jpg.description: Exterior view of a high-end two-car garage with architectural details including dormers with arched windows, a decorative cupola, and classic white carriage-style doors. The garage features gray siding, white trim, and wall-mounted lantern lighting.

coastal_208.jpg.title: Cozy Window Reading Nook
coastal_208.jpg.description: A bright, inviting window seat featuring white shiplap walls, plush cushions, and natural lighting. The space includes built-in seating with white upholstery, decorative pillows, and a wooden serving tray. A small coastal artwork hangs above, complemented by a wall-mounted sconce light.

traditional_201.jpg.title: Luxury Outdoor Living Space with Covered Patio
traditional_201.jpg.description: An elegant covered patio featuring a complete outdoor kitchen and dining area. The space includes a pergola-style white roof structure attached to a stone-faced house. The area is furnished with a rustic wooden dining table and bench seating combination alongside modern chairs. The outdoor kitchen includes built-in appliances and stone countertops with a mounted TV.

shabby-chic-style_523.jpg.title: Shabby Chic Living Space with Vintage Wardrobe
shabby-chic-style_523.jpg.description: A cozy living area featuring a brown leather chesterfield sofa with decorative pillows, a distressed vintage armoire in pale blue-gray, and a clothing rack displaying light-colored dresses. The space combines rustic and feminine elements with hardwood flooring and a vintage area rug.

transitional_928.jpg.title: Industrial Modern Kitchen Island with Bar Stools
transitional_928.jpg.description: A close-up view of a kitchen island featuring dark painted wood cabinetry and a light-colored counter top. Industrial-style black metal bar stools with wooden seats are positioned at the island. The island has decorative turned legs in a dark finish. Green dishware is visible in glass-front cabinets in the background.

mid-century-modern_255.jpg.title: Modern Minimalist Mudroom with Round Window
mid-century-modern_255.jpg.description: A bright, airy mudroom featuring a distinctive round window that brings in natural light. The space includes a built-in wooden bench with storage and white cushioning, decorated with neutral throw pillows. Hooks on the wall hold outerwear, and there's a fern adding a natural element. The room has hardwood flooring and white walls, creating a clean, welcoming entrance space.

mediterranean_151.jpg.title: Luxurious Glamour Master Bedroom
mediterranean_151.jpg.description: An elegant master bedroom featuring a dramatic tufted headboard, ornate chandelier, and sophisticated metallic accents. The room showcases plush bedding in champagne silk, mirrored nightstands, and floor-to-ceiling drapery. The sloped ceiling adds architectural interest while the neutral palette creates a serene atmosphere.

traditional_215.jpg.title: Elevated Laundry Room with Leopard Print Wallpaper
traditional_215.jpg.description: A luxurious laundry room featuring elevated white washer and dryer units mounted on custom cabinetry with drawers. The room is decorated with leopard print wallpaper, has a large window overlooking a pool, and includes decorative elements like a woven basket and potted plants. A traditional oriental rug adds warmth to the space.

contemporary_192.jpg.title: Luxury Modern Bathroom with City Views
contemporary_192.jpg.description: An elegant master bathroom featuring floor-to-ceiling windows with panoramic city views. The space showcases a freestanding soaking tub, extensive double vanity with wooden cabinetry, and marble-look surfaces. The herringbone pattern floor tile adds sophistication, while glass shower enclosures maintain an open feel.

contemporary_98.jpg.title: Modern Grey Wet Room with Black Soaking Tub
contemporary_98.jpg.description: A contemporary bathroom featuring a spacious wet room design with large format grey tile walls and mosaic floor tiles. The space includes a built-in wall niche, rainfall shower system, and a striking black freestanding soaking tub. Natural light enters through a horizontal window, and white towels provide contrast against the grey walls.

asian_330.jpg.title: Modern Mid-Century Home Entrance
asian_330.jpg.description: Exterior view of a mid-century modern home entrance featuring large glass doors, surrounded by Japanese-inspired landscaping with gravel paths, natural boulders, and evergreen plants. The facade combines wood trim with neutral siding and architectural windows.

mediterranean_637.jpg.title: Mediterranean Villa Entryway
mediterranean_637.jpg.description: An elegant entryway featuring exposed wooden beams, terra cotta flooring, and a graceful curved staircase with wrought iron railings. The space is decorated with a large floral arrangement, antique furniture, and an ornate mirror, creating a warm and welcoming Mediterranean atmosphere.

traditional_573.jpg.title: Coastal Home Office with Reading Nook
traditional_573.jpg.description: A bright home office space featuring built-in white shelving and a window seat. The room combines functionality with comfort, showcasing a built-in desk area with storage, decorative shelving, and a cozy window seat with throw pillows. A bamboo window shade adds natural texture.

shabby-chic-style_245.jpg.title: Cozy Coastal Living Room
shabby-chic-style_245.jpg.description: A bright, welcoming living room featuring a white slipcovered sofa, vintage-style table lamp, and oversized wall clock. The space combines traditional and coastal elements with built-in shelving and a zebra-print area rug.

mid-century-modern_533.jpg.title: Modern White Subway Tile Bathroom Renovation
mid-century-modern_533.jpg.description: A contemporary bathroom featuring white subway tile walls with a decorative tile inset niche. The space includes a combination tub-shower with brass fixtures, a wooden vanity with black hardware, and minimalist floating shelves. The bathroom showcases a clean design with geometric pattern floor tiles that complement the wall design.

asian_318.jpg.title: Floating House on Pond
asian_318.jpg.description: A quaint floating house on a pond with a unique design. The house has a wooden frame, a dark curved metal roof, and sits on a platform above the water. A bench is visible in front of the house, and a pergola extends to the right. The surrounding landscape features lush green trees and tall grasses. The water reflects the house and the surrounding foliage, creating a serene and picturesque scene. A fountain in the foreground adds movement and interest to the water's surface.

craftsman_904.jpg.title: Elegant Interior with Dark Doors and Large Windows
craftsman_904.jpg.description: View of a bright, spacious interior featuring dark wooden doors with glass panels, a large window with white framing, and elegant white trim throughout. The walls are painted in a neutral gray tone. A drum-style chandelier hangs from the ceiling, and the floors are polished hardwood. The overall impression is one of classic elegance and abundant natural light.

eclectic_315.jpg.title: Eclectic Living Room with Vintage Accents
eclectic_315.jpg.description: A vibrant living room featuring a blend of vintage and modern elements. A dark wood-trimmed fireplace with white tile surround anchors the space, above which hangs a landscape painting complemented by brass candlesticks and greenery. To the left, built-in bookshelves display decorative items. A blue upholstered armchair and a leather ottoman provide seating, while plants scattered throughout the room add a touch of nature. The large window with stained glass detail is dressed in neutral curtains, casting soft light on the wooden floors and area rug. The overall style is eclectic and inviting.

victorian_503.jpg.title: Elegant Staircase Interior
victorian_503.jpg.description: A beautifully designed staircase with ornate wooden banisters and leaded windows in a luxurious home. The staircase is carpeted with a green and brown patterned carpet, and a small round table with floral arrangement sits at the base, flanked by decorative chairs. A chandelier hangs above the landing, adding to the opulent atmosphere.

transitional_900.jpg.title: Elegant Kitchen with Stone Fireplace
transitional_900.jpg.description: This image showcases a beautifully designed kitchen featuring a large central island with a dark countertop and white cabinetry, complete with decorative column supports. A built-in wine cooler is visible on the island. The room is illuminated by two ornate pendant lights hanging above the island. A stone fireplace with a wooden mantel and a framed artwork adds a rustic touch to the space. An adjacent dining area is visible through the glass-paneled doors, creating a bright and open environment. Hardwood flooring and a planked ceiling complete the look.

coastal_234.jpg.title: Bright and Airy Living Room
coastal_234.jpg.description: A spacious living room is flooded with natural light through large windows. Three comfortable armchairs are arranged around a rustic coffee table atop a patterned rug. A floor lamp stands beside one chair, and sliding glass doors lead to an outdoor area. The walls are painted in a warm beige tone, and the high ceilings create an open and airy atmosphere.

mediterranean_179.jpg.title: Colorful Kitchen Design
mediterranean_179.jpg.description: A well-lit, stylish kitchen showcases a blend of traditional and contemporary design elements. The kitchen features a bright yellow oven, striking blue base cabinets with gold hardware, and white countertops with a farmhouse sink. Above, there are white upper cabinets with glass fronts, complemented by a white subway tile backsplash. A large window with a patterned Roman shade and black frames lets in natural light. The space is accented with elegant lighting fixtures and a wooden countertop island.

french-country_399.jpg.title: Well-Lit Bathroom Interior
french-country_399.jpg.description: A well-lit bathroom interior showcases a vanity area with light grey cabinetry, a seating area with a chrome-based stool, and hexagon tile flooring. Mirrors above the sinks reflect the light, enhancing the bright, clean aesthetic. Plants add a touch of natural freshness to the space.

industrial_298.jpg.title: Modern Living Room with Industrial Accents
industrial_298.jpg.description: This image shows a stylish living room blending modern and industrial elements. A large sectional sofa faces a wall-mounted TV, positioned above a modern fireplace. The room features exposed brick walls, one painted white and another in its natural reddish hue, contrasting with a black accent wall. Large windows with black frames let in natural light. The coffee table, made of metal and wood, is styled with books and decorative objects. A vintage green trunk adds a pop of color and serves as a side table. Three pendant lights with a black industrial design hang from the dark ceiling. A tall potted plant adds a touch of nature to the space.

contemporary_804.jpg.title: Modern Bathroom with Bathtub and Tree
contemporary_804.jpg.description: This is a clean and modern bathroom with a focus on natural light and simple design. The room features a white freestanding bathtub with a bamboo bathtub tray, placed beside a small, round stool with a grey cushion and gold legs. A faux tree in a grey pot sits in front of a large window, adding a touch of greenery. The vanity is made of light-colored wood with a black metal base and a white countertop. The floor is a dark color, possibly black tile, which contrasts with the white walls. A patterned towel hangs on a black towel rack. A framed print is on the wall to the right of the bathtub. Overall, the bathroom has a minimalist and calming aesthetic.

southwestern_124.jpg.title: Spacious Living Room with Desert View
southwestern_124.jpg.description: A well-lit living room with an open concept design is featured. The room is spacious, featuring a large sofa, armchairs, and an ottoman, all arranged around a colorful rug. Large windows offer a view of the desert landscape. The kitchen and dining area are visible in the background, indicating an open floor plan. Dark wooden beams run across the ceiling, adding a rustic touch to the modern design. The furniture is upholstered in neutral tones, while the rug adds a pop of color. The overall impression is one of comfort and sophistication.

contemporary_810.jpg.title: Contemporary Fireplace with Wood Mantle
contemporary_810.jpg.description: A modern fireplace with a horizontal firebox, surrounded by large, rectangular tiles in a warm, rust-colored hue. A dark wood mantle sits above the fireplace. In the corner, a round table with a dark finish is placed on a patterned rug. A potted plant adds a touch of greenery to the scene, and a window lets in natural light.

southwestern_130.jpg.title: Luxury Outdoor Living Space
southwestern_130.jpg.description: This image showcases a luxurious outdoor living space with an open-air dining area and a pool feature with fire bowls. The dining area features a dark-colored table surrounded by comfortable chairs under a covered patio with a ceiling fan and recessed lighting. The patio includes a built-in countertop with stainless steel storage and a small refrigerator. Beyond the dining area is the pool with a stone waterfall feature and fire bowls providing ambient light and warmth. The background reveals a landscape with palm trees against a twilight sky.

transitional_914.jpg.title: Elegant Wet Bar with Glass-Front Cabinets
transitional_914.jpg.description: A well-lit, elegant wet bar features light gray cabinetry with glass-fronted upper cabinets showcasing dishware and decorations. The backsplash is a mottled brown tile that contrasts with the black countertop. Built-in appliances include a dishwasher, a coffee maker, and an oven. The floor is tiled in a light brown stone pattern. A towel hangs casually on a cabinet pull. The ceiling is a textured, square-patterned white.

mid-century-modern_269.jpg.title: Stylish Kitchen with Wine Storage and Outdoor View
mid-century-modern_269.jpg.description: This image showcases a modern kitchen interior featuring a tall, glass-front wine cooler integrated into a light blue cabinetry unit. The design includes several drawers and cabinets with silver hardware, topped with a bright countertop. Open glass shelving displays glassware and decorative items against a light-colored tiled backsplash. The kitchen transitions into an open area with large sliding glass doors that lead to an outdoor patio with seating. The color palette is light and airy, creating a bright and inviting space. The ceiling has a rustic wood plank design that adds warmth to the room. A glimpse of the bar area is seen on the left with a light countertop and bar stools. The natural light streaming in through the glass doors connects the indoor space with the outdoor environment.

victorian_271.jpg.title: Cozy Mudroom Corner
victorian_271.jpg.description: This image showcases a well-organized and inviting mudroom corner. To the left, a window seat with decorative pillows offers a comfortable spot. Built-in white cabinetry with open shelving provides ample storage for sports equipment, baskets, and other items. A half-door, painted in a dark color, opens to the outside, adding character to the space. The room is flooded with natural light, enhancing the warmth of the wooden flooring. A glimpse of laundry appliances can be seen on the right, suggesting the mudroom also functions as a laundry area.

eclectic_467.jpg.title: Modern Mountain Home Exterior
eclectic_467.jpg.description: Contemporary two-story home with dark blue-gray vertical siding featuring angular architecture. The property includes multiple decks with metal railings and large windows. The home is set against a backdrop of evergreen trees with landscaping boulders in the foreground.

traditional_229.jpg.title: Color-Coded Library with Blue Built-ins
traditional_229.jpg.description: A sophisticated home library featuring floor-to-ceiling built-in bookshelves painted in a rich blue color. Books are organized by color creating a rainbow effect from white to red to yellow to blue. The scene includes leather accent chairs and decorative brass objects on the shelves. A patterned area rug adds warmth to the space.

craftsman_910.jpg.title: Elegant Powder Room with Wainscoting
craftsman_910.jpg.description: A refined powder room featuring a curved dark wood vanity with white sink top, complemented by traditional wainscoting panels painted in cream. The space includes a dark-framed arched mirror and brushed nickel faucet fixtures.

craftsman_10.jpg.title: Modern Craftsman Garage Addition
craftsman_10.jpg.description: A standalone single-car garage addition with contemporary craftsman styling. Features dark gray horizontal siding, white trim, and a brown carriage-style garage door. The structure has a steep pitched roof with black metal roofing accents. Decorative wall sconces flank the garage door, and potted flowers add curb appeal.

shabby-chic-style_279.jpg.title: Mountain Mural Bedroom with Neon Accent
shabby-chic-style_279.jpg.description: Modern bedroom featuring a dramatic mountain range mural wall in grayscale and blush tones. The room includes a contemporary bed with gray bedding and pink accent pillows, complemented by a white dresser and a blue neon light fixture on the wall. Natural light enters through a white window shade.

asian_683.jpg.title: Modern Kitchen-Dining Area with Green Walls
asian_683.jpg.description: Contemporary open-concept kitchen and dining space featuring lime green walls, maple cabinets, and a round wooden dining set. The space is illuminated by modern pendant lighting and natural light from sliding glass doors.

asian_23.jpg.title: Modern Scandinavian Kitchen and Dining Space
asian_23.jpg.description: A bright, contemporary kitchen and dining area featuring light wood cabinetry and flooring. The space showcases a seamless integration of cooking and dining zones with clean lines and natural materials. A large wire mesh pendant light hangs above, and the room benefits from natural light through a window.

french-country_164.jpg.title: Elegant Kitchen with Custom Floral Backsplash
french-country_164.jpg.description: Luxurious kitchen featuring a custom hand-painted floral tree backsplash panel against a cream background, complemented by blue subway tile surrounds. The space includes white custom cabinetry, a professional-grade gas cooktop, and a distinctive copper-toned range hood. Marble or quartzite countertops add sophistication to the overall design.

farmhouse_993.jpg.title: Bright Modern Farmhouse Kitchen
farmhouse_993.jpg.description: A bright, airy kitchen featuring white subway tile backsplash, gray shaker cabinets, and marble countertops. The space is illuminated by natural light from a large window and pendant lights. A professional-style range and hood are focal points, with plants and decorative elements adding warmth.

scandinavian_604.jpg.title: Cluttered Kitchen Spice Cabinet
scandinavian_604.jpg.description: An open wooden kitchen cabinet mounted on a white wall, filled with various spice containers, food items, and cooking supplies. The cabinet appears to be standard builder-grade with multiple shelves. Below the cabinet is a small decorative wire basket mount. The surrounding wall shows white tile backsplash and electrical outlets.

tropical_726.jpg.title: Colorful Eclectic Living Room
tropical_726.jpg.description: A vibrant living room featuring bold color combinations and playful design elements. The space includes a teal velvet sectional, bright turquoise walls, striped accent wall, and royal blue storage cabinets. The room is decorated with hanging pendant lights, houseplants, and artistic wall prints, creating a whimsical and energetic atmosphere.

craftsman_247.jpg.title: Modern Neutral Kitchen with Linear Island
craftsman_247.jpg.description: Elegant contemporary kitchen featuring a long island with five upholstered bar stools. The space showcases a modern linear brass chandelier with cream shades, off-white cabinetry, and stainless steel appliances. A vase of white flowers adds a natural touch to the clean design.

eclectic_856.jpg.title: Modern Farmhouse Kitchen with Brass Accents
eclectic_856.jpg.description: Elegant galley kitchen featuring contrasting cabinetry with navy blue base cabinets and white countertops. Custom wooden range hood and warm wooden door complement brass pendant lights. Runner rug adds pattern to dark hardwood floors. Fresh citrus and plants bring natural elements.

rustic_101.jpg.title: Luxury Walk-in Closet with Built-ins
rustic_101.jpg.description: A well-organized walk-in closet featuring custom white built-in cabinetry, open shelving for shoes, hanging rods for clothing, and a central dresser unit with drawers. The space includes a decorative pouf ottoman and showcase lighting. The dark flooring contrasts beautifully with the white storage systems.

transitional_525.jpg.title: Modern Ranch Home Exterior at Dusk
transitional_525.jpg.description: Elegant single-story ranch home with contemporary updates featuring clean lines and warm lighting. The property showcases professional landscaping, wide concrete steps leading to the entrance, and large windows. The home is set against a mountainous backdrop with trees framing the scene.

rustic_667.jpg.title: Rustic Mountain Kitchen with Stone Fireplace
rustic_667.jpg.description: Luxurious rustic kitchen featuring a stone fireplace wall, butcher block island, and high-end red range. The space combines natural materials like wood beams and stone with modern amenities. A linear chandelier provides ambient lighting, while fresh gladiolus flowers add an elegant touch.

transitional_243.jpg.title: Modern Barn Door Installation
transitional_243.jpg.description: Interior view of a white sliding barn door mounted on black metal hardware against a light gray wall. The door is partially open, revealing a warmly lit room beyond. A minimalist setting with clean lines and contemporary styling.
fixtures_furnishings: partial view of furry accent stool or ottoman

coastal_977.jpg.title: Coastal Luxury Home Exterior
coastal_977.jpg.description: Three-story luxury coastal home with white exterior siding, brown metal roof accents, and multiple balconies. Features a double garage, brick paver driveway, and American flag. The architecture includes classical elements like columns and railings, with coastal landscaping including ornamental grasses and small trees.

traditional_29.jpg.title: Coastal Bathroom with Freestanding Tub
traditional_29.jpg.description: A elegant bathroom featuring a modern freestanding white soaking tub positioned against white panel walling. Above the tub hangs a framed coastal landscape painting depicting a beach scene. A wooden stool serves as a side table, holding plants and bath accessories. The space includes dark wood cabinetry and a patterned tile floor.

contemporary_347.jpg.title: Modern Scandinavian Kitchen with Light Wood and Marble
contemporary_347.jpg.description: A contemporary kitchen featuring floor-to-ceiling light wood cabinetry, a large marble waterfall island with bar seating, and modern pendant lighting. The space showcases a clean aesthetic with high-end appliances and a neutral color palette.

french-country_602.jpg.title: Luxury Transitional Kitchen with Custom Island
french-country_602.jpg.description: Elegant kitchen featuring a large center island with built-in display shelving, antique white cabinetry, and a decorative wooden tray ceiling detail. The space showcases high-end appliances, blue herringbone tile backsplash, and distinctive pendant lighting. The island includes bar seating and features a contrasting dark blue base.

scandinavian_162.jpg.title: Modern Minimalist Entryway
scandinavian_162.jpg.description: A bright and airy entryway hallway featuring white walls, warm wood flooring, and a geometric patterned runner rug. The space is decorated with a dark wooden console table, decorative vases with dried eucalyptus, and a curved gold-framed mirror visible in the distance.

industrial_703.jpg.title: Modern Kitchen with Black Marble Island
industrial_703.jpg.description: Contemporary kitchen featuring a dramatic black marble waterfall island with leather bar stools. The space includes floor-to-ceiling light wood cabinetry, a linear striped ceiling design, and open shelving. The kitchen combines modern minimalism with warm natural elements.

contemporary_353.jpg.title: Modern Minimalist Corner Detail
contemporary_353.jpg.description: A close-up view of a corner design featuring a dark wood floating shelf adorned with decorative bronze or copper molecular-style sculptures. A geometric patterned cushion in black and white sits below, and a potted grass plant adds organic texture to the scene.

french-country_616.jpg.title: Elegant French Country Dining Room
french-country_616.jpg.description: A sophisticated dining room featuring a weathered wood table paired with gray upholstered Louis XVI-style chairs. A dramatic distressed chandelier with crystals hangs above, while a large abstract blue-gray artwork adorns the wall above a decorative console table. The room showcases classic architectural details with white moldings and neutral walls.

scandinavian_176.jpg.title: Cozy Media Room with Chic Furnishings
scandinavian_176.jpg.description: This image showcases a sophisticated media room designed for comfort and style. The room features dark textured wallpaper, which adds depth and a touch of luxury to the space. A low-profile wooden console spans the length of the wall, providing ample storage and serving as a base for the large flat-screen TV. Above, a modern chandelier with exposed bulbs illuminates the space. The room is furnished with a plush gray sofa, a tufted leather ottoman, and a stylish armchair with a footrest, creating a cozy and inviting atmosphere. Two windows dressed with dark roller shades filter natural light, while a thick, shaggy rug anchors the room and adds warmth. Decorative accessories, such as lamps, vases, and books, are strategically placed to enhance the room's aesthetic appeal.

industrial_717.jpg.title: Charming Shipping Container Home Exterior
industrial_717.jpg.description: This image showcases the exterior of a cleverly repurposed shipping container home. The structure is painted in a muted teal or blue-grey tone and features a glass-paneled door with an adjacent set of windows, allowing ample natural light to enter. A small deck extends from the entrance, furnished with a woven chair, a small stool, and a round ottoman, creating an inviting outdoor space. A metal sign hangs near the door, adding a personalized touch to the unique dwelling. The surrounding greenery provides a lush, natural backdrop, enhancing the home's appeal.

modern_887.jpg.title: Bathroom Vanity with Open Cabinets
modern_887.jpg.description: A modern bathroom vanity with a double sink is shown. The vanity has light-colored wooden cabinets and drawers. Some of the cabinet doors are open, revealing sliding drawers with various bathroom items. The countertop is a light, solid surface. The floor is covered with light-colored tiles. The overall color scheme is light and neutral, creating a clean and contemporary look.

transitional_257.jpg.title: Cozy Living Room with Desk and Balcony
transitional_257.jpg.description: A bright and cozy living room features a tufted gray sofa, a round gold coffee table with a turquoise rug underneath, and a desk with an orange chair positioned near a large window and balcony. A flat-screen TV hangs on the wall, accompanied by a small wooden console table and a bench. The room is decorated with plants and colorful accents, creating a vibrant and inviting atmosphere.

rustic_673.jpg.title: Cozy Bedroom with Stone Fireplace
rustic_673.jpg.description: A warm and inviting bedroom scene featuring a prominent stone fireplace. The fireplace is set within a stone pillar that reaches nearly to the ceiling, with a framed painting hanging above the firebox. A fire is burning brightly within the fireplace. To the right, a large window offers a view of a snow-covered landscape. Drapes hang on either side of the window. A lounge chair is placed beside the window with a floor lamp next to it. A chandelier hangs from the beamed ceiling. The overall ambiance is one of rustic luxury and warmth.

french-country_39.jpg.title: Organized Walk-In Closet
french-country_39.jpg.description: A clean and well-organized walk-in closet featuring white shelving and hanging rods. The design maximizes storage space with a combination of shelves and rods for clothing. Natural light enhances the brightness of the white interior.

victorian_932.jpg.title: Elegant Living and Dining Room
victorian_932.jpg.description: A luxurious living and dining room features a light blue sofa with decorative pillows, an ornate wooden coffee table topped with flowers and a book, and a gilded mirror on a console table. The room transitions into a dining area with arched windows and a long table set for a meal, illuminated by chandeliers. The architecture includes detailed molding, columns, and patterned wallpaper, creating a classic and refined atmosphere.

craftsman_535.jpg.title: Modern Kitchen with Window View
craftsman_535.jpg.description: This image showcases a modern kitchen featuring a countertop with a sink, stainless steel appliances, and a unique window view. The cabinets are dark, contrasting with the yellow walls. Above the countertop, there is a structural beam painted in a dark color, with pendant lights hanging from it. The window provides a view of a neighborhood with houses and trees. A candle display sits on the countertop near the sink, adding a touch of warmth to the space.

coastal_963.jpg.title: Coastal Bedroom with Antique Bed Frame
coastal_963.jpg.description: A cozy coastal bedroom features an antique wooden bed frame adorned with white bedding and a blue accent pillow. A vibrant blue throw blanket adds a pop of color. The walls are panelled and painted white, complemented by a gold-framed painting above the bed. A black nightstand with a green glass lamp and various accessories stands next to the bed, adding to the room's charm.

craftsman_253.jpg.title: Elegant Kitchen with Wood Cabinetry
craftsman_253.jpg.description: This image showcases a well-designed kitchen featuring rich wood cabinetry and a spacious island. The cabinets are complemented by a light-colored countertop and a white subway tile backsplash. A unique light fixture hangs over the island, adding character to the space. The island itself provides ample workspace and features a built-in sink and faucet. A wooden stool is positioned at the island, inviting casual seating. Overall, the kitchen exudes a warm and inviting atmosphere with a focus on quality materials and craftsmanship.

eclectic_842.jpg.title: Exterior of a Modern Home with Deck
eclectic_842.jpg.description: This image showcases the exterior of a modern home, featuring a prominent deck area with outdoor seating. The house is painted in dark green and khaki, complemented by a dark roof and black railings on the deck. Lush greenery surrounds the house, creating a natural backdrop. The architectural design incorporates varying roof heights and textures, adding visual interest to the overall structure. The deck includes outdoor chairs and a table, inviting relaxation and enjoyment of the outdoor space.

mediterranean_390.jpg.title: Elegant Mediterranean Hallway
mediterranean_390.jpg.description: A beautifully lit hallway in a Mediterranean-style home features arched doorways, terracotta tile flooring with a diamond pattern, and a wood-beamed ceiling. A large arched window to the left allows natural light to flood the space, casting geometric shadows across the floor. A lantern-style chandelier hangs from the ceiling, and glimpses of other rooms are visible through the doorways. A decorative console table and mirror are seen at the end of the hallway near a seating area.

transitional_531.jpg.title: Elegant Bedroom with Dark Green Accent Wall
transitional_531.jpg.description: This is a view of a serene and stylish bedroom. The focal point is a dark green paneled accent wall with a large, framed black-and-white cityscape artwork hanging on it. To the right, a king-size bed is dressed with white linens, complemented by a textured throw blanket and decorative pillows, including a tan leather lumbar pillow. A gold sconce lights the side of the bed. In the foreground, there is a dark green velvet chaise lounge and a black marble side table. On the left, a wooden dresser holds a vase with plants. The room is lit by a circular modern chandelier. The flooring is light wood, and a light-colored rug is partially visible under the bed. The walls are painted white, contributing to the bright and airy feel of the room.

rustic_115.jpg.title: Modern Bunk Room with Floating Beds
rustic_115.jpg.description: A modern bunk room features floating beds, with a top bunk suspended above two lower beds. A metal ladder provides access to the upper bunk. Each bed is outfitted with linens, pillows, and a throw. Wall-mounted lights provide individual illumination. The room has a neutral color palette with gray walls and wooden accents. A smoke detector is visible on the ceiling.

asian_37.jpg.title: Bathroom Storage and Display
asian_37.jpg.description: A well-organized bathroom storage unit with wooden shelves and drawers, styled with decorative items and towels, adding a touch of warmth and functionality to the space.

asian_697.jpg.title: Pathway Garden Design
asian_697.jpg.description: A garden pathway lined with greenery and a bamboo fence. The pathway is made of rectangular gray stones with narrow gaps between them, leading the eye into the garden. Adjacent to the path, various types of grasses and plants create a natural, lush border. A bamboo fence provides privacy and a backdrop for the garden. A tree with leafy branches overhangs the scene, casting dappled shadows on the plants and pathway.

french-country_170.jpg.title: Modern Transitional Living Room
french-country_170.jpg.description: A sophisticated living room featuring a stone fireplace with mounted flat-screen TV above. The space showcases a light gray sofa, square coffee table, and French doors. Decorative elements include a framed artwork, table lamp, and clock on the wall. The room has wood crown molding and clean white walls.

farmhouse_987.jpg.title: Modern Sage Green Kitchen with Natural Wood Island
farmhouse_987.jpg.description: Contemporary kitchen featuring sage green cabinetry with glass-front upper cabinets, a large kitchen island with light wood base and white countertop. The space includes pendant lighting, leather counter stools, and hardwood flooring. Stainless steel appliances and modern fixtures complete the design.

modern_139.jpg.title: Modern Indoor-Outdoor Bathroom
modern_139.jpg.description: A luxurious contemporary bathroom featuring a floating vanity and an outdoor shower area separated by horizontal wood slat privacy screens. The space seamlessly blends indoor and outdoor elements with clean lines and natural materials.

contemporary_435.jpg.title: Modern Luxury Kitchen with Waterfall Island
contemporary_435.jpg.description: Upscale contemporary kitchen featuring a dramatic marble waterfall island with white paneled base. The space showcases floor-to-ceiling windows, track lighting, and wooden cabinetry with a mosaic tile backsplash. High-end stainless steel appliances include a chimney hood and built-in wall oven.

tropical_732.jpg.title: Elegant Dining Nook with Gold Accents
tropical_732.jpg.description: A contemporary dining area featuring a square table with crisp white linens, upholstered cream chairs, and a striking gold spherical chandelier. The space is accented by wall sconces and a modern floral arrangement with orchids.

shabby-chic-style_912.jpg.title: Vintage Staircase with Iron Railing
shabby-chic-style_912.jpg.description: Interior staircase corner featuring a decorative wrought iron railing with scrollwork design. The space includes a rustic wooden dresser topped with a traditional table lamp and floral arrangement. White painted brick wall adds texture while wooden stairs provide warmth to the space.

transitional_519.jpg.title: Navy Blue Home Office with Orange Accent Chair
transitional_519.jpg.description: A sophisticated home office space featuring built-in navy blue cabinetry and shelving around double windows. The shelves display white coral decorative pieces. A modern brass spherical chandelier hangs above, and a vibrant orange ergonomic desk chair provides a striking color contrast. The room includes a built-in desk surface and drawers with silver hardware.

scandinavian_638.jpg.title: Modern Minimalist Bathroom with Walnut Vanity
scandinavian_638.jpg.description: A contemporary bathroom featuring a floating walnut wood vanity with clean lines and multiple drawers. The space includes a white countertop with vessel sinks, frameless mirrors, and modern chrome sconce lighting. A green plant adds organic texture to the minimalist design. The bathroom has dark slate flooring and bright white walls.

modern_111.jpg.title: Modern Shelf Styling with Natural Elements
modern_111.jpg.description: A stylish wall-mounted shelving display featuring black floating shelves against a white wall. The shelves are decorated with a curated mix of decorative objects including potted plants, wooden fish sculptures, art prints, woven baskets, and modern geometric sculptures. Below the shelves is a dark wood credenza.

farmhouse_777.jpg.title: Elegant Dining Room with Ornate Ceiling
farmhouse_777.jpg.description: A sophisticated dining room featuring a stunning tin-style ceiling in seafoam green. The space includes a traditional wooden dining table with upholstered chairs, a brass chandelier, and French doors. A built-in wine storage system and decorative indoor plant add character. The room is anchored by a neutral area rug and accented with a sage green settee.

southwestern_483.jpg.title: Modern Dual-Head Shower Room
southwestern_483.jpg.description: A spacious walk-in shower featuring dual showerheads, white tile walls with gray accent strips, and a built-in bench. The room includes a white penny tile floor with central drain and recessed wall niches for toiletries.

modern_677.jpg.title: Modern Bedroom with Linear Fireplace
modern_677.jpg.description: Contemporary bedroom featuring a sleek linear gas fireplace embedded in a light-colored tile accent wall. The room includes floor-to-ceiling windows, neutral decor, and luxurious bedding. Above the fireplace is framed nature artwork.

victorian_77.jpg.title: Luxurious Modern Bedroom with Tufted Headboard
victorian_77.jpg.description: Elegant master bedroom featuring a gray tufted headboard, plush bedding with multiple decorative pillows, and a modern abstract artwork above the bed. The room includes floor-to-ceiling curtains, wall-mounted sconces, and a crystal chandelier. Natural light streams in through large windows.

mid-century-modern_902.jpg.title: Modern Craftsman Kitchen Remodel
mid-century-modern_902.jpg.description: Luxurious kitchen featuring natural wood cabinetry with a warm honey finish, complemented by light granite countertops and a neutral subway tile backsplash. The space includes high-end stainless steel appliances, including a double wall oven and range hood. Under-cabinet lighting enhances the workspace, while recessed ceiling lights provide ambient illumination.

french-country_11.jpg.title: Elegant French Country Kitchen with Stone Arch
french-country_11.jpg.description: A luxurious kitchen featuring a dramatic stone archway, white custom cabinetry, and high-end finishes. The space showcases a blend of traditional and modern elements with a prominent hanging lantern pendant light, built-in appliances, and marble countertops. A decorative wall clock and arched mirror add architectural interest to the stone accent wall.

traditional_15.jpg.title: Elegant Master Bedroom with French Doors
traditional_15.jpg.description: A luxurious master bedroom featuring a wall of French doors with transom windows, dressed with bamboo shades and side panels. The room showcases a traditional brass chandelier, tray ceiling, and a generously sized bed with a gathered dust ruffle and blue quilted coverlet. A modern bench sits at the foot of the bed, and natural light floods the space.

rustic_883.jpg.title: Rustic Log Cabin Bedroom with Quilt
rustic_883.jpg.description: A cozy bedroom in a log cabin featuring exposed wooden walls and beams. The room has a bed decorated with a striking geometric patterned quilt in red and cream colors. French doors lead to a balcony, and windows are dressed with floral valances. An antique wooden chest sits at the foot of the bed.

traditional_942.jpg.title: Elegant Classical Foyer with Barrel Vault
traditional_942.jpg.description: A grand entrance hallway featuring a barrel-vaulted ceiling with wood paneling, classic white columns, and dark hardwood flooring. The space is anchored by a dramatic arched doorway with transom windows and leads to other living spaces. A traditional console table with lamp sits along one wall.

victorian_63.jpg.title: Luxurious White Marble Kitchen
victorian_63.jpg.description: Elegant galley-style kitchen featuring white custom cabinetry, Calacatta marble backsplash and countertops. The space includes leaded glass cabinet doors, brass hardware, and a vintage-style cream range. Natural light floods through windows, and a traditional runner rug adds warmth to hardwood floors.

coastal_787.jpg.title: Modern Coastal Kitchen with Blue Island
