coastal_787.jpg.description: Luxurious open-concept kitchen featuring a large blue island with bar seating. White perimeter cabinets contrast with blue subway tile backsplash. High-end stainless appliances and pendant lighting create an elegant atmosphere. The space showcases marble countertops and professional-grade finishes.

mid-century-modern_916.jpg.title: Mid-Century Modern Open Concept Living Space
mid-century-modern_916.jpg.description: A warm, sunlit open-concept living and dining area featuring exposed wooden beams and large windows overlooking greenery. The space combines a modern kitchen counter with a living area that includes comfortable seating and a wood-burning stove.

rustic_897.jpg.title: Rustic Mountain Home Entrance
rustic_897.jpg.description: Exterior view of a luxury mountain home entrance featuring a stone and timber architectural design. The entrance includes a turret-style element with panoramic windows and a covered porch area. The home demonstrates craftsman influences with exposed wooden beams and natural stone veneer. Warm lighting from interior spaces creates an inviting ambiance.

craftsman_509.jpg.title: Rustic Mountain Lodge Stone Fireplace
craftsman_509.jpg.description: A cozy mountain home interior featuring a dramatic floor-to-ceiling stone fireplace with a built-in firebox. Large multi-pane windows flood the space with natural light, complemented by exposed wooden beams. A comfortable seating area includes leather furniture and a natural wood stump table, creating an organic, rustic atmosphere.

traditional_956.jpg.title: Luxury Traditional Kitchen with Custom Island
traditional_956.jpg.description: Elegant kitchen featuring rich cherry wood cabinetry contrasting with a cream-colored island. The space showcases a dramatic tray ceiling with crystal chandeliers, a large arched window, and high-end stainless steel appliances. The island includes ornate carved details and comfortable upholstered bar stools.

modern_663.jpg.title: Modern White and Wood Kitchen with Island
modern_663.jpg.description: Contemporary kitchen featuring white upper cabinets paired with warm wood lower cabinets. Large center island with white quartz countertop and seating. Features subway tile backsplash, stainless steel appliances, and a window bringing in natural light. Floating wooden shelves add warmth and storage.

modern_105.jpg.title: Modern Desert-Style Front Entry Walkway
modern_105.jpg.description: A contemporary home entrance featuring a geometric concrete pathway with floating steps surrounded by drought-resistant landscaping. The walkway leads to a modern black front door with glass panels. The yard showcases a mix of ornamental grasses, succulents, and native plants with decorative rock ground cover. Solar panels are visible on the roof.

asian_873.jpg.title: Modern Industrial Living Room with Orange Sofa
asian_873.jpg.description: Contemporary living room featuring a bold orange sofa against industrial-style black framed glass partitions. The space is decorated with potted plants, multiple side tables, and track lighting. The room combines warm and industrial elements with natural accents.

farmhouse_763.jpg.title: Country Cottage Dining Nook
farmhouse_763.jpg.description: A charming dining area featuring a curved built-in bench seat with white cushions, paired with black Windsor-style chairs around a round white table. The space has sage green wainscoting, exposed wooden ceiling beams, and decorative plates displayed on the wall. A window provides natural light, and there's a sunflower arrangement on the table.

shabby-chic-style_906.jpg.title: Modern Gray and White Kitchen with Art Gallery Wall
shabby-chic-style_906.jpg.description: Contemporary kitchen featuring sleek gray cabinets with handleless design, white upper cabinets, and marble backsplash. Three framed artworks are displayed above the cabinets. The space includes a partial view of a wooden dining chair and a tall window with black frames.

rustic_129.jpg.title: Rustic Outdoor Kitchen Pavilion
rustic_129.jpg.description: A covered outdoor living space featuring a gabled wooden roof structure with exposed beams. The space includes an outdoor kitchen and dining area with stone veneer accents, built on a concrete pad with stepping stone pathway access. The pavilion is surrounded by landscaping and features both cooking and entertainment zones.

mediterranean_347.jpg.title: Elegant Traditional Kitchen with Grand Island
mediterranean_347.jpg.description: Luxurious open-concept kitchen featuring a massive wood-paneled island with white countertops. The space includes custom cream-colored cabinetry, professional-grade stainless steel appliances, and distinctive pendant lighting. A decorative tile backsplash adds visual interest, while arched doorways and windows create an architectural statement. The kitchen flows into a dining area with natural light streaming through large windows.

craftsman_284.jpg.title: Cozy Craftsman Living Room with Fireplace
craftsman_284.jpg.description: A warm and inviting living room featuring a prominent brick fireplace with wooden mantel, built-in bookshelves, and comfortable seating. The room is characterized by its terra cotta colored walls, traditional woodwork, and ambient lighting from a pendant fixture.

shabby-chic-style_735.jpg.title: Rustic Kitchen Design
shabby-chic-style_735.jpg.description: A rustic kitchen featuring exposed brick walls, a white refrigerator, a kitchen island with seating, and a chevron patterned rug.

farmhouse_788.jpg.title: Backyard Exterior of Modern Home
farmhouse_788.jpg.description: The image showcases the backyard exterior of a modern home with a distinct black and white color scheme. The modern addition features a dark, almost black exterior with vertical siding and a metal roof. The windows are large and sliding, opening onto a wooden deck. A woman is seen opening the sliding glass doors, revealing a glimpse of the interior. The original part of the house is white with classic detailing, including a smaller door and white-framed windows. The yard is lush with greenery, including bushes and small trees, adding a natural element to the scene.

asian_640.jpg.title: Screened Porch Addition
asian_640.jpg.description: This image showcases a newly constructed screened porch addition to a brick house, designed with a high gable roof and wooden accents. The porch features a wooden staircase leading up to the screened area, which is well-lit with recessed lighting. The structure is built around a large tree, integrating nature into the design. The exterior is complemented by a brick pathway and landscaping, enhancing the home's curb appeal.

farmhouse_950.jpg.title: Living Room with Stone Fireplace and Large Windows
farmhouse_950.jpg.description: A bright and airy living room featuring a full stone fireplace, a large grid window offering a view of lush greenery and a river. The room is furnished with comfortable armchairs, a glass-topped coffee table adorned with ferns, and a blue textured rug. Plants are scattered around, enhancing the connection to nature. The overall ambiance is modern and inviting.

asian_126.jpg.title: Cozy Modern Bedroom with Natural Light
asian_126.jpg.description: A serene bedroom showcases mid-century modern design elements. The room is bathed in natural light streaming through large windows, offering a view of lush greenery. A unique triangular window above the artwork adds architectural interest. A comfortable, ivory-colored chair with an ottoman sits beside a small, round side table. The walls are painted in a soft, neutral tone, complementing the warm wood accents and light-colored flooring. A piece of abstract art hangs above the chair, adding a touch of sophistication. The bed, covered with a white comforter, is partially visible in the foreground. A sliding wood-framed door with frosted glass panels is also a key feature in the room.

modern_850.jpg.title: Modern Bathroom with Freestanding Tub and Walk-in Shower
modern_850.jpg.description: This is a modern bathroom featuring a freestanding bathtub, a walk-in shower, and a minimalist design. The shower area has white vertical tiles and dark fixtures, contrasting with the dark floor. A built-in niche provides storage in the shower area. A white freestanding tub sits adjacent to the shower, near a window that allows natural light into the room. The overall color scheme is clean and contrasting, with an emphasis on simple, geometric shapes.

french-country_819.jpg.title: Luxurious Bathroom with Columns
french-country_819.jpg.description: An expansive and luxurious bathroom features classical design elements such as Roman-style columns and marble flooring. The columns are centrally placed, creating archways that visually segment the space. The shower area is tiled with a intricate pattern, while the rest of the floor is covered with large marble tiles. A large tub is positioned near a window, providing natural light.

industrial_918.jpg.title: Industrial Living Room with Shipping Container Wall
industrial_918.jpg.description: This is an interior shot of a living room with an industrial design aesthetic. The room features a wall made of corrugated metal, resembling a shipping container, painted in a light off-white or gray color. The ceiling has exposed beams or structures painted in white. A large window allows natural light to illuminate the space, with a sheer black curtain partially drawn. A light gray sectional sofa is placed in front of the shipping container wall, adorned with several cushions in varying shades of gray and brown. To the left of the sofa, there is a dark-colored table lamp on a side table, adding a touch of light to the room. A large coffee table with a metal frame and a concrete or stone top is positioned in front of the sofa. The floor appears to be polished concrete, contributing to the industrial feel. A modern light fixture hangs from the ceiling, providing additional illumination. The color palette of the room is primarily neutral, with shades of gray, white, and black, creating a minimalist and modern atmosphere.

modern_688.jpg.title: Contemporary Kitchen Interior
modern_688.jpg.description: A well-lit, modern kitchen features custom cabinetry in a muted blue-gray tone that extends to the ceiling for maximum storage. The island boasts a striking textured finish and is accented with rustic wooden bar stools. Dark, artistic pendant lights hang above, adding a dramatic touch. A long window provides natural light over the sink area, and a glass cabinet displays kitchenware.

contemporary_384.jpg.title: Modern Staircase with Glass Railing and Artwork
contemporary_384.jpg.description: This image features a modern staircase design with floating wooden treads and a glass railing. The staircase is illuminated with integrated lighting beneath each tread, creating a warm glow. Adjacent to the stairs is a wall adorned with three framed black and white photographs, and below these photographs are two upholstered chairs with a green floral pattern. A large window with a black frame allows natural light into the space and offers a view of trees in the distance. The flooring is dark wood, complementing the wooden treads of the staircase. The overall design aesthetic is contemporary and sophisticated.

mid-century-modern_725.jpg.title: Modern Bedroom with Canopy Bed and Wood Paneling
mid-century-modern_725.jpg.description: This is a contemporary bedroom featuring a four-poster canopy bed with a light tan patterned comforter. The room is characterized by wood paneling, which creates a warm and natural atmosphere. Accents of black in the canopy bed frame and window frames offer a modern contrast to the wood. A textured white rug adds softness underfoot, and a green chair with a matching ottoman provides a seating area near a large window. The window offers a view of outdoor greenery, enhancing the connection to nature. Orange doors add a bold pop of color. A floating bedside table with a lamp adds a minimalist touch.

farmhouse_31.jpg.title: Sage Green Kitchen with Granite Countertops
farmhouse_31.jpg.description: A well-lit kitchen featuring sage green cabinets, granite countertops, and stainless steel appliances. The cabinets extend to the ceiling, with decorative items displayed on the upper shelves. A window provides natural light and a view of lush greenery. A wooden bowl filled with fruit sits on the countertop.

transitional_280.jpg.title: Elegant Vaulted Ceiling Design
transitional_280.jpg.description: A low-angle shot showcases an elegant interior design with a vaulted ceiling, featuring a modern dark-toned ceiling fan as a central element. The ceiling is light-colored with prominent white beams that emphasize the vault's structure. Recessed lighting is subtly integrated for illumination. Two windows on the left side provide natural light, contributing to the room's brightness. The walls are painted in a neutral grey tone, which complements the white ceiling and trim.

mediterranean_421.jpg.title: Exterior Entrance of Stone House
mediterranean_421.jpg.description: The exterior of a stone house is showcased in a daytime shot. The building is constructed from light-colored stone, giving it a rustic and sturdy appearance. An arched doorway provides access to the interior, with a few steps leading up to it. A terracotta tiled roof extends above the doorway, providing shelter. A small window is visible to the right of the entrance. The front yard is landscaped with various plants, including a bush with purple flowers, adding a touch of color to the scene. A pathway leads to the entrance, with a few trees visible in the background.

rustic_868.jpg.title: Rustic Ranch Home Exterior
rustic_868.jpg.description: Exterior view of a rustic ranch-style home featuring a long porch with stone columns and a wooden pergola. The house is constructed with a mix of stone and wood materials, topped with a metal roof. A natural wooden fence lines the foreground, adding to the rural aesthetic. The property is surrounded by a green lawn and mature trees, with a clear blue sky in the background.

farmhouse_25.jpg.title: Bright and Airy Kitchen Window
farmhouse_25.jpg.description: A bright and airy kitchen features three large, vertically-paned windows over a white farmhouse sink. White cabinetry with classic hardware surrounds the sink. Overhead, three pendant lights provide illumination. The walls are painted a soft blue above the white cabinets.

victorian_729.jpg.title: Modern Shower Niche Detail
victorian_729.jpg.description: A clean, minimalist shower installation featuring white subway tile walls with dark contrasting grout. The design includes a built-in rectangular niche with a glass shelf for toiletries. The niche appears to be accented with a different, smaller mosaic tile pattern.

transitional_294.jpg.title: Modern Coastal Bedroom with Geometric Accent Wall
transitional_294.jpg.description: A contemporary bedroom featuring large windows with field views, a statement geometric wood accent wall, and luxurious layered bedding. The space is anchored by a dramatic capiz shell chandelier and includes a modern bench at the foot of the bed.

coastal_778.jpg.title: Classic Coastal Powder Room
coastal_778.jpg.description: A well-appointed small bathroom featuring white wainscoting, blue-gray wallpaper, and nautical accents. The space includes a pedestal sink, white toilet, and is decorated with a rope-framed oval mirror and chrome fixtures.

traditional_771.jpg.title: Window Seat Storage Bench
traditional_771.jpg.description: A built-in window seat featuring a blue cushioned bench with blue and white toile pattern throw pillows. The bench includes storage drawers underneath and is positioned against a white-framed window with garden views.

mediterranean_435.jpg.title: Elegant Mediterranean Staircase and Foyer
mediterranean_435.jpg.description: A luxurious residential interior featuring a grand wooden staircase with ornate wrought iron railings. The space showcases exposed wooden ceiling beams, recessed lighting, and rich hardwood flooring. A large decorative wooden entertainment center or cabinet is visible along the back wall.

asian_132.jpg.title: Whimsical Powder Room with Nautical Wallpaper
asian_132.jpg.description: A modern powder room featuring a dramatic blue wallpaper with a repeating pattern of boats and orange lanterns or fruits. The space includes a pedestal sink with a circular LED-illuminated mirror and white fixtures against the statement wall.

modern_844.jpg.title: Modern Spa-Like Master Bathroom
modern_844.jpg.description: Luxurious contemporary bathroom featuring a floating wooden vanity, freestanding soaking tub, and frameless glass shower enclosure. Large windows provide natural lighting and views of greenery outside. The space combines warm wood tones with modern gray tile and clean lines.

southwestern_468.jpg.title: Rustic Turquoise Bathroom Vanity
southwestern_468.jpg.description: A charming bathroom vignette featuring a distressed turquoise blue vanity cabinet with antique hardware. Above it hangs a decorative framed mirror with studded details. The space includes wooden wall shelving displaying decorative items, and framed artwork on the walls. The vanity has a simple countertop with a dark faucet fixture.

contemporary_390.jpg.title: Organized Closet Detail with Clothing Rod
contemporary_390.jpg.description: Close-up view of a white built-in closet organization system featuring a pull-out clothing rod with garments hanging. The scene shows folded textiles on shelving and hanging clothes in muted tones including a navy patterned garment and neutral pieces.

asian_654.jpg.title: Modern Wet Room with Freestanding Tub
asian_654.jpg.description: A contemporary bathroom featuring a spacious wet room design with a freestanding soaking tub. The space combines dark charcoal wall tiles with hexagonal floor tiles in mixed earth tones. A minimalist shower system and wooden stool add functional elements while maintaining the clean aesthetic.

tropical_929.jpg.title: Modern Colorful Dining Room
tropical_929.jpg.description: Contemporary dining room featuring vibrant upholstered chairs in lime green and hot pink surrounding a dark wood dining table. A large abstract pink artwork is displayed on a white paneled wall, with a modern wall sconce providing accent lighting.

farmhouse_944.jpg.title: Olive Grove Outdoor Dining Space
farmhouse_944.jpg.description: A charming outdoor dining area nestled among olive trees, featuring a rustic wooden picnic table setup against a white cottage-style structure. The space has a Mediterranean feel with young olive trees planted in a grid pattern on a gravel surface, creating an intimate dining atmosphere.

mediterranean_353.jpg.title: Luxury Resort-Style Pool Oasis
mediterranean_353.jpg.description: An elegant backyard swimming pool with curved edges featuring a built-in rock waterfall and LED lighting. The space includes a covered pavilion with stone columns, extensive paver decking, and artificial turf landscaping. Palm trees and tropical vegetation frame the scene, creating a resort-like atmosphere. The pool area is illuminated at dusk, highlighting the water features and architectural elements.

eclectic_659.jpg.title: Modern Kitchen with Dark Wood Cabinets
eclectic_659.jpg.description: This image showcases a modern kitchen design featuring dark wood cabinets, stainless steel appliances, and a dark countertop. The kitchen has ample storage with tall cabinets extending to the ceiling. The stainless steel range hood complements the gas stove and metallic backsplash. Recessed lighting illuminates the space. There is a window on the left side letting in natural light. The floor is tiled.

craftsman_290.jpg.title: Elegant Farmhouse Entryway
craftsman_290.jpg.description: A welcoming farmhouse-style entryway featuring a stained wood door, white vertical siding, and a wood-paneled ceiling. The porch is supported by square columns with brick bases. Decorative outdoor lighting fixtures flank the door, and dark shutters adorn the nearby window.

scandinavian_823.jpg.title: Modern Sauna and Bathroom Installation
scandinavian_823.jpg.description: Interior view of a modern bathroom space featuring a custom glass-door sauna installation adjacent to a white toilet. The sauna features natural wood slat construction with a glass door panel and modern hardware. The bathroom has white walls and appears to be a compact, efficient layout.

tropical_901.jpg.title: Etched Glass Doors with Leaf Design
tropical_901.jpg.description: A pair of wooden-framed glass doors featuring a frosted leaf design. The leaves are large and cover the majority of the glass panels, creating a sense of privacy while still allowing light to filter through. The doors have silver handles and are set against a neutral-colored wall. The leaf pattern is symmetrical and adds a decorative element to the entryway. The etched effect on the glass gives the design a soft, diffused appearance.

eclectic_671.jpg.title: Steampunk Bar Design
eclectic_671.jpg.description: A meticulously designed steampunk-themed bar featuring dark cabinetry, a copper-topped island, and a decorative metal ceiling adorned with gears. Exposed brick accents and a well-stocked liquor shelf add to the ambiance.

shabby-chic-style_709.jpg.title: Rustic Interior with Plate Rack and Bench
shabby-chic-style_709.jpg.description: A view through a doorway into a cozy interior. The main focus is a wall-mounted plate rack, displaying a collection of various white plates and platters. Below the rack, a dark wooden bench holds a burgundy leather bag. The walls are painted in a warm beige, and the floor appears to be stone. The scene is lit with soft, natural light, contributing to the rustic and inviting atmosphere of the space.

coastal_988.jpg.title: Stylish Bathroom Vanity with Hexagonal Tile Backsplash
coastal_988.jpg.description: A contemporary bathroom features a navy blue vanity with gold hardware and a white countertop. A circular mirror hangs against a hexagonal tile backsplash, flanked by pendant lights. A small plant and towel add to the room's charm.

mid-century-modern_719.jpg.title: Modern Staircase Railing
mid-century-modern_719.jpg.description: A close-up shot of a modern staircase railing featuring black, vertically-aligned metal spindles arranged in a geometric pattern. The spindles are attached to a wooden handrail and a horizontal metal base, creating a sleek and contemporary design. A glass panel is visible on the left side, providing a view of the interior. The background shows a glimpse of the interior with white walls and a white door, contributing to the modern aesthetic of the space.

rustic_840.jpg.title: Elegant Black Pantry Design
rustic_840.jpg.description: This image showcases a sophisticated pantry with a U-shaped layout, dominated by sleek black cabinetry and marble countertops. The backsplash is adorned with a striking geometric pattern, adding a touch of visual interest to the space. Open shelving in the center unit displays a selection of cookbooks, jars, and decorative items. A sink with a brass faucet is positioned on the right side, contributing to the luxurious feel of the pantry. Natural light streams in from a window on the left, highlighting the contrasting colors and textures.

traditional_981.jpg.title: Shower Niche with Marble Backsplash
traditional_981.jpg.description: A bathroom featuring a built-in shower niche with a marble backsplash. The niche is tiled with small, rectangular marble pieces and contains various shower essentials, including soap dispensers, a cream container, and a bar of soap. The surrounding shower walls are covered in white subway tiles, creating a clean and modern aesthetic. A white shower curtain partially obscures the right side of the frame.

eclectic_117.jpg.title: Eclectic Home Office Design
eclectic_117.jpg.description: This image showcases a vibrant and eclectic home office. The room features a wooden desk paired with a black ergonomic office chair. A unique geometric bookshelf, filled with books, decorative items, and framed photos, adds character to the space. A bright window provides natural light. The floor is covered in red tiles and a colorful rug. The color palette includes a mix of pastel and bold hues, contributing to the room's cheerful and creative atmosphere.

coastal_750.jpg.title: Modern Kitchen with Large Island
coastal_750.jpg.description: A bright and airy modern kitchen features a large central island with a light-colored countertop and wooden frame, surrounded by wooden stools. Above, two industrial-style pendant lights hang, illuminating the space. A stainless steel pot rack is mounted on the wall, displaying various cookware. The kitchen is equipped with stainless steel appliances, and a window brings in natural light, complemented by light hardwood flooring.

rustic_698.jpg.title: Cozy Living Room with Lake View
rustic_698.jpg.description: A bright and airy living room features floor-to-ceiling windows offering a scenic view of a lake and surrounding greenery. The room is furnished with a gray sofa, two modern armchairs, and a sleek coffee table. A colorful area rug anchors the space, and the wooden walls and ceiling add warmth and texture.

traditional_759.jpg.title: Elegant Entryway with Storage Bench
traditional_759.jpg.description: A well-lit, inviting entryway featuring a custom-built storage bench with a lift-up lid. The bench is integrated with a paneled wall adorned with brass coat hooks, all finished in a crisp white paint. A blue and white floral curtain softens the space, complementing the pale blue wall paint above the paneling. The bench provides practical storage, and the design blends functionality with aesthetic appeal.

southwestern_440.jpg.title: Raised Garden Beds with Lattice Backing
southwestern_440.jpg.description: This image showcases a pair of raised garden beds constructed from wood and corrugated metal, set against a backdrop of a wooden lattice fence. The garden beds feature a sturdy wooden frame with a metal liner, suggesting durability and practicality for gardening. The lattice fence provides both privacy and support for climbing plants, adding a decorative element to the outdoor space. The overall aesthetic is rustic and functional, blending seamlessly into a natural environment.

french-country_825.jpg.title: Modern Interior with Glass Railings
french-country_825.jpg.description: This image showcases a contemporary interior with a focus on light and open space. The polished wooden floors reflect light, creating a bright and airy ambiance. Glass railings with light-colored frames define the staircases and walkways, contributing to the clean, modern aesthetic. The walls are painted in a neutral color, complementing the overall minimalist design. Recessed lighting and strategically placed spotlights illuminate the space. The view extends into other areas of the house, showcasing the open floor plan and cohesive design. The composition is well-balanced, emphasizing the architectural details and the flow of the space.

industrial_924.jpg.title: Modern Industrial Kitchen with Red Accent
industrial_924.jpg.description: A contemporary kitchen featuring gray cabinetry, exposed brick walls, and a striking red refrigerator. The space combines industrial and modern elements with a dining area that includes a metal table and designer chairs. White subway tile backsplash and patterned floor tiles add visual interest.

modern_878.jpg.title: Modern Luxury Bathroom Vanity
modern_878.jpg.description: A sophisticated modern bathroom featuring a floating vanity with a dramatic black marble countertop. The space includes contemporary linear lighting fixtures and a geometric patterned wall treatment. A circular black and white artwork adds visual interest to the clean, minimalist design.

southwestern_454.jpg.title: Desert Patio with Mountain View
southwestern_454.jpg.description: A contemporary outdoor patio space overlooking a desert landscape with saguaro cacti and mountain views. Features a sleek seating area with modern furniture and a decorative terra cotta planter with vibrant orange flowers.

industrial_930.jpg.title: Mid-Century Modern Reading Nook with Ocean View
industrial_930.jpg.description: A cozy reading corner featuring vintage wooden rocking chairs with colorful cushions, positioned near a large picture window overlooking water and foliage. The space includes industrial-style shelving units with books and decorative items, and is anchored by a bright blue carpet.

farmhouse_19.jpg.title: Modern Farmhouse Kitchen with Dark Island
farmhouse_19.jpg.description: Spacious kitchen featuring exposed wooden beams, a large dark gray island with woven bar stools, white cabinetry, and pendant lighting. The space combines modern and rustic elements with a clean aesthetic.

rustic_854.jpg.title: Rustic Modern Great Room with Stone Fireplace
rustic_854.jpg.description: A spacious open-concept living area featuring vaulted wooden ceilings with exposed beams, a dramatic stone fireplace wall, and comfortable contemporary seating. The space seamlessly connects to a kitchen area, with natural light streaming through large windows. The room showcases a perfect blend of rustic and modern elements.

eclectic_103.jpg.title: Lush Garden Seating Area
eclectic_103.jpg.description: A charming outdoor seating area set against massive elephant ear plants and bamboo. The space features a vintage-style bistro set on a brick paver patio, creating an intimate garden retreat bathed in dappled sunlight.

mediterranean_409.jpg.title: Mediterranean Courtyard Fountain
mediterranean_409.jpg.description: A charming exterior courtyard featuring a stone fountain as the focal point, set against a limestone facade with arched windows. The landscaping includes lush greenery, climbing vines, and manicured shrubs creating a serene garden atmosphere.

eclectic_665.jpg.title: Retro-Modern Two-Tone Kitchen
eclectic_665.jpg.description: Stylish kitchen featuring a striking two-tone cabinet design with mint green lower cabinets and white upper cabinets. The space is anchored by a dramatic black and white checkered floor pattern. Pink subway tile backsplash adds a soft contrast, while modern amenities including black appliances complete the look. A vase of fresh flowers and wine bottle add decorative touches.

southwestern_332.jpg.title: Eclectic Living Room with Blue Accents
southwestern_332.jpg.description: A transitional living space featuring a wooden doorway leading to a bright blue dining room. The foreground shows a vintage-style blue velvet armchair with a matching ottoman, positioned on a cowhide rug. A decorative wall sconce and wooden wall decor add character to the white walls.

asian_668.jpg.title: Japanese-Inspired Modern Entryway
asian_668.jpg.description: An architectural entrance featuring a dramatic peaked roof with ornate trim work. The entryway showcases a striking red circular doorway (reminiscent of a Japanese torii gate) set against white walls. The roofline has detailed decorative metalwork and traditional Asian-influenced design elements. The structure combines modern and traditional Japanese architectural elements with clean lines and natural materials.

farmhouse_978.jpg.title: Modern Farmhouse Screened Porch with Wood Ceiling
farmhouse_978.jpg.description: A bright, airy screened porch interior featuring a rustic wooden plank ceiling and white walls. The space is flooded with natural light through large screened windows. A minimalist pendant light hangs from the vaulted ceiling.

tropical_915.jpg.title: Modern Hillside Home with Pool at Dusk
tropical_915.jpg.description: Exterior twilight view of a contemporary multi-level home built into a hillside. Features large glass windows, wraparound deck with metal railings, and an illuminated pool area. The architecture emphasizes indoor-outdoor living with extensive glazing and open terraces. Landscape includes modern drought-resistant plantings with agaves.

industrial_926.jpg.title: Modern Powder Room with Geometric Accent Wall
industrial_926.jpg.description: A stylish powder room featuring a dramatic black geometric pattern wall with diagonal lines. A pendant Edison bulb light fixture hangs above. The space includes a white pedestal sink, circular mirror, and a blue vase with hydrangea blooms adding a pop of color.

southwestern_442.jpg.title: Curved Stone Garden Bench
southwestern_442.jpg.description: A curved outdoor bench made of stacked stone with a smooth limestone or concrete cap, set against a block wall with decorative metal sun and cactus wall art. The bench is built on a paved stone patio with herringbone pattern pavers.

eclectic_115.jpg.title: Modern Teal Kitchen with Natural Light
eclectic_115.jpg.description: A contemporary kitchen featuring bold teal cabinets and bright natural lighting from large windows. The space includes floating wooden shelves above the windows, white countertops, and a colorful vintage-style runner rug. The design maximizes storage while maintaining an open, airy feel.

victorian_703.jpg.title: Romantic Red Master Bedroom
victorian_703.jpg.description: Luxurious traditional bedroom featuring deep red walls, elegant drapery, and classic furnishings. The room is anchored by a grand dark wood bed with ornate headboard and crisp white bedding. A brass chandelier with cream shades provides ambient lighting, complemented by table lamps. Decorative plates adorn the wall, and a matching loveseat adds seating.

traditional_983.jpg.title: Modern Kitchen Vignette with Artistic Touch
traditional_983.jpg.description: Elegant kitchen detail featuring a modern pull-down faucet over a farmhouse sink, with marble subway tile backsplash. A striking black and white sketch artwork is mounted above. Fresh green hydrangeas add a vibrant natural element. The space combines contemporary and traditional elements with cream-colored cabinets and dark countertops.

rustic_842.jpg.title: Cozy Modern Bedroom with Plaid Bedding
rustic_842.jpg.description: A stylish bedroom featuring a plaid bedding ensemble in grey and blue tones, accompanied by a navy blue nightstand with brass hardware. A white table lamp and small potted plant add decorative touches. The bed has multiple textured pillows in grey, plaid, and dark green.

eclectic_9.jpg.title: Luxurious Rustic Lodge Room
eclectic_9.jpg.description: A cozy and sophisticated lodge-style seating area featuring rustic wood ceiling treatments and elegant furnishings. The space includes panoramic windows with nature views, built-in cabinetry for glassware display, and is anchored by a dramatic iron chandelier. The room combines rustic and luxury elements with leather seating and warm lighting.

eclectic_673.jpg.title: Modern Eclectic Living Room Corner
eclectic_673.jpg.description: A cozy living room corner featuring an exposed brick wall with framed nautical prints, a navy velvet armchair with gold frame, built-in white bookshelf, and various plants. The space combines traditional architectural elements with modern furnishings and is decorated with a vintage-style rug.

mediterranean_379.jpg.title: Modern Two-Tone Kitchen with Marble Backsplash
mediterranean_379.jpg.description: Contemporary kitchen featuring a two-tone cabinet design with light upper cabinets and darker lower cabinets. Marble backsplash and countertops, professional-grade stainless steel range, and decorative greenery in a white vase. The space includes brass hardware, hardwood flooring, and a vintage-style runner rug.

tropical_903.jpg.title: Tropical Palm Garden Border
tropical_903.jpg.description: A lush tropical garden border featuring tall red-stemmed palm trees as the backdrop, with layered purple foliage plants in the foreground. The garden is well-maintained with a manicured lawn edge and natural stone borders.

french-country_199.jpg.title: Serene Coastal Bedroom
french-country_199.jpg.description: A luxurious master bedroom featuring soft blue walls and neutral furnishings. The room showcases elegant window treatments with both curtains and roman shades in light grey tones. A plush chaise lounge sits at the foot of a well-dressed bed with multiple pillows and layers of bedding in whites and greys. A modern circular chandelier hangs from the ceiling.

scandinavian_821.jpg.title: Modern Marble Shower Niche
scandinavian_821.jpg.description: Modern bathroom shower corner featuring light marble-look tile walls with built-in recessed shelving niche containing various bath products. Includes a floating bench seat made of matching stone material.

tropical_917.jpg.title: Industrial Modern Concrete Bathroom
tropical_917.jpg.description: A minimalist bathroom featuring raw concrete walls and floors with a floating concrete vanity. The space includes a sleek wall-mounted toilet and a contemporary vessel sink. A large framed mirror hangs above the vanity, with a gallery wall visible in its reflection. The shower area features modern fixtures and a glass partition.

scandinavian_835.jpg.title: Modern Scandinavian Grey Bedroom
scandinavian_835.jpg.description: A minimalist bedroom featuring grey walls and contemporary decor. The space is anchored by a bed with rumpled grey bedding and a white throw blanket. A spherical paper pendant light hangs from the ceiling, while a modern leather accent chair sits in the corner. The room is brightened by natural light through sheer white curtains, and features modern wall art and potted plants for organic touches.

eclectic_667.jpg.title: Luxurious Stone Fireplace Living Room
eclectic_667.jpg.description: A warm and inviting living room featuring a dramatic floor-to-ceiling stone fireplace with a see-through design. The space showcases vaulted wooden beam ceilings with a large black lantern chandelier. The room is furnished with comfortable beige sofas and decorated with floral throw pillows. A modern gas fireplace insert is surrounded by natural stone masonry.

coastal_746.jpg.title: Modern Coastal Living Room with Gallery Wall
coastal_746.jpg.description: A bright, airy living room featuring a gray sectional sofa anchored by a geometric patterned ottoman in mint and white. The space is adorned with a curated gallery wall of black and white artwork, complemented by lush green plants. A hanging rattan chair adds bohemian flair, while natural light streams in through large windows.

traditional_997.jpg.title: Elegant Exterior of White Brick Home
traditional_997.jpg.description: The image shows the exterior of an elegant home with a white brick facade, complemented by a brown roof and lush landscaping. The structure features a prominent tower-like section with multiple windows, adding architectural interest. A low black fence and manicured shrubs define the property line, enhancing its curb appeal against a backdrop of mature trees and a blue, partly cloudy sky.

victorian_717.jpg.title: Elegant Dining Room Interior
victorian_717.jpg.description: A classically designed dining room featuring a large wooden china cabinet filled with glassware and china. A highly polished dining table surrounded by upholstered dining chairs, with a decorative rug underneath. The walls are adorned with yellow wallpaper, and a chandelier hangs above the table.

rustic_856.jpg.title: Cozy Rustic Living Room with Bunk Beds
rustic_856.jpg.description: A warm and inviting living room features a comfortable brown sofa adorned with decorative pumpkin pillows. Built-in wooden bunk beds line the wall, accessible by wooden stairs. The room is lit by recessed lighting in the wooden ceiling and supplemented by a table lamp on a wooden side table. The interior exudes a rustic charm, with wood paneling and earthy tones throughout.

industrial_932.jpg.title: Rustic Industrial Kitchen Interior
industrial_932.jpg.description: An industrial-style kitchen features a blend of rustic and modern elements. A large, exposed wooden cabinet houses a stainless steel refrigerator and a washing machine. Above the appliances, woven baskets provide additional storage. The walls are painted in a dark gray-blue color, contrasting with the light gray wooden flooring. A rustic wooden table with metal legs is surrounded by mismatched wooden chairs. Above the table, a chandelier adds a touch of elegance. The kitchen area also includes stainless steel countertops, open shelving with kitchen utensils, and a range hood. Exposed pipes and light fixtures contribute to the industrial aesthetic.

southwestern_456.jpg.title: Exterior view of a modern stucco house with stone accents
southwestern_456.jpg.description: This is an exterior shot of a two-story house featuring a blend of stucco and stone elements. The home has a muted color scheme, predominantly beige and light brown, complemented by the darker hues of the stone accents. The front entrance is framed by a stone facade, extending slightly from the main structure. A walkway leads up to the front door, with desert landscaping including rocks, cacti, and sparse greenery flanking the path. Large windows provide glimpses of the interior, revealing a well-lit living space. The roof is tiled, adding a touch of texture to the overall design. A dark metal fence runs along the front of the property.

french-country_833.jpg.title: Luxurious Marble Shower
french-country_833.jpg.description: A bright and elegant shower featuring light marble tiles. The space includes a built-in niche for toiletries, a comfortable bench, and chrome shower fixtures. The overall design is clean and modern, offering a spa-like experience.

traditional_767.jpg.title: Elegant Kitchen with Marble Island
traditional_767.jpg.description: A beautifully designed kitchen with a large marble-topped island as the central feature. The island is painted in a sophisticated gray, contrasting with the white cabinetry surrounding the perimeter of the room. Elegant gold lantern-style pendant lights hang above the island, providing both illumination and a touch of glamour. The white backsplash, which extends up to the range hood, complements the overall bright and airy feel of the space. Wood flooring adds warmth and character to the kitchen. The countertops appear to be made of the same marble as the island, creating a cohesive look. The space includes high-end appliances and careful attention to detail in the trim and molding.

transitional_282.jpg.title: Elegant Kitchen Corner Detail
transitional_282.jpg.description: A detailed shot of a kitchen corner featuring a gas stovetop, marble countertop, and backsplash. A wooden cutting board, oil bottle, candle, and flower arrangement create a homey atmosphere. The overall color palette is soft and neutral, enhanced by the pop of color from the turquoise teapot.

eclectic_129.jpg.title: Modern House Exterior with Balcony
eclectic_129.jpg.description: This is a picture of a modern house exterior with a balcony. The house has a dark blue siding and black roof, and the balcony has a wooden deck and metal railings. In front of the house are large rocks. The house is surrounded by trees.

mid-century-modern_727.jpg.title: Modern Bathroom with Wooden Cabinets
mid-century-modern_727.jpg.description: A modern bathroom features sleek wooden cabinets with a floating vanity, a large mirror reflecting the shower area, and glass shower enclosure. The lighting consists of recessed lights and hanging pendant lights over the vanity. The color scheme includes natural wood tones, white countertops, and light blue accents in the shower. A plant adds a touch of nature to the space.

farmhouse_33.jpg.title: Bright and Airy Modern Bedroom
farmhouse_33.jpg.description: A stylish modern bedroom featuring a neutral color palette with accents of gold and brown. The room is well-lit with a high vaulted ceiling and a modern chandelier. Two mid-century modern style chairs are placed in front of a dresser with a round gold mirror above. The bed is decorated with several pillows and a patterned duvet cover. A large framed artwork hangs above the bed. A grey area rug grounds the space. Overall, the room presents a calm and sophisticated atmosphere.

asian_124.jpg.title: Elegant Entryway with Garden View
asian_124.jpg.description: A welcoming entryway features a textured beige wall covering, warm wooden floors, and a stylish dark console table adorned with a vase of flowers. Natural light streams in from an open doorway, offering a glimpse of a lush garden courtyard. The wooden doors with vertical paneling add to the room's elegance, while two cylindrical pendant lights illuminate the space from above. A simple woven rug lies on the floor, grounding the entryway.

modern_852.jpg.title: Modern Kitchen Island with Linear Light
modern_852.jpg.description: A bright and minimalist kitchen features a sleek white countertop island with waterfall edges. Three wooden bar stools with sculpted seats are neatly arranged in front of the island. Above, a long, linear brass light fixture illuminates the space, contrasting with the white cabinetry and walls. A stainless steel faucet and sink are integrated into the countertop. A decorative twig sculpture adds a touch of organic texture to the minimalist space.

asian_642.jpg.title: Modern Minimalist Interior with Kitchen and Lounge
asian_642.jpg.description: This interior shot showcases a modern minimalist design. A light wood kitchen with sleek cabinets and stainless steel appliances is visible. The foreground features a lounge area with a unique chaise lounge draped in a hide. A slim floor lamp stands nearby. A small picture in a recessed frame adorns the wall. The color palette is dominated by light woods and neutral tones, contributing to the clean, airy feel of the space. A doorway leads into a bright bathroom.

southwestern_318.jpg.title: Rustic Bedroom with Fireplace
southwestern_318.jpg.description: A cozy and inviting bedroom features a rustic fireplace nestled in the corner, adding warmth and charm. The bed is adorned with neutral-toned linens and decorative pillows, while a wooden-framed window offers a serene view of the outdoor landscape. The exposed wooden beams on the ceiling complement the earthy color palette, creating a tranquil and comfortable atmosphere.

craftsman_286.jpg.title: Modern Farmhouse Kitchen with Island
craftsman_286.jpg.description: This image showcases a modern farmhouse style kitchen featuring a large island with a dark base and a warm wood countertop. The kitchen includes white walls, a white paneled ceiling with exposed wooden beams, and a black-framed window. There are open shelves, stainless steel appliances, and a combination of light and dark cabinetry. The flooring is a warm wood tone. The overall aesthetic is clean, bright, and inviting with a blend of modern and rustic elements.

eclectic_897.jpg.title: Art Deco Powder Room with Peacock Wallpaper
eclectic_897.jpg.description: A small powder room featuring dramatic peacock feather patterned wallpaper in gray and coral tones. The space includes a traditional pedestal sink and toilet, with a round mirror mounted on the patterned wall. Natural light enters through a white-framed window.

mediterranean_345.jpg.title: Minimalist Shower Room
mediterranean_345.jpg.description: A clean, modern shower space featuring a small window for natural light. The room has concrete flooring and white walls, with a sleek rainfall showerhead mounted on the wall. A built-in shelf holds a small potted plant and beige towel.

craftsman_292.jpg.title: Luxury Outdoor Kitchen with Decorative Pergola
craftsman_292.jpg.description: High-end outdoor kitchen space featuring a custom curved stone counter with a built-in grill station under a wooden pergola with decorative metal inserts. The pergola creates beautiful shadow patterns and includes integrated lighting. The space connects to the main house which has gray siding and opens to a landscaped backyard.

eclectic_883.jpg.title: Modern Serene Bedroom with Geometric Wallpaper
eclectic_883.jpg.description: A contemporary bedroom featuring a white upholstered platform bed adorned with layered throw pillows in teal, peach, and gray. The wall showcases a striking geometric lattice wallpaper pattern. Natural light streams in through a large window with sheer curtains. A framed artwork hangs above the bed, flanked by brass wall-mounted sconces.

mediterranean_351.jpg.title: Mediterranean Outdoor Living Loggia
mediterranean_351.jpg.description: Elegant covered outdoor patio featuring dramatic stone archways and vaulted ceilings. The space includes a formal dining arrangement with upholstered chairs and decorative blue spherical accents on the table. The limestone arches open to a night view with illuminated landscaping.

farmhouse_946.jpg.title: Modern Farmhouse Kitchen with Sliding Barn Door
farmhouse_946.jpg.description: A modern kitchen space featuring a white cabinet island with a butcher block countertop, complemented by pendant glass lighting fixtures. A rustic sliding barn door adds character to the space. The area includes hardwood flooring and beige walls, with a decorative wreath on the barn door.

asian_656.jpg.title: Modern Asian-Inspired Hallway
asian_656.jpg.description: A sophisticated hallway featuring warm wood paneling and a dramatic skylight ceiling. The space combines natural light from above with modern architectural elements, creating a zen-like corridor. The hallway features clean lines, minimalist design, and natural elements including potted plants.

scandinavian_809.jpg.title: Modern Lakeside Living Room
scandinavian_809.jpg.description: Spacious contemporary living room with panoramic lake views through large windows. Features grey hardwood flooring and a minimalist design scheme with carefully selected statement furniture pieces. A modern fireplace and woodpile storage add warmth to the space.

contemporary_392.jpg.title: Luxury Modern Pool House at Dusk
contemporary_392.jpg.description: Contemporary luxury residence featuring a geometric swimming pool with illuminated features at twilight. The architectural design showcases floor-to-ceiling windows, multiple levels, and an open-concept living space that seamlessly connects to the outdoor area. The backyard includes a wooden deck, lounge chairs, and perfectly manicured lawn areas.

modern_846.jpg.title: Modern Wood and Marble Kitchen with Island Seating
modern_846.jpg.description: Contemporary open-concept kitchen and living space featuring wood paneled ceiling and walls, marble backsplash, pendant globe lighting, and a large kitchen island with bar seating. The space transitions into a living area with plush seating and decorative pillows.

traditional_773.jpg.title: Modern Master Bathroom with Stone Shower
traditional_773.jpg.description: Elegant master bathroom featuring a spacious glass-enclosed shower with stone tile walls, a double vanity with cream countertop, and a built-in soaking tub. Natural light enters through window openings, illuminating the neutral-toned space.

mediterranean_437.jpg.title: Modern Dining Room with Dramatic Fireplace Wall
mediterranean_437.jpg.description: Luxurious open-concept dining room featuring a floor-to-ceiling dark grey fireplace wall with linear gas insert. The space showcases exposed wooden beams, high vaulted ceilings, and hardwood flooring. A large dining table with tufted upholstered chairs sits atop a natural fiber area rug. The room benefits from natural light through large windows.

transitional_296.jpg.title: Modern Marble Shower Enclosure
transitional_296.jpg.description: A contemporary bathroom shower installation featuring large-format marble-look tiles in light gray with subtle veining. The shower includes a built-in niche for toiletries, a chrome rainfall showerhead, and a partial glass enclosure. The design demonstrates clean lines and minimalist styling.

mid-century-modern_733.jpg.title: Modern Spa-Like Bathroom
mid-century-modern_733.jpg.description: A luxurious contemporary bathroom featuring a floating wooden vanity, glass shower enclosure, and modern brass fixtures. The space incorporates natural elements with clean lines and minimalist design principles. A decorative woven stool and small floral arrangement add organic touches to the otherwise sleek space.

farmhouse_27.jpg.title: Cozy Farmhouse Laundry Room
farmhouse_27.jpg.description: A charming laundry room featuring white shiplap walls, modern appliances, and vintage-inspired decor. The space includes wall-mounted shelving with watering cans, potted plants, and a prominent 'ALTERATIONS' sign. The room combines practical elements with decorative touches, including framed artwork, woven baskets, and hanging plants.

coastal_949.jpg.title: Modern Mint Kitchen with Fluted Island
coastal_949.jpg.description: Bright, airy kitchen featuring a large fluted island in mint green with a white stone countertop. The space includes white walls, floating shelves, and is accented by a dramatic organic arrangement in a neutral ceramic vase. Natural light floods in through windows, and the design incorporates black bentwood counter stools for contrast.

rustic_881.jpg.title: Modern Farmhouse Entryway and Dining Room
rustic_881.jpg.description: A bright interior space featuring a dining room view through an entryway. The space showcases a wooden front door with glass panels, white coffered ceiling, contemporary chandelier, and a farmhouse-style dining setup on a patterned area rug.

french-country_13.jpg.title: Luxury Traditional Kitchen with Island
french-country_13.jpg.description: Elegant kitchen featuring exposed wooden beams, custom white cabinetry, and a large central island with marble countertops. Glass pendant lighting hangs above the island, which includes upholstered bar seating. The kitchen includes high-end appliances and a decorative tile backsplash.

victorian_918.jpg.title: Traditional Kitchen with Black Range and Subway Tile
victorian_918.jpg.description: Kitchen detail showing a black gas range installed against a cream-colored subway tile backsplash. The range is flanked by white painted cabinetry and topped with what appears to be a beige granite or quartz countertop. The tile work features a decorative border pattern.

victorian_75.jpg.title: Elegant Marble Bathroom with Freestanding Tub
victorian_75.jpg.description: Luxurious bathroom featuring marble tile walls, a freestanding soaking tub, exposed copper piping, vintage-style fixtures, and an ornate gilt mirror. The space includes a window providing natural light and a decorative wall plaque.

mid-century-modern_900.jpg.title: Modern Desert Garden Path
mid-century-modern_900.jpg.description: A contemporary architectural landscape design featuring ornamental grasses and desert-adapted plants along a pathway leading to a modern structure. The scene is captured during golden hour, with natural stone walls and architectural elements creating a harmonious blend with the natural environment.

rustic_659.jpg.title: Modern Rustic Living Room with Dramatic Fireplace
rustic_659.jpg.description: A luxurious living room featuring a floor-to-ceiling fireplace with weathered metal panels and exposed wooden beams. Large windows provide natural light and forest views. The space combines contemporary comfort with rustic elements.

modern_675.jpg.title: Modern Pool House with Outdoor Bar
modern_675.jpg.description: Luxurious backyard pool setting featuring a contemporary pool house structure with an integrated outdoor bar. The rectangular swimming pool has clean lines and reflects the sky, while the bar area features a wooden pergola-style roof and modern seating. The space is surrounded by natural landscaping and stone retaining walls.

contemporary_379.jpg.title: Modern White Kitchen with Black & White Gallery Wall
contemporary_379.jpg.description: Contemporary kitchen featuring a large white waterfall island with blurred motion of someone at the counter. The space has white cabinetry, stainless steel appliances, and a distinctive black and white photo gallery wall. Dark hardwood flooring provides contrast to the bright white elements. A modern pendant light hangs above the island, which includes grey upholstered bar stools.

southwestern_481.jpg.title: Bright Coastal Bedroom Detail
southwestern_481.jpg.description: A contemporary bedroom corner featuring a white wall with vibrant blue artwork above. The bedding is crisp white with geometric patterned pillows and a colorful striped accent pillow. A simple white side table holds a vase of fresh sunflowers, while a modern pendant light hangs above.

tropical_718.jpg.title: Contemporary Home Office with Built-in Shelving
tropical_718.jpg.description: Luxurious home office featuring custom built-in dark wood shelving system with integrated desk. The room includes plantation shutters, floor-to-ceiling curtains, and recessed lighting. Decorative objects and artwork adorn the floating shelves, including a striking blue abstract artwork. The space combines functionality with sophisticated design elements.

farmhouse_775.jpg.title: Modern Marble and Glass Bathroom
farmhouse_775.jpg.description: Contemporary bathroom featuring a glass block window, walk-in shower with brushed gold fixtures, white subway tile walls, and patterned floor tiles. The space includes a marble countertop and a glass shower enclosure with black frame details.

modern_113.jpg.title: Modern Pool House with Geometric Paving
modern_113.jpg.description: A luxurious modern pool house set in a lush garden setting. Features a rectangular swimming pool with geometric concrete pavers leading to a minimalist pool house structure. The design incorporates clean lines and indoor-outdoor living concepts with floor-to-ceiling glass doors. Surrounded by mature pine trees and manicured landscaping.

shabby-chic-style_910.jpg.title: Modern Minimalist Living Room
shabby-chic-style_910.jpg.description: A spacious, bright living room with a coffered ceiling featuring clean lines and minimal decor. The room showcases a large sectional sofa, fireplace, and flat-screen TV mounted above a modern media console. Two tall windows flank the entertainment area, bringing in natural light.

eclectic_868.jpg.title: Modern Rustic Living Room Corner
eclectic_868.jpg.description: A cozy living room corner featuring leather armchairs with black frames, wooden floating shelves, and a rustic coffee table. The space is decorated with green and navy blue accent pillows, potted plants, and styled coffee table books.

craftsman_279.jpg.title: Inviting Outdoor Living Space with Stone Fireplace
craftsman_279.jpg.description: A comfortable and inviting outdoor living space is centered around a large stone fireplace with a fire burning inside. Above the fireplace is a television displaying a landscape scene. Wicker furniture with white cushions and blue pillows offers ample seating around a round white table. The space is partially covered by a wooden roof with exposed beams. A wooden door is visible on the right. The stone flooring and surrounding foliage enhance the natural setting.

shabby-chic-style_904.jpg.title: Soft Lighting and Diamond Wall
shabby-chic-style_904.jpg.description: A cozy interior scene showcasing a string of soft, spherical lights, casting a gentle glow in a room with a diamond-patterned wallpaper. The lights are suspended beneath a white shelf or ledge, suggesting a whimsical and warm ambiance.

modern_107.jpg.title: Luxury Villa with Pool
modern_107.jpg.description: A luxurious modern villa is featured in this eye-level shot, highlighting its outdoor living space and swimming pool. The villa boasts a sleek, flat roof with wooden paneling supported by dark-colored pillars on white bases, creating a striking contrast. Large sliding glass doors open onto a spacious patio area, seamlessly blending indoor and outdoor living. A circular wicker chair sits invitingly on the patio, hinting at relaxation and comfort. Beyond the patio, glimpses into the interior reveal a dining area with orange chairs and a bedroom with a visible bed. The swimming pool is a central feature, its turquoise waters reflecting the sky and the villa's architecture, bordered by light-colored stone. Lush green plants frame the pool, adding a touch of nature to the modern setting. The overall scene evokes a sense of tranquility, luxury, and sophisticated design.

asian_871.jpg.title: Bedroom with Floral Wall Art
asian_871.jpg.description: A minimalist bedroom features a low-profile, dark-toned bed frame supporting a bed with white linens and pillows. Above the bed hangs a large canvas print of pink and purple flowers against a textured, muted background. The room has a clean, modern aesthetic with a light grey wall and polished concrete floor. A small beige rug is positioned near the foot of the bed, and a bedside table is partially visible. The overall style is simple, calming, and contemporary.

industrial_729.jpg.title: Modern Bathroom with Double Vanity
industrial_729.jpg.description: This image showcases a modern bathroom design featuring a double vanity with concrete countertops. The vanity is equipped with two rectangular sinks and matte black faucets. Underneath the counter, a rustic wooden shelf provides storage space for towels. Above the vanity, two black-framed mirrors hang, each lit by a matte black sconce. A window with a black frame is present on the right side of the image.  The room is painted white.

scandinavian_148.jpg.title: Living Room with Barn Door
scandinavian_148.jpg.description: A bright, airy living space featuring a natural wood barn door that partially obscures an adjacent room with a small round table and stool. The living room side contains a light-colored sofa with a botanical print pillow, a wooden coffee table, and neutral walls. The barn door hangs on a visible metal track, adding a rustic-modern touch to the space.

french-country_628.jpg.title: Elegant Living Room with Natural Light
french-country_628.jpg.description: This image depicts a bright and airy living room with a focus on natural light. The room features a large white sofa facing a wall of windows that offer a view of lush greenery outside. A decorative console table is positioned behind the sofa, adding to the room's elegance. Two ornate chandeliers hang from the ceiling, illuminating the space. A marble fireplace and a television are placed on the right side of the room. The color palette is predominantly neutral with light beige walls and white accents. The overall design exudes a sense of sophistication and comfort.

modern_661.jpg.title: Pull-Out Trash Can Cabinet
modern_661.jpg.description: Close-up of a pull-out trash can cabinet in a kitchen setting. The cabinet is light gray with silver hardware and houses two white plastic bins. The pull-out mechanism is visible, with metal tracks supporting a wooden base for the bins. The floor is tiled in a light neutral color. The adjacent cabinet is a darker blue.

southwestern_495.jpg.title: Cozy Bedroom with Rustic Accents
southwestern_495.jpg.description: A cozy bedroom features a large bed with white linens and neutral-toned pillows, accented by a decorative headboard and bedside sconces. A rustic wooden bench sits at the foot of the bed, adding a touch of vintage charm. Small floral arrangements on the nightstands and patterned pillows provide pops of color and visual interest.

traditional_954.jpg.title: Elegant Bathroom with Arched Mirrors
traditional_954.jpg.description: A well-lit bathroom features a double vanity with two arched mirrors above it, flanked by tall dark wood cabinets. The vanity has a white marble countertop and twin white sinks with exposed brass plumbing and vintage-style faucets. A ceramic pot with yellow flowers sits in the center of the countertop. The floor is tiled in a checkerboard pattern of muted greens and creams. Sconces are mounted between the mirrors and the cabinets. A wicker stool is placed beneath the vanity.

rustic_895.jpg.title: Rustic Mountain Home Exterior
rustic_895.jpg.description: The exterior of a rustic mountain home is showcased, blending natural elements with modern design. The house features a metal roof, exposed wooden beams, and stone accents. A covered entryway is illuminated by hanging pendant lights, adding a warm glow. The landscaping includes young trees and a low stone wall, complementing the home's natural aesthetic. The driveway is paved with gray stones, completing the inviting facade.

victorian_61.jpg.title: Luxurious Home Theater
victorian_61.jpg.description: A sumptuously decorated home theater featuring plush brown and gold furnishings. A large screen displays a classic black-and-white film. The room is accented with patterned wallpaper, elegant vases, and a stylish coffee table with a tray. Two armchairs and a cushioned ottoman provide seating, while dark curtains offer privacy. Spotlights illuminate the ceiling.

transitional_269.jpg.title: Colorful Laundry Room
transitional_269.jpg.description: A modern laundry room features a front-loading washer and dryer set in white. The appliances are placed under a white countertop which holds a green tray with cleaning supplies, a wicker basket, and a potted plant. The walls are covered in a geometric, colorful wallpaper in shades of purple, green, yellow, and pink. A small window is positioned above the countertop, providing natural light.

mid-century-modern_914.jpg.title: Contemporary Home Exterior
mid-century-modern_914.jpg.description: A view of the exterior of a contemporary home featuring a stone facade, a wood front door, and a curved pathway leading to the entrance. The landscaping includes a variety of plants and flowers, with a large agave in the foreground. The home's architecture includes a prominent roofline and dark-framed windows.

industrial_701.jpg.title: Modern Exterior of a Two-Story Home
industrial_701.jpg.description: The exterior of a modern two-story home is showcased in this daytime shot. The residence features a combination of materials including dark brick, wood siding, and large windows, creating a visually striking design. A black garage door is visible, and the driveway is bordered by decorative grasses, adding to the contemporary landscape. The home's architecture blends clean lines with natural elements, creating an inviting and sophisticated curb appeal.

french-country_600.jpg.title: Elegant Living Room with Rustic Accents
french-country_600.jpg.description: This image showcases a beautifully designed living room blending rustic and elegant elements. The room features exposed wooden beams on the ceiling, paired with two ceiling fans. A large stone fireplace is a focal point, topped with several blue lanterns. The furniture arrangement includes comfortable sofas and chairs in light blues and creams, arranged around a wooden coffee table and a small side table with a lamp. The floor is tiled, and a striped rug anchors the seating area. Natural light floods the room through large sliding glass doors, adding warmth and brightness to the space.

scandinavian_160.jpg.title: Modern Minimalist Bathroom Design
scandinavian_160.jpg.description: A contemporary bathroom featuring a floating wooden vanity with a vessel sink, circular mirror, brass wall-mounted faucet, and decorative pink peonies. The space includes a shower area with mustard yellow towels and combines white tile flooring with wooden shower floor details.

modern_649.jpg.title: Modern White Marble Kitchen
modern_649.jpg.description: Sleek contemporary kitchen featuring white marble waterfall countertops and built-in stainless steel appliances. The space showcases a minimalist design with clean lines, white cabinetry, and a luxurious marble island with dramatic veining. Built-in wall ovens and a microwave are installed in a floor-to-ceiling cabinet wall.

contemporary_345.jpg.title: Modern Mountain View Library Room
contemporary_345.jpg.description: A contemporary living space featuring floor-to-ceiling windows with stunning forest and mountain views. The room includes a built-in bookshelf, comfortable seating area, and a fireplace. Natural light floods the space through large windows framed with wooden trim.

craftsman_523.jpg.title: Rustic Wood Ceiling Room
craftsman_523.jpg.description: Empty interior room featuring exposed wooden ceiling beams and planks, white shiplap walls, and a framed window with natural wood trim. The room has a concrete or gray floor and displays a minimalist, unfinished aesthetic.

coastal_975.jpg.title: Elegant Double Vanity Bathroom
coastal_975.jpg.description: A luxurious master bathroom featuring a custom built-in double vanity with white cabinetry, marble countertops, and two oval mirrors. Wall-mounted sconces flank each mirror, while gray subway tile backsplash adds texture. Green foliage in a clear vase provides a natural accent.

transitional_241.jpg.title: Modern Rustic Living Room with Stone Fireplace
transitional_241.jpg.description: A cozy living room featuring a floor-to-ceiling stone fireplace, exposed wooden beam, and comfortable seating arrangement. The space combines natural textures with modern comfort, including patterned accent chairs and plush sofas. Wall art and decorative accessories create a balanced, welcoming atmosphere.

rustic_665.jpg.title: Modern A-Frame Forest Retreat
rustic_665.jpg.description: A striking contemporary A-frame house featuring floor-to-ceiling windows and multiple decks. The exterior is painted dark gray/black with natural wood accents. Climbing ivy adds organic texture to the structure. The home includes a rooftop deck and ground-level wooden deck with outdoor furniture. The building is set among bare winter trees, creating a serene forest setting.

victorian_49.jpg.title: Charming Garden Potting Shed
victorian_49.jpg.description: A quaint garden shed with striking red trim against beige siding. Features large multi-pane windows and a red door. The structure has a classic cottage style with steep roof pitch and is surrounded by lush greenery.

rustic_103.jpg.title: Modern Farmhouse Sunroom Office
rustic_103.jpg.description: A bright and airy home office space featuring large black-framed windows, rustic wood beam ceiling, and white shiplap walls. Natural light floods the room, highlighting a casual seating and work area with views to autumn foliage outside.

mediterranean_386.jpg.title: Custom Wine Cellar Storage Detail
mediterranean_386.jpg.description: Interior view of a luxury wine cellar featuring custom wooden wine racks, hanging stemware storage, and a decorative stone or tile backsplash. The space includes built-in bottle storage and a display area with wine glasses mounted underneath wooden shelving.

eclectic_854.jpg.title: Boho Chic Master Bedroom
eclectic_854.jpg.description: A beautifully styled bedroom featuring a white bed with mixed patterned pillows, flanked by matching round mirrors and black side tables. The room is anchored by a vintage-style Persian rug in blue and red tones. A tufted bench sits at the foot of the bed, and the space is decorated with a carved wooden headboard panel.

farmhouse_749.jpg.title: Cozy Under-Stairs Reading Nook
farmhouse_749.jpg.description: A cleverly designed reading nook built into the space under a staircase. Features a built-in bench with cushions and pillows, wooden bead board backing, and integrated book storage underneath. The space is illuminated by a wall-mounted reading lamp.

tropical_724.jpg.title: Luxury Hawaiian Lanai with Stone Feature Wall
tropical_724.jpg.description: An elegant outdoor living space featuring a dramatic floor-to-ceiling stone wall with integrated planters. The covered lanai includes comfortable modern outdoor furniture set against a backdrop of tropical landscaping and ocean views. The space seamlessly blends indoor-outdoor living with high-end finishes and natural materials.

asian_859.jpg.title: Modern Japanese Minimalist Bathroom
asian_859.jpg.description: Contemporary bathroom featuring a double vanity with wooden countertop and vessel sinks. The space includes a large wall mirror, dark vertical tile backsplash, and wooden cabinetry. The adjacent room appears to be a laundry or utility area with white fixtures.

contemporary_423.jpg.title: Elegant Modern Interior with Art and Natural Light
contemporary_423.jpg.description: A bright and airy modern interior featuring a spacious living area with large windows, a striking chrome rocking chair, and a glimpse into a dining room with modern art and hanging globe lights. The flooring consists of square tiles with a grid pattern. The overall impression is one of sophisticated minimalist design with an emphasis on light and space.

french-country_166.jpg.title: Spacious Living Room with Fireplace and Natural Light
french-country_166.jpg.description: An expansive living room features a soaring ceiling adorned with wooden beams, accentuating the height of the space. A white brick fireplace serves as a focal point, adding a touch of rustic charm. Large sliding glass doors offer ample natural light and showcase the outdoor scenery. Comfortable seating arrangements include plush sofas and armchairs, inviting relaxation and conversation. The hardwood flooring adds warmth and complements the neutral color palette, creating a welcoming and sophisticated atmosphere.

scandinavian_606.jpg.title: Modern Bathroom with Wooden Vanity
scandinavian_606.jpg.description: A well-lit modern bathroom features a wooden vanity with a white countertop sink, complemented by black fixtures and a toilet. White and grey tiled walls provide a clean backdrop. Accents include a black towel shelf, small plants, and a shower-tub combo.

farmhouse_991.jpg.title: Bright Sunroom with Modern Style
farmhouse_991.jpg.description: This image features a sunroom with a modern style. The walls are painted white with a vertical shiplap design, and the room has large black-framed windows that offer a view of the outside greenery. There is a gray sectional couch in the middle of the room with various throw pillows. A black coffee table sits in front of the couch with greenery on top of it.

asian_21.jpg.title: Illuminated Staircase with Wooden Accents
asian_21.jpg.description: A modern interior shot featuring a wooden staircase with warm, embedded lighting illuminating each step. A simple wooden handrail runs along the right wall, which is painted in a neutral tone. The left wall features vertical wooden slats, adding texture and depth to the space. At the top of the staircase, a barred window or screen filters natural light, creating a soft and inviting atmosphere.

asian_681.jpg.title: Modern Bathroom Design
asian_681.jpg.description: A modern bathroom features a wooden tub filled with white petals, set beside a window covered by a bamboo shade. The walls are tiled in a stone-like pattern with varying shades of brown. A frosted glass shower door is partially visible, suggesting a walk-in shower area.

tropical_730.jpg.title: Tropical Retreat with Pool House
tropical_730.jpg.description: A serene outdoor scene features a tropical-style pool house adjacent to a tranquil pond. The pool house, with its thatched roof and wooden structure, is surrounded by lush greenery, including palm trees and various plants. The pond reflects the structure, creating a mirror-like effect. The landscape is well-manicured with stepping stones leading through the grass. The blue sky peeks through the foliage, adding to the peaceful ambiance.

contemporary_437.jpg.title: Galley Kitchen with Stainless Steel Appliances
contemporary_437.jpg.description: This is a bright and modern galley kitchen. The design incorporates white upper cabinets and light wood grain lower cabinets paired with light countertops. A stainless steel refrigerator is centered in the room, flanked by matching cabinets. The range and overhead microwave are also stainless steel, completing the cohesive look. The flooring is hardwood, and the backsplash features a light marble pattern, adding texture to the space.

french-country_172.jpg.title: Elegant Home Wine Cellar
french-country_172.jpg.description: A well-organized and stylish home wine cellar. The space features multiple wine racks arranged in arched alcoves, some constructed from dark-toned wood and others from brick. Glass shelves are illuminated with spotlights, showcasing a variety of wine bottles and decorative items. A round wooden table and a wine barrel add to the room's ambiance, while the light wood flooring provides a clean contrast to the darker elements.

farmhouse_985.jpg.title: Minimalist Living Room with Concrete Floors
farmhouse_985.jpg.description: An empty minimalist living room featuring a concrete floor, a modern black fireplace set into a white wall, recessed lighting, and large glass doors to the left. The room is sparsely decorated, emphasizing clean lines and open space.

scandinavian_612.jpg.title: Bright Open Concept Living Space
scandinavian_612.jpg.description: This image showcases a bright and airy open concept living space, seamlessly integrating the living room, kitchen, and dining area. The living room features a large, comfortable-looking beige sofa adorned with textured throw pillows and a cozy knit blanket. Adjacent is a small round side table with decorative items. The kitchen boasts a sizable island with bar seating, complemented by modern pendant lights hanging above. Clean white cabinetry and countertops enhance the bright ambiance. Large windows and a vaulted ceiling contribute to the sense of spaciousness and natural light. The dining area, visible in the background, includes a dark wooden table and chairs, with more large windows offering views of the outdoors.

asian_695.jpg.title: Zen Garden Path
asian_695.jpg.description: A serene zen garden features a pathway of irregular flagstone stones, winding through a bed of light-colored gravel. Soft, flowing ornamental grass spills over the edges of the path, contrasting with the flat stones. Other plants and greenery add depth and texture to the scene. The image captures a sense of tranquility and natural beauty.

asian_35.jpg.title: Serene Wooden Soaking Tub with View
asian_35.jpg.description: A minimalist bathroom features a square wooden soaking tub. The tub is light in color and sits beneath a large window that offers a view of trees outside. A rolled mat rests on the edge of the tub. The room has simple walls, a wooden shelf, and a window to the left with light streaming in.

rustic_117.jpg.title: Rustic Green Kitchen with Brick Floor
rustic_117.jpg.description: A rustic-style kitchen features dark green cabinetry, a stainless steel sink with a black faucet, and light gray countertops. A brick floor adds warmth to the space, while a wood-paneled ceiling contributes to the rustic feel. Glass-front cabinets display kitchenware. The view through a glass door shows an open landscape.

transitional_533.jpg.title: Elegant Dining Room with Glass Table
transitional_533.jpg.description: This is a sophisticated dining room featuring a glass-top dining table surrounded by upholstered chairs with decorative stud detailing. A red runner adorns the table, topped with decorative plates, candles, and floral arrangements. A modern chandelier hangs above, complemented by soft, neutral-toned curtains and artwork on the walls. The room is grounded by a patterned rug, creating a cohesive and stylish space.

eclectic_698.jpg.title: Teal Bathroom with Rustic Vanity
eclectic_698.jpg.description: A close-up view of a stylish teal bathroom featuring a rustic wooden vanity with a white circular sink.
