The walls are covered in glossy teal subway tiles, complemented by brushed gold fixtures. The vanity has metal drawer pulls, and the countertop is white marble. A round wooden-framed mirror partially visible adds to the character. Jars with decorative contents sit on a small marble shelf, while a framed picture leans against the toilet top. The overall impression is a blend of rustic and modern design.

mediterranean_392.jpg.title: Modern Marble Bathroom with Patterned Shower
mediterranean_392.jpg.description: Luxurious contemporary bathroom featuring a frameless glass shower enclosure with geometric patterned tile accent wall. White marble-look walls, freestanding soaking tub with wooden bath caddy, and a window overlooking greenery. The space combines modern fixtures with natural elements.

craftsman_251.jpg.title: Modern Craftsman Entryway
craftsman_251.jpg.description: A welcoming entryway featuring a craftsman-style wooden front door with window panel, paired with a traditional bench seating area and console table. The space includes decorative wall art and potted plants for a homey touch. The floor appears to be dark slate or tile, and the walls are painted in a warm cream color.

eclectic_840.jpg.title: Bathroom Storage with Blue Wallpaper
eclectic_840.jpg.description: A bathroom storage nook featuring dark wood shelving with white towels and a playful green frog decoration. The space is accented by striking blue and white patterned wallpaper with a scrolling damask design.

traditional_968.jpg.title: Formal Garden Fountain with Floral Display
traditional_968.jpg.description: A classical tiered fountain serves as the centerpiece of a formal garden design. The fountain is surrounded by symmetrical flower beds featuring pink, purple, and white blooms. The garden is laid out in a geometric pattern with crushed stone pathways and features lush green shrubbery in the background.

craftsman_537.jpg.title: Craftsman Style Luxury Home Exterior
craftsman_537.jpg.description: Modern craftsman style home exterior featuring stone and siding, covered front porch with white columns, attached garage, and professional landscaping. The home has multiple gabled roofs, large windows, and architectural details typical of craftsman design.

coastal_961.jpg.title: Modern Carpeted Staircase with Natural Light
coastal_961.jpg.description: An elegant staircase featuring beige carpeting and white wooden railings with metal balusters. The space is flooded with natural light from tall windows. A wooden pedestal with a decorative vase containing olive branches adds an organic touch. The staircase leads to an upstairs landing and connects to a hallway with hardwood flooring.

victorian_930.jpg.title: Elegant Formal Dining Room
victorian_930.jpg.description: A sophisticated dining room featuring a crystal chandelier over a dark wood dining table. The space is adorned with cream upholstered chairs and layered window treatments including sheer balloon shades and floor-length drapes. The room has crown molding and appears to be set for a formal dining occasion.

rustic_671.jpg.title: Lakeside Rustic Cottage with Outdoor Fireplace
rustic_671.jpg.description: A cozy lakeside cottage featuring a stone exterior with timber accents, outdoor covered patio area with a stone fireplace. The property includes manicured lawn leading to waterfront, mature pine trees, and thoughtful landscaping with flowering beds. The architecture combines rustic materials with elegant design elements at dusk.

transitional_255.jpg.title: Modern Round Mirror with Natural Wood Frame
transitional_255.jpg.description: A minimalist interior scene featuring a large circular mirror with a wooden frame mounted on a white wall. The mirror reflects a window and bright interior space. A decorative vase with dried botanicals and a green leafy plant are visible in the corner of the frame.

mid-century-modern_928.jpg.title: Modern Master Suite with Black Partition Wall
mid-century-modern_928.jpg.description: Contemporary master bedroom suite featuring a dramatic black shiplap partition wall that houses a vanity area. The space combines bedroom and bathroom zones with a minimalist aesthetic. The white vaulted ceiling contrasts beautifully with the dark partition, while light wooden floors add warmth.

industrial_715.jpg.title: Rustic Industrial Restaurant Interior
industrial_715.jpg.description: A warm, inviting restaurant space featuring exposed brick walls and wooden beams. The interior combines industrial and rustic elements with modern lighting. A wooden console or service station is visible with decorative pumpkins, and the space includes industrial-style bar seating.

modern_885.jpg.title: Modern Open Concept Living Room with Cathedral Ceiling
modern_885.jpg.description: A bright, airy open-concept living space featuring soaring two-story ceilings with coffered details. The room showcases large windows, hardwood flooring, and flows into a kitchen area. The space is bathed in natural light and features a sophisticated neutral color palette.

french-country_614.jpg.title: Elegant Traditional Tea Setting
french-country_614.jpg.description: A formal dining table set for tea service with fine china and delicate place settings. The table features yellow and white china with gold trim, a tall beige vase centerpiece with dried wheat stalks, and is set against black Windsor-style chairs. The table is covered with a white embroidered tablecloth.

contemporary_351.jpg.title: Modern Minimalist Kitchen with Warm Wood Accents
contemporary_351.jpg.description: Contemporary kitchen featuring floor-to-ceiling cabinets in a neutral palette, with a striking combination of white upper cabinets and taupe lower cabinets. The space showcases a marble-like backsplash, wooden butcher block counter accents, and modern stainless steel appliances. A large window provides natural lighting, complemented by a professional-grade faucet and contemporary cabinet hardware.

southwestern_126.jpg.title: Modern Farmhouse Kitchen with Black Cabinets
southwestern_126.jpg.description: A stylish kitchen featuring black lower cabinets with brass hardware, a white farmhouse sink, and gold faucet fixtures. The space includes white marble countertops, open shelving, and natural decorative elements including potted plants and dried flowers. A wooden cutting board and decorative circular piece accent the walls.

contemporary_806.jpg.title: Modern Front Entry with Wood Beams
contemporary_806.jpg.description: A contemporary front entry featuring a modern wooden door with horizontal glass panels. The entrance is framed by rich wood beam posts and stone walls. The entryway is decorated with symmetrical black planters containing green foliage and a white decorative pumpkin, all set on gray stone tile flooring.

eclectic_471.jpg.title: Cozy Reading Nook with Circular Window
eclectic_471.jpg.description: A luxurious reading room featuring a stunning circular window with a nature view. The space is flanked by built-in dark green bookshelves and features a pink velvet sofa. The wooden ceiling has exposed beams and a decorative chandelier. A patterned area rug adds color and texture to the floor.

coastal_236.jpg.title: Luxury Living Room with Arched French Doors
coastal_236.jpg.description: Elegant living room space featuring soaring arched windows and French doors overlooking palm trees. The room showcases a crystal chandelier, white sectional sofa, and hardwood flooring. Art pieces are displayed in wall niches, and a glass coffee table sits atop a plush area rug.

transitional_902.jpg.title: Bright Modern Farmhouse Kitchen
transitional_902.jpg.description: A luxurious white kitchen featuring custom cabinetry, marble countertops, and a statement range hood. The space showcases a combination of traditional and modern elements with white brick backsplash, floating wooden shelves, and high-end appliances. Natural light streams through windows, highlighting the pristine surfaces and elegant fixtures.

shabby-chic-style_509.jpg.title: Floral Girls Bedroom with Coral Walls
shabby-chic-style_509.jpg.description: A charming children's bedroom featuring coral pink walls adorned with large floral decals in peach and mint green. The room includes a single bed with a white comforter and a mint green metal frame. A matching mint green nightstand sits beside the bed, and turquoise curtains frame the window. A chevron pattern area rug in cream and yellow adds a geometric element to the floor.

victorian_501.jpg.title: Classic Black and White Checkered Kitchen
victorian_501.jpg.description: Elegant galley kitchen featuring a dramatic black and white checkered floor pattern. The space showcases white cabinetry with glass-front upper cabinets, professional-grade stainless steel appliances, and a black backsplash. The kitchen extends into what appears to be a dining area with natural light filtering through a window with sheer curtains.

rustic_498.jpg.title: Modern Lakeside Sunroom with Reflecting Pool
rustic_498.jpg.description: A contemporary sunroom addition featuring floor-to-ceiling glass doors opening to a lakeside deck. The space includes a reflecting pool in the foreground that mirrors the architecture. The view captures outdoor dining furniture against a backdrop of fall foliage and a serene lake setting.

coastal_550.jpg.title: Modern White Kitchen with Custom Island
coastal_550.jpg.description: Bright contemporary kitchen featuring white shaker cabinets, custom wood-topped island with integrated sink, modern chrome pendant lighting, and hardwood flooring. The space includes under-cabinet lighting, stainless steel appliances, and contemporary white bar stools at the island.

traditional_559.jpg.title: Modern Master Bathroom Renovation
traditional_559.jpg.description: A luxurious contemporary bathroom featuring a large glass-enclosed shower with stone tile walls, a double vanity with cream countertop, and a soaking tub. Natural light enters through windows, complementing the warm beige color scheme.

southwestern_898.jpg.title: Desert Oasis Entrance
southwestern_898.jpg.description: An inviting outdoor space with rugged stone columns defining the entrance to a home, set against a backdrop of dark mountains at dusk. A low wall acts as a bench, complementing the warm-toned pavers that lead into the illuminated walkway.

scandinavian_389.jpg.title: Elegant Bedroom with Panel Walls
scandinavian_389.jpg.description: A beautifully styled bedroom featuring a paneled wall painted in a soft teal or blue-green shade. A metal-frame bed is centered against the wall, adorned with neutral-toned linens and pillows. Flanking the bed are wooden bedside tables, each topped with a woven-style sconce. A modern white pendant light hangs from the ceiling, illuminating the room. The overall design evokes a sense of calm and sophistication.

craftsman_12.jpg.title: Inviting Exterior of a Stylish Home
craftsman_12.jpg.description: This image showcases the exterior of a beautifully designed house. The house features dark gray siding with white trim around the windows, creating a striking contrast. The entryway is accentuated by stone pillars and wooden beams, giving it a rustic yet modern feel. A curved stone pathway leads to the front door, surrounded by well-maintained grass and manicured bushes. The landscaping adds to the home's curb appeal. The gray shingle roof complements the overall color scheme.

victorian_515.jpg.title: Classic Blue Bathroom with White Accents
victorian_515.jpg.description: A well-lit bathroom features a blend of classic and clean design elements. The walls are painted in a soft blue hue, complemented by white subway tile wainscoting that runs around the lower portion of the room. A white pedestal sink sits beneath a matching framed mirror, with a chrome faucet adding a touch of shine. Above the sink, a chrome towel rack holds two white towels with blue stripes. The door, painted white, is framed with simple white trim. The floor features a black and white tile pattern, adding a graphic element to the space.

craftsman_912.jpg.title: Coastal Bar with Ocean View
craftsman_912.jpg.description: A scenic outdoor bar area captures a serene coastal vibe. The foreground features a bar counter made with bamboo accents and a dark countertop, complemented by simple bar stools. A robust wooden post supports the structure, partially framing the picturesque view. Beyond the bar, a shimmering swimming pool is edged by a stone wall and leads to a charming gazebo, complete with lounging options. Lush greenery provides a touch of nature, while the backdrop is dominated by a brilliant blue sky dotted with fluffy white clouds, offering a breathtaking ocean vista.

coastal_544.jpg.title: Elegant Bathroom Vanity with Marble Countertop
coastal_544.jpg.description: This image showcases an elegant bathroom vanity with a marble countertop. The vanity is made of light wood and features sleek, minimalist drawers and cabinets with gold hardware. Above the vanity, there are two gold-framed mirrors and two sconces that provide soft, warm lighting. A small vase of pink flowers sits on the countertop, adding a touch of color and life to the space. The background is a clean white wall, enhancing the overall minimalist aesthetic.

eclectic_303.jpg.title: Eclectic Living Room with Statement Art
eclectic_303.jpg.description: A well-appointed living room showcasing an eclectic design. The focal point is a large abstract art piece in blue and white tones hanging on a textured geometric wallpapered wall. A tan leather sofa is accessorized with patterned throw pillows. An olive green velvet armchair is positioned to the left, while a round black coffee table with a brass tray and floral arrangement sits in front of the sofa. A large fiddle-leaf fig tree adds a touch of nature to the scene. A vintage-style floor lamp with a brass shade illuminates the space, and a patterned area rug grounds the setting.

mediterranean_609.jpg.title: Stylish Home Office Interior
mediterranean_609.jpg.description: A well-designed home office featuring a unique curved desk, a black bookcase, and a comfortable patterned armchair. The room is illuminated by a modern chandelier and natural light from a nearby window. The decor includes neutral tones with pops of color from the red tulips and artwork.

coastal_222.jpg.title: Coastal Style Home Office
coastal_222.jpg.description: A bright and airy home office in a coastal style, featuring a built-in desk beneath a row of windows. The desk is made of light wood, and the windows are adorned with natural woven shades. Two white upholstered swivel chairs with brass bases sit in front of the desk. The walls are covered in horizontal white shiplap, while the ceiling is painted a soft blue. Decorative license plates are mounted above the windows. A small wooden lantern and framed photos add personal touches to the space. The floor is light wood, contributing to the overall light and beachy feel.

eclectic_465.jpg.title: Elegant Living Room with Sheer Shades
eclectic_465.jpg.description: A brightly lit living room features a large window with sheer shades, allowing soft natural light to illuminate the space. The room is furnished with a blue sofa, a striped armchair, and a plush white rug, creating a serene and inviting atmosphere. Pale blue curtains frame the windows, complementing the room's light color palette. The coffered ceiling adds a touch of architectural detail.

victorian_273.jpg.title: Yellow Victorian Home with Green Accents
victorian_273.jpg.description: A two-story Victorian style home with a wraparound porch is showcased under a clear blue sky. The house is painted in a pale yellow, contrasting with the green shingles on the upper gable and the white trim outlining the structure. A smaller porch is centered on the second story, just above the main entrance. The elaborate white porch railing and decorative supports enhance the home's Victorian aesthetic. Brick steps lead up to the porch, adding a touch of rustic charm.

transitional_916.jpg.title: Luxurious Marble Shower
transitional_916.jpg.description: An elegant and spacious shower featuring marble walls, a glass door, and dual shower heads. The design incorporates decorative mosaic tiles in the center and is framed by white cabinetry on either side.

southwestern_132.jpg.title: Elegant Double Sink Bathroom Vanity
southwestern_132.jpg.description: This image showcases an elegant bathroom featuring a double sink vanity. The vanity boasts a brown wooden cabinet and a light-colored countertop with two sinks. Above each sink, there is a decorative mirror with a unique white frame. Sconces provide warm lighting above the mirrors, and decorative wall sconces add to the ambiance. A tall vase with decorative branches stands between the sinks. The overall color palette includes brown, beige, and white, creating a warm and inviting atmosphere.

asian_468.jpg.title: Elegant Bathroom Vanity with Natural Wood Finish
asian_468.jpg.description: A bathroom featuring a double vanity with a light-colored natural wood finish. The vanity has two sinks and ample storage space with drawers and cabinets. Above the vanity are two mirrors with decorative frames and matching light fixtures. A tall wooden cabinet is positioned between the mirrors. A framed picture hangs on the wall above a towel rack. A toilet is visible on the right side of the image, and the floor is a combination of wood and patterned tile.

mediterranean_147.jpg.title: Warm and Inviting Bedroom Design
mediterranean_147.jpg.description: A stylish bedroom featuring a grey upholstered bed with white linens and patterned pillows, complemented by a copper-colored throw blanket. The room includes matching bedside tables with white lamps, a red leather bench at the foot of the bed, and a window with dark frames and brown curtains. A light grey rug anchors the space, and the walls are painted in a soft neutral tone, creating a warm and inviting atmosphere.

traditional_203.jpg.title: Spice Drawer Organization
traditional_203.jpg.description: A well-organized kitchen showcasing two wooden drawers. The top drawer is filled with spices in various jars and containers, neatly arranged for easy access. The lower drawer holds a collection of hot sauce bottles of different shapes and sizes. The drawers are integrated into wooden cabinetry, and a white countertop is visible above. A stainless steel oven is partially visible on the left, and the floor appears to be made of wood, contributing to the overall warm and functional design of the kitchen.

shabby-chic-style_535.jpg.title: Charming Farmhouse Screened Porch
shabby-chic-style_535.jpg.description: A bright, airy screened porch featuring a rustic wooden dining table paired with modern black metal chairs. The space includes a turquoise French door, white beadboard ceiling with ceiling fan, and decorative outdoor lantern. A console table with floral arrangement adds a decorative touch.

mid-century-modern_243.jpg.title: Modern Living Room with Marble Fireplace
mid-century-modern_243.jpg.description: Elegant contemporary living room featuring a marble fireplace with lit flames, centered beneath a circular decorative mirror. The space includes coffered ceilings, dark hardwood floors, and large windows. A cowhide rug anchors modern chrome-and-leather seating.

farmhouse_588.jpg.title: Modern Coastal Bathroom Renovation
farmhouse_588.jpg.description: A bright, airy bathroom featuring a freestanding tub, custom wood vanity with marble countertop, and woven rattan pendant light. The space combines natural materials with modern fixtures, highlighted by white shiplap walls and dark slate flooring. A blue patterned runner adds a decorative touch while black-framed windows and mirrors create architectural interest.

asian_440.jpg.title: Luxurious Zen Bedroom with Asian Wall Art
asian_440.jpg.description: A sophisticated bedroom featuring an expansive decorative Asian wall mural or screen with nature motifs. The space combines modern comfort with traditional Eastern aesthetics. Natural light streams in through a window, creating dramatic lighting. The bed is adorned with plush neutral bedding and multiple pillows.

asian_326.jpg.title: Modern Garden Walkway Between Houses
asian_326.jpg.description: A narrow walkway between two structures featuring a grey house and a wooden fence/structure. The path is lined with lush greenery and landscaping elements. The space demonstrates clever use of a narrow side yard with natural elements.

tropical_283.jpg.title: Luxury Spa-Style Bathroom with Living Wall
tropical_283.jpg.description: A dramatic dark bathroom featuring a vertical garden wall system with live plants. The space includes a modern walk-in shower with glass enclosure and stone flooring. Dark textured walls contrast with natural elements and bright chrome fixtures. A robe hangs artistically on the wall, and floating shelves display spa accessories.

modern_488.jpg.title: Modern Scandinavian Kitchen with Wood Cabinetry
modern_488.jpg.description: Contemporary kitchen featuring warm wood cabinetry, marble backsplash, and modern black lighting fixture. The space showcases a minimalist design with clean lines, integrated appliances, and a contrasting color palette of warm woods and cool whites. A decorative knit bowl adds texture to the sleek dining surface.

contemporary_184.jpg.title: Modern Spa-Like Bathroom with Freestanding Tub
contemporary_184.jpg.description: A contemporary bathroom featuring a freestanding soaking tub and walk-in shower with seafoam green subway tile. The space includes built-in shelving, plantation shutters, and modern fixtures with a clean, minimalist aesthetic.

modern_1002.jpg.title: Modern Minimalist Bathroom with Walk-in Shower
modern_1002.jpg.description: Contemporary bathroom featuring a spacious walk-in shower with glass partition and a built-in soaking tub. The space is brightened by a large window overlooking greenery. The bathroom combines sleek fixtures with a monochromatic color scheme and clean lines.

mid-century-modern_525.jpg.title: Modern Kitchen with Island and Runner Rugs
mid-century-modern_525.jpg.description: Contemporary kitchen featuring warm wood cabinetry and a central island with bar seating. The space includes recessed lighting, hardwood flooring, and decorative runner rugs. A large window provides natural light and outdoor views. The kitchen combines functionality with modern aesthetics.

mediterranean_621.jpg.title: Modern Moroccan Powder Room
mediterranean_621.jpg.description: A stylish powder room featuring a striking black and white patterned tile backsplash with quatrefoil motifs. The space includes a white vessel sink mounted on a light wood counter, topped with an ornate white framed mirror and modern brass pendant lighting.

shabby-chic-style_247.jpg.title: Modern Bohemian Kitchen with Emerald Hexagon Tiles
shabby-chic-style_247.jpg.description: A contemporary kitchen featuring striking emerald green hexagonal backsplash tiles, white countertops, and wooden floating shelves. The space includes hanging cookware storage and decorative elements like a sunburst mirror and potted plants. The design combines modern functionality with bohemian accents.

victorian_529.jpg.title: Gothic Victorian Canopy Bedroom
victorian_529.jpg.description: A dramatic Victorian-style bedroom featuring an ornate black canopy bed with gothic architectural details. The bed has tufted upholstery and elaborate bedding with ruffled details. Gothic-inspired furnishings include black upholstered benches at the foot of the bed. The room features dark wood trim, wall sconces, and framed artwork against white walls.

coastal_578.jpg.title: Modern Mudroom with Stacked Laundry
coastal_578.jpg.description: A well-organized mudroom featuring a stacked washer and dryer unit, built-in white storage cubbies, and slate tile flooring. The space includes shiplap walls painted white, a wooden bench, and custom storage solutions.

mediterranean_635.jpg.title: Ornate Garden Gate with Wrought Iron Detail
mediterranean_635.jpg.description: An elegant arched garden gate made of solid wood with vertical planks and topped with decorative wrought iron scrollwork. The gate features a dark finish, curved archway, and is set within a white stone or stucco wall frame. Green foliage surrounds the top of the gate, creating a natural canopy.

traditional_571.jpg.title: Modern Master Bathroom Remodel
traditional_571.jpg.description: A contemporary bathroom featuring a spacious walk-in shower with glass enclosure and stone tile walls. The space includes a double vanity with light countertops and a separate soaking tub beneath windows providing natural light. The ceiling features white beadboard paneling.

asian_332.jpg.title: Zen Meditation Room with Yin-Yang Floor
asian_332.jpg.description: A serene meditation space featuring a wooden floor with an inlaid yin-yang symbol. The room has large windows and glass panels allowing natural light and garden views. Decorative stained glass panels with tree motifs adorn the upper walls and doors. The space combines natural materials with Asian-inspired design elements.

tropical_297.jpg.title: Modern Kitchen with Portrait Art
tropical_297.jpg.description: Contemporary kitchen featuring a striking black and white portrait on the wall, floating glass pendant lights, and a minimalist design. The space combines warm wood cabinetry with white countertops and black accents. A bar-height counter with modern bar stools creates an elegant dining area.

contemporary_190.jpg.title: Modern Grey and White Bathroom Renovation
contemporary_190.jpg.description: A contemporary bathroom featuring a sleek glass shower enclosure with stacked stone accent wall. The space includes modern fixtures, a floating wood vanity, and stylish ceiling lighting. The design incorporates a monochromatic color scheme with textural elements and clean lines.

asian_454.jpg.title: Elegant Garden Entry Gates with Lanterns
asian_454.jpg.description: A sophisticated garden entrance featuring decorative metal gates with leaf cutout patterns. Stone pillars topped with glowing lanterns flank the entrance. A small pond or water feature with lily pads is visible in the foreground. The gates are framed by natural greenery and landscaping elements.

mediterranean_153.jpg.title: Modern Coastal Open-Concept Living Space
mediterranean_153.jpg.description: An elegant open-concept living room that seamlessly connects to the kitchen and outdoor space through large sliding glass doors. The room features exposed wooden beams, recessed lighting, and a sophisticated transitional design scheme. The indoor-outdoor flow is enhanced by the garden view visible through the doors.

traditional_217.jpg.title: Modern Farmhouse Kitchen with Vaulted Ceiling
traditional_217.jpg.description: Luxurious open-concept kitchen featuring a vaulted ceiling with exposed beams, large marble island, brass geometric pendant lights, and custom white cabinetry. The space showcases a marble backsplash, professional-grade appliances, and contemporary bar seating.

eclectic_459.jpg.title: Colorful Cottage Kitchen with Floral Wallpaper
eclectic_459.jpg.description: A charming kitchen featuring a farmhouse sink beneath a sage green window frame. The space showcases vibrant floral wallpaper in peach and white, with open wooden shelving displaying colorful ceramic dishes and pottery. Dark navy cabinets contrast with light countertops and brass hardware.

shabby-chic-style_521.jpg.title: Cozy Reading Nook with Built-in Bookshelves
shabby-chic-style_521.jpg.description: A charming reading corner featuring floor-to-ceiling built-in white bookshelves, a comfortable window seat with storage drawers, and a tufted lime green ottoman. The space includes natural light from a window dressed with a neutral roman shade, decorative plants atop the shelving, and a plush wingback chair. The room has a carpeted floor and wood-paneled walls.

mid-century-modern_257.jpg.title: Modern Scandinavian Bedroom Design
mid-century-modern_257.jpg.description: Serene bedroom featuring a light upholstered platform bed with crisp white and gray bedding. Two wooden benches with upholstered seats sit at the foot of the bed. The room includes modern lighting and natural wood accents, with minimalist decor and clean lines throughout.

transitional_719.jpg.title: Modern White Subway Tile Bathroom
transitional_719.jpg.description: A clean, contemporary bathroom installation featuring classic white subway tile walls with dark grout. The shower-tub combination includes a built-in niche with coral-colored penny tile accent. Chrome fixtures include a shower head and tub controls. The installation demonstrates precise tilework with even spacing and professional finishing.

industrial_259.jpg.title: Industrial Chic Kitchen
industrial_259.jpg.description: This image showcases an industrial-style kitchen with exposed brick walls and large windows. A central island with a dark countertop serves as a focal point, complemented by a rustic wooden dining table. The lighting is provided by a multi-bulb chandelier, adding a modern touch to the raw industrial aesthetic. The kitchen also features dark cabinets, metal shelving, and a ladder for accessing upper storage.

french-country_358.jpg.title: Bright and Functional Kitchen Interior
french-country_358.jpg.description: This image shows a well-lit and functional kitchen with white cabinetry, stainless steel appliances, and a warm, inviting atmosphere. The kitchen features ample countertop space, a gas range with an overhead microwave, and a corner sink. The flooring is a warm wood tone, and a textured rug adds a cozy touch. Roman shades adorn the windows, providing natural light.  The overall design is clean and modern with traditional elements.

scandinavian_438.jpg.title: Modern Kitchen with Natural Elements
scandinavian_438.jpg.description: A well-lit, contemporary kitchen features warm wood cabinetry and open shelving adorned with various potted plants. A woman in a dress stands at the sink while a young girl sits on the countertop next to the stove. The island features a white countertop with wood cabinetry and a black barstool. The floor is a dark grey herringbone pattern, and the walls are white, creating a bright and airy space.

modern_311.jpg.title: Outdoor Dining Space with Brick Feature
modern_311.jpg.description: This image showcases a sophisticated outdoor dining area featuring a circular table surrounded by wicker chairs. The focal point is a brick wall adorned with sconce lighting and a decorative candelabra. Green plants and a structured hedge behind the wall add a touch of nature. The setting is enclosed by light brick buildings, creating a sense of privacy and elegance.

farmhouse_577.jpg.title: Elegant White Bathroom with Shiplap Walls
farmhouse_577.jpg.description: A bright and elegant bathroom features white shiplap walls and light wood-look tile flooring. A freestanding white bathtub sits beneath a window, and a glass-enclosed shower is visible to the left. A geometric pendant light hangs from the white plank ceiling, which also features exposed wooden beams. A white vanity with drawers and cabinets is seen on the right. The overall design is clean and sophisticated, with a touch of rustic charm.

southwestern_683.jpg.title: Mediterranean Garden Design
southwestern_683.jpg.description: This image showcases a beautifully landscaped Mediterranean-style garden. A single-story house with a terracotta tile roof and textured walls serves as a backdrop. The garden features a diverse array of plants including bright yellow and red flowering shrubs, various green shrubs, and grasses, all arranged in a naturalistic style. A low stone retaining wall adds a rustic touch, while stone steps lead up to the house. The overall effect is lush, colorful, and inviting, reflecting the characteristic aesthetic of Mediterranean garden design.

contemporary_71.jpg.title: Modern Bathroom Design
contemporary_71.jpg.description: This is a bright and modern bathroom featuring a combination of natural wood and gold accents. The floor is tiled with a geometric pattern in black and gold. A wooden vanity with gold handles and two sinks sits against the wall, topped with two gold-framed mirrors. A toilet is placed next to the bathtub, which is enclosed with a glass shower door decorated with gold diamond shapes. The walls are painted white, and a skylight provides natural light. Gold fixtures and accessories are used throughout the space, and there are plants and flowers adding a touch of life.

mediterranean_806.jpg.title: Elegant Kitchen with Island
mediterranean_806.jpg.description: A beautifully designed kitchen featuring dark wood cabinetry, a cream-colored island with a uniquely patterned granite countertop, and ornate hanging light fixtures. The kitchen also includes a high-end range with a decorative backsplash and a custom range hood.

modern_28.jpg.title: Murphy Bed with Storage Cabinets
modern_28.jpg.description: A modern bedroom scene featuring a Murphy bed cleverly integrated into a wall unit flanked by matching storage cabinets. The floor is covered with a geometrically patterned off-white and brown rug. A small dog stands on the rug. Part of a chair is visible in the foreground. Natural light streams in from a nearby window, illuminating the room.

craftsman_709.jpg.title: Charming Shingle-Style Home Exterior
craftsman_709.jpg.description: The image showcases a charming shingle-style home exterior bathed in the soft light of either sunrise or sunset. The house features a steeply pitched gable roof covered in weathered gray shingles, a hallmark of the Shingle style. Two double-hung windows with white trim are symmetrically placed beneath the gable peak. A small, square vent is centered at the gable apex. Below the roofline, a wide, white-painted frieze board provides a clean contrast to the shingles. The front porch is supported by white Doric columns and is clad in shingles, matching the house. A brick walkway leads to the porch entrance, creating a warm, inviting approach. Landscaping includes neatly trimmed shrubs and a well-maintained lawn. A glimpse of a dark-colored bench is visible on the porch. Overall, the home exudes a sense of classic American architecture with a touch of rustic elegance.

mediterranean_812.jpg.title: Modern Bathroom Interior with Wood Accents
mediterranean_812.jpg.description: This image showcases a modern bathroom with a warm and inviting atmosphere. The space features light wood flooring and cabinetry, creating a sense of natural elegance. An arched doorway leads to another room, adding architectural interest. The bathroom boasts a spacious walk-in shower with a built-in bench and a minimalist design. A vanity with a light countertop and brass fixtures complements the overall aesthetic. The color palette is dominated by neutral tones, enhancing the serene ambiance of the room.

mediterranean_18.jpg.title: Elegant Courtyard Entrance
mediterranean_18.jpg.description: A beautifully designed courtyard entrance featuring a herringbone brick pathway leading to an arched doorway. Flanking the pathway are lush green hedges, vibrant purple flowering plants, and slender cypress trees. Small fountains add a touch of elegance to the space, while a decorative lantern illuminates the brick wall. The overall scene exudes a sense of tranquility and charm.

contemporary_65.jpg.title: Modern Bathroom with Glass Shower and Floating Vanity
contemporary_65.jpg.description: This is a bright and modern bathroom featuring a glass-enclosed shower, a long floating vanity, and sleek white tile. The shower has a clear glass partition and a niche for storage. The vanity has a light wood finish, marble countertop, and an open shelf below for towel storage. A large mirror hangs above the vanity, reflecting natural light from the window. White towels and a vase of white flowers add to the clean and minimalist aesthetic.

modern_463.jpg.title: Modern Bathroom with Vertical Tiles and Copper Accents
modern_463.jpg.description: This image showcases a modern bathroom featuring a walk-in shower with vertically stacked light gray tiles. Copper-colored fixtures, including the shower head and a towel rack, add a touch of warmth and sophistication. A small wooden side table holds toiletries, while a minimalist toilet sits next to a light wood vanity with a stone countertop. The room is well-lit with natural light streaming through a window above the shower. A vase with greenery and a framed artwork add decorative elements to the space.

modern_305.jpg.title: Whimsical Bathroom Design with Monkey Wallpaper
modern_305.jpg.description: A bathroom featuring a rectangular white basin set on a dark countertop. The walls are adorned with playful monkey-themed wallpaper in black and white. Brass-finished light fixtures extend from the wall, flanking a decorative mirror with a thick frame. The room also features chrome faucets and a small vase with white orchids.

contemporary_609.jpg.title: Bathroom with Whale Art
contemporary_609.jpg.description: A bathroom featuring a white toilet with a yellow object on top of the tank, set against a backdrop of white subway tiles covering the lower half of the walls. Above the toilet hangs a framed print of whales, and a toilet paper holder is mounted on the right wall. The overall aesthetic is clean and simple.

farmhouse_563.jpg.title: Modern Monochrome Master Bedroom with Fireplace
farmhouse_563.jpg.description: Luxurious master bedroom featuring a dramatic black shiplap fireplace wall, vaulted ceiling with chandelier, and large windows with natural light. The room combines modern and transitional elements with clean lines and comfortable textures.

rustic_329.jpg.title: Elegant French Country Bathroom Design
rustic_329.jpg.description: A luxurious bathroom featuring a walk-in shower with custom tiled diamond pattern walls, matching geometric floor tiles in a checkerboard pattern, and an ornate wooden vanity with a dark stone countertop. The space includes an arched mirror with wooden trim and wall-mounted sconce lighting.

mid-century-modern_38.jpg.title: Modern Mid-Century Bathroom Renovation
mid-century-modern_38.jpg.description: A bright, clean bathroom featuring a custom wooden double vanity with white countertops and brass fixtures. The space includes white subway tile walls with a blue accent stripe, terrazzo-style flooring, and large windows providing natural light. Modern sconce lighting fixtures complement the curved-edge mirrors above the vanity.

industrial_265.jpg.title: Cozy Bistro-Style Sunroom
industrial_265.jpg.description: A charming sunlit breakfast nook with industrial-style framed glass dividers. The space features patterned tile flooring, open shelving with cookware, and a bistro-style dining setup. Plants and natural light create a welcoming atmosphere, while vintage-inspired lighting adds character.

french-country_364.jpg.title: Traditional Living Room with Blue Buffalo Check
french-country_364.jpg.description: A formal living room featuring classic furniture arrangements with blue and white buffalo check upholstery. The room includes tall windows with natural light, a prominent wooden china cabinet, and a green painted dresser with ornate mirror. The space is decorated in a traditional style with a sophisticated area rug.

contemporary_621.jpg.title: Modern Urban Terrace Lounge
contemporary_621.jpg.description: A luxurious outdoor terrace featuring a contemporary daybed with plush gray cushions, surrounded by elegant olive trees in large white planters and boxwood hedging in modern gray planters. The space includes wooden decking and decorative lanterns, creating a serene urban oasis.

tropical_526.jpg.title: Tropical Bedroom Corner with Rattan Chair
tropical_526.jpg.description: A cozy bedroom corner featuring a rattan campaign-style chair with cream cushioning next to a bed with paisley-patterned turquoise bedding. The scene includes dark wood furniture and natural light coming through windows.

victorian_298.jpg.title: Modern White Bathroom with Glass Shower
victorian_298.jpg.description: A contemporary bathroom featuring a spacious glass-enclosed shower alongside a modern soaking tub. The space is finished with vertical white subway tile walls and dark flooring. The bathroom combines functionality with clean, minimalist design elements.

mid-century-modern_280.jpg.title: Modern Kitchen with Chevron Tile and Natural Light
mid-century-modern_280.jpg.description: Contemporary kitchen featuring seafoam green chevron tile backsplash, wooden floating shelves, and warm wood cabinetry. Large window provides natural lighting with garden views. White marble or quartz countertops complement the design. Modern pendant lights and pot filler add functional elegance.

mediterranean_184.jpg.title: Coastal Modern Dining Room with Rattan Chairs
mediterranean_184.jpg.description: A bright, airy dining room featuring large black-framed windows, spherical pendant lights, and natural rattan dining chairs. The space includes a light wood dining table, coastal artwork, and white walls creating an open, inviting atmosphere.

rustic_301.jpg.title: Modern Mountain Living Room with Stone Fireplace
rustic_301.jpg.description: Luxurious contemporary living room featuring a floor-to-ceiling stone fireplace, wooden beam ceiling, and open floor plan. The space combines natural materials with modern design elements, including pendant lighting and custom artwork. The room showcases a comfortable seating area with clean-lined furniture and large windows providing natural light.

transitional_725.jpg.title: Traditional Entryway with Curved Staircase
transitional_725.jpg.description: An elegant entryway featuring a traditional wooden staircase with white balusters and dark wood handrail. The space is anchored by a round olive green ottoman and decorated with indoor plants. A black cat sits on the stairs, and there's a distinctive arched doorway with decorative wallpaper visible in the background.

rustic_467.jpg.title: Modern Rustic Attic Bedroom
rustic_467.jpg.description: A symmetrical attic bedroom featuring twin beds under sloped walls with black shiplap paneling. The room is anchored by an antler chandelier and centered window with wooden bench storage. Plush bedding in grey tones complements the dark walls, while sheepskin rugs add softness to the plaid carpet.

craftsman_721.jpg.title: Built-in Home Office Desk Nook
craftsman_721.jpg.description: A custom built-in desk area featuring white beadboard wainscoting, upper cabinets with glass knobs, and a butcher block wooden desktop surface. The workspace includes a black leather desk pad and a vintage-style adjustable brass task lamp. The design combines functionality with classic architectural details.

tropical_240.jpg.title: Tropical Modern Dining Room
tropical_240.jpg.description: A contemporary dining space featuring a live-edge wooden dining table paired with woven rattan chairs. The room is adorned with lush tropical plants including a prominent monstera deliciosa. A woven pendant light fixture hangs above, and there's colorful artwork on the white walls. The space combines natural materials with modern design elements.

mediterranean_30.jpg.title: Rustic Modern Kitchen with Hexagonal Terracotta Flooring
mediterranean_30.jpg.description: A spacious kitchen featuring a custom wooden island with open storage, white cabinetry, and distinctive hexagonal terracotta floor tiles. The room includes a tall white armoire and built-in cabinets with brass hardware. Decorative baskets sit atop the armoire, and a bowl of fresh produce adorns the island's dark countertop.

scandinavian_362.jpg.title: Modern Art Studio with Wood Ceiling
scandinavian_362.jpg.description: A bright, spacious art studio featuring a natural pine wood ceiling, concrete floors, and abundant natural light from windows and skylights. The space includes mobile work surfaces and art display areas with colorful abstract artwork on display. The room has a clean, minimalist aesthetic with strategic placement of plants for organic touches.

french-country_402.jpg.title: Cozy Traditional Living Room with Built-in Shelving
french-country_402.jpg.description: Elegant living room featuring a lit fireplace with limestone surround, built-in arched bookshelf with storage below, and comfortable upholstered seating. The space is decorated with ceramic accessories, plants, and a striking sunburst mirror. A traditional area rug anchors the space, while rustic wooden stools add character.

southwestern_867.jpg.title: Modern Living Room with Wall-Mounted TV
southwestern_867.jpg.description: Contemporary living room featuring a wall-mounted flat-screen TV above a modern fireplace. The space includes built-in shelving with decorative items, a cozy seating arrangement with red/orange armchairs, and a large storage ottoman. The room is decorated with a geometric pattern area rug and personal items on floating shelves.

industrial_503.jpg.title: Modern Garage Loft with Luxury Car
industrial_503.jpg.description: A contemporary garage space featuring a white Chevrolet Corvette and a custom loft area. The space has a minimalist industrial design with a wooden mezzanine level supported by posts. The garage features clean lines, grey walls, and professional lighting fixtures.

tropical_254.jpg.title: Coastal Bedroom with Tropical Accent
tropical_254.jpg.description: A bright, airy bedroom featuring white shiplap walls and ceiling, with a large tropical leaf art print above the bed. The room includes a white four-poster bed dressed in crisp white linens with light blue accents. Matching white nightstands flank the bed, topped with identical table lamps. A window with natural light adds warmth to the space.

farmhouse_239.jpg.title: Modern Minimalist Media Room
farmhouse_239.jpg.description: A clean, minimalist media room featuring a wall-mounted flat screen TV on a raised platform area. The room has white walls, light wood flooring, and a striking black barn door. A modern black ceiling fan provides ventilation. The space showcases architectural details including white beam work and paneled ceiling.

craftsman_6.jpg.title: Modern White Laundry Room with Black Countertops
craftsman_6.jpg.description: A well-organized laundry room featuring white shaker-style cabinetry, black granite or quartz countertops, and a central window. The space includes built-in storage solutions and laundry appliances arranged in a galley-style layout. Gray wood-look flooring complements the clean, modern aesthetic.

mediterranean_24.jpg.title: Luxurious Covered Patio Dining Space
mediterranean_24.jpg.description: An elegant outdoor living space featuring a covered porch with white classical columns and arches. The space is furnished with a round teak dining table and modern woven chairs. Two orb-style chandeliers hang from a coffered ceiling. The seating area includes plush cushions in gray and blue tones. Fresh citrus fruits are displayed as a centerpiece.

contemporary_153.jpg.title: Illuminated Multi-Level Deck with Fire Pit
contemporary_153.jpg.description: A beautifully designed outdoor deck space featuring multiple levels with built-in lighting. The deck wraps around a mature tree and includes a modern fire pit, built-in planters with flowers, and comfortable outdoor seating. The space is warmly lit with uplighting on the tree and integrated deck lighting, creating an inviting evening atmosphere.

scandinavian_376.jpg.title: Modern Boho Living Room with Leather Sectional
scandinavian_376.jpg.description: A bright living room featuring a tan leather sectional sofa, plantation shutters, and modern boho decor elements. The space is anchored by a hanging rattan chair and complemented by a fiddle leaf fig plant in the corner. The room demonstrates a blend of natural materials and modern design sensibilities.

southwestern_873.jpg.title: Contemporary Light Wood Kitchen with Black Countertops
southwestern_873.jpg.description: Elegant galley-style kitchen featuring light wood cabinetry with glass-front upper cabinets and black granite countertops. The space includes modern stainless steel appliances, recessed lighting, and cream-colored tile flooring. A cozy seating nook with coral-colored cushions is visible in the corner.

french-country_416.jpg.title: Luxury Kitchen with Marble Backsplash
french-country_416.jpg.description: Modern kitchen detail featuring a dramatic marble backsplash with natural veining patterns. The cabinetry is painted in a sophisticated sage green with brass hardware. A built-in gas cooktop is visible along with under-cabinet lighting highlighting the stone work.

industrial_517.jpg.title: Stylish Kitchen with Wood Accents and Island
industrial_517.jpg.description: This image showcases a modern kitchen design with a blend of wood and gray tones. A custom-built wooden shelving unit is integrated into a wood-paneled wall, displaying books and decorative items. The kitchen features gray cabinetry, a stainless steel range hood, and a contrasting butcher block island with black metal framing. The island has open shelving and caster wheels. The backdrop includes white-tiled walls and white upper cabinets with glass doors, enhancing the bright and airy feel of the space.

rustic_473.jpg.title: Modern A-Frame Cabin Exterior
rustic_473.jpg.description: This image features a striking, modern A-frame cabin nestled amongst tall pine trees. The cabin boasts a dramatic, steeply angled roof and a large, multi-paned glass facade that allows for ample natural light. Below the large triangle of windows, there is a horizontal section with more windows and a set of stairs leading to the entrance. The exterior is finished with a combination of natural wood and black framing. In front of the cabin, there is a row of white Adirondack chairs and small red side tables, providing a cozy seating area. The ground is covered with bark mulch, adding to the natural aesthetic of the cabin.

modern_14.jpg.title: Modern Bathroom with Freestanding Tub
modern_14.jpg.description: This image showcases a modern bathroom leading into a bedroom. The bathroom features a freestanding white tub, gray tile wainscoting, and abstract art. The bedroom is visible through a doorway, showing a bed with blue linens and a wood accent wall. The flooring throughout appears to be concrete or a similar material, adding to the modern aesthetic.

shabby-chic-style_284.jpg.title: Elegant Living Room with White Furniture and Lavender Accents
shabby-chic-style_284.jpg.description: A bright and airy living room features two white armchairs accented with lavender pillows in varying patterns. One chair has a solid lavender pillow, while the other showcases a floral pattern with a contrasting trim. A striped lumbar pillow complements the floral cushion. A round side table holds a pot of greenery, adding a touch of nature. In the background, a sideboard is adorned with decorative objects, including a striking purple vase. The room is lit by natural light filtering through sheer curtains.

craftsman_735.jpg.title: Cozy Interior Stairway
craftsman_735.jpg.description: An interior shot showcases a staircase and a hallway leading into a living space. The staircase features wooden steps and white risers, with a white banister and a paneled wall along the side. The hallway has hardwood flooring, and a half wall separates it from the adjacent room, providing an open feel while maintaining some separation. The room beyond the hallway includes a table with a decorative arrangement, a window that lets in natural light, and a glimpse of a patterned armchair. The walls are painted in a light color palette, with white trim and accents.

mid-century-modern_294.jpg.title: Modern Laundry Room
mid-century-modern_294.jpg.description: A well-lit, modern laundry room features a front-loading washing machine and dryer set, dark countertops, and warm-toned wooden cabinetry. A window above the sink offers a view of the outside, and a decorative vase with branches adds a touch of nature to the space.

transitional_731.jpg.title: Stylish Kitchen Design
transitional_731.jpg.description: A bright, stylish kitchen featuring white cabinetry, a farmhouse sink, and a unique green and white patterned backsplash. Wooden shelves provide open storage, and wicker pendant lights add a touch of natural texture. A stainless steel Wolf range completes the modern yet inviting design.

rustic_315.jpg.title: Cozy Lodge Bedroom
rustic_315.jpg.description: A cozy bedroom designed in a lodge style. The walls and cabinetry are painted in a deep, dark green. Two twin beds are pushed together, decorated with gray and white patterned blankets and pillows. Black and white photographs adorn the wall above the beds. A wooden cabinet sits to the left of the beds, holding books and decorative items. The room has a rustic yet stylish atmosphere.

asian_497.jpg.title: Lush Modern Garden and Home Exterior
asian_497.jpg.description: A bright, daytime shot showcasing a well-maintained modern garden and the exterior of a contemporary home. The foreground features a perfectly manicured lawn, leading to a landscaped area with various plants, trees, and decorative elements like dark planters. A paved pathway stretches into the garden, suggesting a walking route. The side of the house is visible, featuring large windows with light-colored curtains and a contrasting exterior finish, possibly stone or brick, with a dark trim. The overall composition is aesthetically pleasing, highlighting the integration of modern architecture with natural landscaping. The sky is clear with soft light, contributing to a calm and inviting atmosphere.

industrial_271.jpg.title: Cozy Bedroom with Patchwork Quilt
industrial_271.jpg.description: A comfortably arranged bedroom features a bed dressed with a patchwork quilt in shades of blue, grey, and white. The quilt includes various patterns and emblems, possibly sports team logos. The bed is flanked by a grey skirt and topped with pillows in complementary patterns and colors, including plaid and a decorative pillow with an embroidered design. Two black and white framed pictures are displayed on the wall above the bed, which is painted in a soft grey. A dark grey accent wall is visible behind the bed, decorated with a motivational poster. To the right, curtains in a muted blue-grey drape partially over a window with blinds. A wooden desk and chair are located to the left, adding to the functional aspects of the room. A ceiling fan with a light fixture is installed above, providing both ventilation and illumination.

scandinavian_410.jpg.title: Bright Modern Stairway
scandinavian_410.jpg.description: A bright and airy interior showcases a modern stairway with wooden steps and glass railings, bathed in natural light streaming through a nearby window. The clean lines of the staircase contrast with the natural wood textures, creating a visually appealing focal point. The hallway features light-colored walls and wooden floors, complemented by minimalist furniture such as a wooden bench and a table with a decorative vase. Modern track lighting illuminates the space, adding to the contemporary aesthetic.

french-country_370.jpg.title: Elegant Living Room with Fireplace and Chandeliers
french-country_370.jpg.description: A spacious and elegant living room features a stone fireplace flanked by dark gray built-in cabinets with glass doors. Above the fireplace, a flat-screen TV is mounted on the stone. Two ornate chandeliers hang from the ceiling, illuminating the hardwood floors. Recessed lighting is also present. A wrought iron railing is visible in the background, separating the living area from another space. The room has a neutral color palette with stone, wood, and gray accents.

modern_339.jpg.title: Modern Dining Room with Large Painting
modern_339.jpg.description: This image showcases a modern dining room featuring a large, abstract painting on the left wall that introduces a colorful element to the otherwise neutral space. The room is furnished with a wooden dining table, surrounded by six wooden chairs with blue leather seats. A modern, statement chandelier hangs above the table, providing a focal point. Recessed lighting is used throughout the room. In the background, a series of framed pictures are displayed on the wall above a blue cabinet. The room opens to an outdoor patio through large sliding glass doors, offering a view of the garden and natural light. The color palette is dominated by neutral tones, with pops of blue, brown, and natural greens from the outdoor view. The overall design is clean, minimalist, and contemporary, emphasizing natural light and open space.

contemporary_635.jpg.title: Luxurious Bathroom with Shower and Tub
contemporary_635.jpg.description: This image showcases a luxurious bathroom design, featuring a glass-enclosed shower with multiple showerheads and body jets, juxtaposed with a modern bathtub. The shower area is tiled with contrasting dark and light tones, creating a sophisticated look. The adjacent bathtub is surrounded by a marble or similar stone countertop, equipped with sleek faucets and holding various bath products. A built-in shelving unit in the shower adds functionality and aesthetic appeal.

tropical_532.jpg.title: Coastal Bedroom with Dark Wood Accents
tropical_532.jpg.description: This is a spacious bedroom with a coastal theme, featuring a dark wood ceiling with exposed beams and a unique pendant light fixture. The walls are painted in a light, neutral color. The bed is centered with two white nightstands, each topped with a lamp. The bed is dressed with blue and white patterned pillows and a blue throw. In front of the bed are two woven stools on top of a patterned rug. The room has openings on either side of the bed, and a dark sliding door to the right. A window above the bed allows light to pass through from another room.

contemporary_972.jpg.title: Elegant High-Rise Office Space
contemporary_972.jpg.description: A stylish and modern home office in a high-rise apartment, featuring a large window with a city view, built-in shelving and cabinetry, a round glass coffee table, and a comfortable workspace. The room is decorated with a mix of textures and colors, creating a sophisticated and inviting atmosphere.

coastal_342.jpg.title: Coastal Modern Kitchen Island Seating
coastal_342.jpg.description: Modern kitchen island setup featuring woven rattan pendant lights and upholstered counter stools. The space showcases a white quartz waterfall countertop with brown textured barstools against a bright, airy backdrop. Custom cabinetry and decorative glass vessels complete the coastal-inspired design.

eclectic_505.jpg.title: Pink Modern Farmhouse Kitchen
eclectic_505.jpg.description: A feminine kitchen design featuring custom pink cabinetry with brass hardware, white marble countertops, and glass-fronted upper cabinets. The space includes a modern gooseneck faucet, decorative flowers, and a vintage-style mirror display on the counter. Natural light streams through the window above the sink.

mediterranean_769.jpg.title: Rustic Southwest Living Room
mediterranean_769.jpg.description: A cozy living room featuring exposed wooden ceiling beams and large windows offering scenic views. The space includes a corner fireplace, built-in entertainment center with bookshelves, and comfortable seating arranged around a decorative trunk serving as a coffee table.

craftsman_872.jpg.title: Modern Mudroom with Built-in Storage
craftsman_872.jpg.description: A well-organized mudroom entry featuring custom white built-in storage with coat hooks, open shelving, and a dark wood bench seat. The space transitions to an adjacent room with slate grey flooring and a dark accent wall.

coastal_424.jpg.title: Modern Attic Living Space
coastal_424.jpg.description: A cozy attic living room featuring sloped white wooden plank ceiling, an arched window with navy accent wall, grey sectional sofa, wooden storage chest as coffee table, and two brown leather Moroccan poufs on a neutral area rug. The space includes greenery and a small display cabinet.

southwestern_734.jpg.title: Southwestern Living Room with Kiva Fireplace
southwestern_734.jpg.description: A bright, airy living room featuring a traditional adobe-style kiva fireplace, exposed wooden beam ceiling, and large picture window overlooking greenery. The space combines contemporary furniture with southwestern architectural elements.

industrial_488.jpg.title: Modern Living Room with Orbital Wall Art
industrial_488.jpg.description: A contemporary living room featuring dramatic high windows and distinctive circular orange wall art installations. The space combines modern furniture with artistic elements, set against white walls and natural light. The room includes a plush area rug and strategically placed lighting.

french-country_589.jpg.title: Luxury Mediterranean Living Room with Exposed Beams
french-country_589.jpg.description: Elegant living room featuring dramatic exposed wooden beam ceiling in a cathedral style. The space includes a stone fireplace with built-in TV above, comfortable upholstered seating, and an ornate console table. Natural light streams through large windows, offering views of the outdoors. The room combines rustic and luxurious elements with high-end finishes.

southwestern_720.jpg.title: Elegant Spanish Colonial Entryway
southwestern_720.jpg.description: A beautifully designed exterior entryway featuring a wooden door framed by ornate lantern-style sconces. The entrance is accented by symmetrical potted plants including ornamental grasses and white flowers. Desert landscaping with agave plants complements the stucco exterior walls. Natural light creates dramatic shadows across the textured surface.

craftsman_866.jpg.title: Traditional White Kitchen Remodel
craftsman_866.jpg.description: Modern kitchen featuring cream-colored custom cabinetry with transom windows above, dark granite countertops, and a farmhouse sink. The space includes pendant lighting, hardwood trim, and a decorative floor mat with geometric border pattern.

eclectic_277.jpg.title: Modern Teal Bathroom Vanity
eclectic_277.jpg.description: A stylish bathroom featuring a custom teal-colored vanity cabinet with brass hardware. The space includes white subway tile walls, a framed gold mirror, brass faucets and fixtures, and decorative floral tile flooring. A vase of purple flowers adds a pop of color.

coastal_430.jpg.title: Modern Farmhouse Kitchen with White Cabinetry
coastal_430.jpg.description: Bright, airy kitchen featuring white cabinetry, marble-look countertops, and industrial pendant lighting. The space showcases a blend of modern and farmhouse elements with natural wood accents and glass-front cabinets. A kitchen island with a woven basket containing green apples adds a homey touch.

victorian_461.jpg.title: Elegant Marble Master Bathroom
victorian_461.jpg.description: A luxurious bathroom featuring white marble countertops and walls with gray veining. The space includes a long double vanity with white cabinetry, framed mirrors, and classic wall sconces. Large windows with sheer curtains provide natural lighting. The floor features a traditional basket weave tile pattern.

transitional_862.jpg.title: Modern Gray Living Room with Orange Accents
transitional_862.jpg.description: Contemporary living room featuring a large gray sectional sofa with light gray throw pillows. The wall displays a series of black and white framed photographs alongside two vibrant abstract artworks. Three orange leather ottomans serve as a coffee table arrangement with a decorative plant centerpiece. The room has recessed lighting and gray hardwood flooring.

shabby-chic-style_469.jpg.title: Elegant Powder Room with Stone Vessel Sink
shabby-chic-style_469.jpg.description: A refined powder room featuring a weathered console table converted into a vanity, topped with a natural stone vessel sink. A simple framed mirror hangs above, flanked by traditional sconces. Fresh pink flowers in a glass vase add a delicate touch. The walls are painted in a warm neutral tone.

victorian_307.jpg.title: Craftsman Style Home Exterior Detail
victorian_307.jpg.description: Close-up exterior architectural detail of a home featuring decorative shingle siding in burgundy/brown on the gable, traditional lap siding in beige below, and a small white-trimmed window. The image shows the upper corner of the house with green tree foliage visible overhead.

eclectic_511.jpg.title: Cottage Kitchen with Farmhouse Sink
eclectic_511.jpg.description: A charming kitchen featuring a white farmhouse sink beneath a black-framed window. The window offers a view of greenery outside. Green painted cabinets with wooden countertops complement open wooden shelving displaying colorful circular dinnerware. Orange flowers in vases and striped kitchen towels add pops of color. A copper pendant light hangs above.

coastal_356.jpg.title: Luxury Hamptons-Style Poolside Retreat
coastal_356.jpg.description: Elegant waterfront residence featuring a pristine swimming pool with stone surround and multiple lounge areas. The white shingle-style architecture showcases classic coastal design with dormers, stone chimney, and extensive windows. The outdoor space includes blue-and-white striped umbrellas, plush lounge chairs, and manicured landscaping with potted plants.

contemporary_966.jpg.title: Modern Gray Bathroom with Double Vanity
contemporary_966.jpg.description: Luxurious contemporary bathroom featuring a dark gray color scheme with large format tile walls and floors. The space includes a frameless glass shower enclosure and a floating double vanity with integrated sinks and sleek hardware. The countertop appears to be concrete or quartz in a matching gray tone.

shabby-chic-style_441.jpg.title: Vintage Cottage Bathroom with Coral Accents
shabby-chic-style_441.jpg.description: A charming bathroom featuring white shiplap walls, a classic clawfoot tub with coral and white patterned shower curtain, pedestal sink, and a small window with lace cafe curtains. The room has a vintage feel with turquoise-framed artwork and penny tile flooring.

mid-century-modern_337.jpg.title: Retro 1950s Kitchen with Geometric Floor
mid-century-modern_337.jpg.description: A charming vintage-style kitchen featuring white cabinets, yellow countertops, and a distinctive geometric patterned floor in turquoise, cream, and gray. The space includes a breakfast nook with a round table and black chairs. The kitchen has white sheer curtains, turquoise decorative elements on an upper shelf, and classic appliances.

eclectic_539.jpg.title: Built-in Library Nook with Modern Accent
eclectic_539.jpg.description: A cozy reading nook featuring a built-in yellow bookshelf unit surrounding a navy blue sofa. The space is adorned with a modern abstract artwork mounted on a dark wall. Two wooden nesting tables sit in front, topped with fresh green hydrangeas. The floor features a geometric patterned carpet.

industrial_35.jpg.title: Modern Industrial Bar Storage
industrial_35.jpg.description: A sleek home bar setup featuring dark cabinetry with a brushed metal sliding door. The space includes industrial-style pendant lighting, floating metal shelves, and organized storage for liquor bottles and bar accessories. The grey brick wall backdrop complements the modern industrial aesthetic.

shabby-chic-style_56.jpg.title: Elegant French Country Dining Room
shabby-chic-style_56.jpg.description: A bright and airy dining room featuring a rustic wooden table paired with white upholstered chairs. The space is illuminated by a grand crystal chandelier and natural light from large windows dressed with light blue curtains. The room showcases coffered ceilings, vintage wooden doors, and built-in glass-front cabinets.

traditional_377.jpg.title: Cozy Laundry Room with Black Appliances
traditional_377.jpg.description: A well-organized and visually appealing laundry room features a compact yet efficient layout. The room is fitted with a stacked washer and dryer in a dark, almost black finish. Above the appliances are matching white cabinets providing ample storage, complemented by a rod for hanging clothes. A small sink and cabinet are positioned to the left, with dark countertop, enhancing the room's functionality. The walls are adorned with a soft, green patterned wallpaper, adding a touch of elegance to the space. A wooden bench and coat rack offer a practical area for changing or storing outdoor wear. The floor is tiled with dark hexagonal tiles, contributing to the room's clean and modern aesthetic.

tropical_491.jpg.title: Rock Waterfall Feature
tropical_491.jpg.description: A picturesque outdoor scene features a rock waterfall. The waterfall is constructed with various sizes of rocks, creating multiple tiers for the water to cascade down. The surrounding area is filled with stones and pebbles of different sizes, and the natural elements like trees and green foliage. The overall effect is a serene, natural landscape.

contemporary_796.jpg.title: Modern Minimalist Bathroom Vanity
contemporary_796.jpg.description: Contemporary bathroom featuring a floating wood vanity with black hardware, white quartz countertop, and black faucets. The backsplash features small hexagonal gray tiles. Three black-framed windows provide natural lighting, and a small potted plant adds organic decoration.

asian_252.jpg.title: Elegant Outdoor Gazebo with Seating Area
asian_252.jpg.description: This image showcases an elegant outdoor gazebo featuring a symmetrical design with a dark roof and wooden structure. The interior is furnished with comfortable seating arrangements, including wicker sofas and chairs accented with red cushions. Ambient lighting illuminates the space, highlighting the wooden flooring and the decorative elements such as statues placed around the perimeter. The surrounding landscaping adds to the serene atmosphere of the outdoor living area.

traditional_411.jpg.title: Elegant Dining Room with Dark Walls
traditional_411.jpg.description: A sophisticated dining room showcases a dark blue wall color contrasted by light-colored furnishings. A rectangular dining table with a pedestal base sits atop a gray patterned rug. Wicker-backed chairs surround the table, some adorned with light-colored cushions. A window framed by gold curtains allows natural light to illuminate the room, with artwork flanking either side. A unique chandelier hangs above the table, completing the elegant aesthetic.

coastal_418.jpg.title: Stylish White Bookshelves with Decorative Items
coastal_418.jpg.description: A close-up shot showcasing white built-in bookshelves with neatly arranged decorative items. The shelves contain objects like a geometric vase, coral in a glass display, wooden bowls, decorative books, and ceramic pots. The arrangement gives off a minimalist and modern aesthetic.

victorian_449.jpg.title: Eclectic Blue Living Room
victorian_449.jpg.description: A vibrant and eclectic living room featuring bold teal walls and a patterned teal ceiling. The room is symmetrically arranged with two light pink daybeds on either side of a central fireplace. Large, arched gold mirrors flank the fireplace, reflecting the light and adding depth to the space. A deep blue shag rug covers the floor, complementing the walls and ceiling. Above, a green glass chandelier hangs, providing a focal point. The fireplace is marble and has a crack above it, with a fire burning. Artwork is hung above the fireplace, and various decorative objects are scattered throughout the room, adding to the eclectic feel.

shabby-chic-style_327.jpg.title: Organized Mudroom with Custom Storage
shabby-chic-style_327.jpg.description: This image features a well-organized mudroom, displaying a built-in storage unit against a light blue wall. The storage unit is painted white and includes open shelving at the top, hooks for hanging items, and drawers at the bottom. A bright pink tote bag hangs from one of the hooks. A patterned decorative pillow rests on the storage unit's base. To the right, a white door stands with a small patterned rug at its base, and a partial view of another doorway is visible beyond it. A mirror hangs on the left wall, reflecting the scene. The flooring is a textured tile in neutral tones, and white trim and molding complete the room's aesthetic.

mediterranean_741.jpg.title: Xeriscape Garden Path
mediterranean_741.jpg.description: A pathway meanders through a xeriscape garden filled with drought-tolerant plants, mulch, and natural stone. The path is composed of irregularly shaped flagstones leading toward a lush landscape. Tall grasses, yucca, and low-lying flowering plants add texture and color to the scene, with trees in the background providing shade.

traditional_405.jpg.title: Organized Spice and Sauce Drawers
traditional_405.jpg.description: Two wooden drawers, neatly organized with spices in the top drawer and hot sauces in the bottom drawer, showcasing an efficient kitchen storage solution.

mid-century-modern_445.jpg.title: Bedroom Interior with Mirror and Patterned Pillow
mid-century-modern_445.jpg.description: A close-up of a bedroom interior showcasing a wooden headboard with a chevron pattern, adorned with white bedding and pillows. A long decorative pillow with a geometric design in pale pink and navy blue lies in front. Above the headboard, a round gold-framed mirror is centered. Nightstands are partially visible on either side, each featuring a lamp, a small plant, and a candle. The walls are painted in a light neutral tone, creating a bright and airy atmosphere.

craftsman_682.jpg.title: Charming Exterior of an Elegant House
craftsman_682.jpg.description: The exterior of a beautifully designed house is captured in this inviting image. The house features a unique architectural style with a blend of natural colors. A well-maintained garden in the foreground adds to the charm of the property. The house is adorned with a turret on one side, contributing to its unique appeal. The overall scene creates a sense of warmth and sophistication.

asian_246.jpg.title: Contemporary Kitchen Interior
asian_246.jpg.description: This image showcases a contemporary kitchen with a clean and functional design. The space features wooden cabinetry throughout, contributing warmth and a natural aesthetic. The island is the central focal point, offering ample counter space and storage. A skylight provides natural illumination, complemented by recessed lighting that enhances the overall brightness. The light-colored wood flooring and countertops harmonize with the cabinetry, while a tiled backsplash adds subtle texture. Appliances, including a refrigerator, are integrated seamlessly into the design.

asian_520.jpg.title: Massage Room Interior
asian_520.jpg.description: A cozy massage room featuring lime green walls adorned with framed floral prints, creating a serene atmosphere. The room includes a massage table draped with a purple sheet, a comfortable wooden chair, a small sink and vanity unit, and a dark-framed mirror. Pillows and folded towels are neatly arranged on the table, enhancing the inviting and relaxing ambiance.

tropical_485.jpg.title: Outdoor Kitchen Oasis
tropical_485.jpg.description: This image showcases a luxurious outdoor kitchen area nestled within a lush garden. The kitchen features a substantial countertop with a built-in grill, sink, and storage cabinets, constructed from textured concrete and natural stone. Several large black patio umbrellas provide shade. The surrounding garden is filled with tropical plants and trees, creating a serene atmosphere. The patio floor is paved with irregularly shaped stone tiles.

contemporary_782.jpg.title: Modern Staircase with Built-in Storage
contemporary_782.jpg.description: A contemporary staircase design featuring wooden treads and black metal horizontal railings. The space underneath is cleverly utilized with built-in wooden storage cubes. The design maximizes functionality while maintaining a clean, minimalist aesthetic.

southwestern_99.jpg.title: Luxury Golf Simulator Home Theater
southwestern_99.jpg.description: High-end home entertainment space featuring a professional golf simulator with large projection screen displaying a golf course, complemented by a framed golf artwork on the side wall. The room has modern recessed lighting, contemporary seating with leather recliners, and textured stone accent walls.

shabby-chic-style_455.jpg.title: Cozy Cottage Bedroom with Coral Bedding
shabby-chic-style_455.jpg.description: A bright and airy bedroom featuring coral-colored bedding with paisley patterns, white painted walls and ceiling, green shutters, and multiple windows providing natural light. The space has a relaxed, cottage-style feel with elegant touches.

transitional_686.jpg.title: Modern Powder Room with Geometric Wallpaper
transitional_686.jpg.description: A stylish powder room featuring bold geometric trellis wallpaper in navy and white. The space includes a traditional pedestal sink, round gold-framed mirror, and white toilet. The pattern creates a dramatic effect in this small bathroom space.

traditional_363.jpg.title: Bright Coastal Dining Room with Round Table
traditional_363.jpg.description: A light-filled dining room featuring a round wooden table surrounded by six upholstered chairs in light gray. The space has coffered ceilings, large windows with natural light streaming in, hardwood floors, and built-in storage. A modern drum pendant light hangs above the table, and potted plants add organic elements.

rustic_249.jpg.title: Craftsman Style Mountain Home Exterior
rustic_249.jpg.description: Luxurious craftsman-style home exterior featuring a circular paver driveway, wooden post columns, and dual garage doors. The home showcases a tan/beige exterior with cedar accents, multiple gabled rooflines, and professional landscaping.

traditional_388.jpg.title: Modern Kid's Bedroom with Custom Bunk Bed
traditional_388.jpg.description: A vibrant children's bedroom featuring a custom-built wooden bunk bed with navy blue accents and integrated staircase storage. The room has a playful striped accent wall, geometric area rug, and rocking horse toy. Natural light streams in through window with roller shade.

farmhouse_403.jpg.title: Modern Farmhouse Kitchen with Exposed Beams
farmhouse_403.jpg.description: Luxurious open-concept kitchen featuring exposed wooden beams, white cabinetry, and a large center island. The space combines rustic and modern elements with brick accent wall, geometric pendant lighting, and high-end stainless steel appliances. Light wooden floors and marble countertops complete the sophisticated design.

southwestern_72.jpg.title: Southwestern Living Room with Mountain View
southwestern_72.jpg.description: A cozy southwestern-style living room featuring exposed wooden ceiling beams, a traditional kiva fireplace, and large windows with mountain views. The room is decorated with rustic furniture, including a substantial wooden console table displaying candles and decorative items. The space includes plush seating with red accent pillows and traditional southwestern textiles.

modern_265.jpg.title: Modern Mini Bar Nook
modern_265.jpg.description: A minimalist bar nook featuring built-in light wood cabinetry with a white countertop and sink. The space is furnished with three cream-colored club chairs arranged around a round wooden coffee table.
