A modern brass linear chandelier hangs above, and two framed photographs with blue tones accent the white wall.

contemporary_769.jpg.title: Modern Garden Pathway Design
contemporary_769.jpg.description: A contemporary side yard featuring large rectangular concrete pavers set in decorative gravel, creating a clean-lined walkway. The path is flanked by manicured lawn areas and professionally landscaped borders with boxwood shrubs and evergreen plants. A stone-faced house wall is visible on the left with black metal railings, and a white perimeter wall defines the space.

modern_503.jpg.title: Modern Black Ranch with Wood Accents
modern_503.jpg.description: Exterior view of a contemporary single-story home featuring black horizontal siding, warm wood panel accents, and landscape lighting. The home has a minimalist design with a flat roof and an attached garage. The landscaping includes mulched beds and natural vegetation against a wooded backdrop.

mediterranean_972.jpg.title: Above-Ground Pool with Wood Deck
mediterranean_972.jpg.description: An oval above-ground swimming pool surrounded by a custom wooden deck. The pool is enclosed by a privacy fence with some hanging plants. The deck features lounge chairs and includes built-in stairs for easy access. A yellow slide is mounted on one end of the pool.

craftsman_669.jpg.title: Custom Kitchen Drawer Organization
craftsman_669.jpg.description: Interior view of custom kitchen cabinetry featuring multiple pull-out drawers with specialized storage solutions. The drawers showcase organized storage for plates, serving dishes, and cookware with wooden dividers and slats. The cabinetry is finished in white paint, contrasting with warm hardwood flooring.

mediterranean_966.jpg.title: Outdoor Kitchen Built-in Appliances
mediterranean_966.jpg.description: Close-up view of a custom outdoor kitchen installation featuring stainless steel appliances built into a stone or concrete base with a wooden countertop. The setup includes what appears to be a beverage refrigerator with glass door and additional storage drawers.

tropical_9.jpg.title: Modern Coastal Villa Exterior
tropical_9.jpg.description: Luxurious contemporary white stucco home with Mediterranean influences featuring a grand circular paver driveway, tall palm trees, and professional landscaping. The home showcases a modern flat roof design with multiple architectural levels, large garage doors, and clean lines.

modern_517.jpg.title: Modern Luxury Master Bathroom Vanity
modern_517.jpg.description: A contemporary bathroom featuring a floating double vanity with walnut wood cabinetry and white marble countertop. The space includes vertical wall sconces, a large mirror, and dark tile walls contrasting with white surfaces. A small potted bamboo plant adds an organic element.

farmhouse_371.jpg.title: Rustic Modern Kitchen Storage
farmhouse_371.jpg.description: Custom kitchen cabinetry featuring a mix of natural wood and painted finishes. The focal point is a large pantry cabinet in warm wood tones alongside light gray painted cabinets. The design includes beadboard backsplash, decorative pottery on upper shelving, and contrasting hardware finishes.

southwestern_66.jpg.title: Cozy Modern Bedroom Retreat
southwestern_66.jpg.description: A warm and inviting bedroom featuring plush bedding in neutral tones, with a modern nightstand and table lamp with orange shade. The space includes decorative wall art, comfortable seating, and layered textiles including an ornate area rug.

french-country_238.jpg.title: Luxury Transitional Kitchen with Custom Range Hood
french-country_238.jpg.description: High-end kitchen featuring a custom geometric tile backsplash, white perimeter cabinets, and a contrasting gray island. The space showcases a farmhouse sink, white orchid decoration, and a dramatic custom range hood with metallic trim. Light hardwood flooring complements the overall design, while recessed lighting provides ambient illumination.

scandinavian_558.jpg.title: Modern Scandinavian Living Room
scandinavian_558.jpg.description: Bright contemporary living room featuring a minimalist design with a cream-colored sofa, black and white striped area rug, and gallery wall with black frames. The space includes a fiddle leaf fig plant and modern gold coffee table, complemented by natural light from a sliding door.

industrial_339.jpg.title: Modern Open-Concept Loft Living Space
industrial_339.jpg.description: A luxurious open-concept living area featuring double-height ceilings with clerestory windows. The space combines a living room with a modern kitchen and includes a mezzanine level. The polished concrete floors reflect ambient light, while the contemporary fireplace serves as a focal point.

transitional_679.jpg.title: Modern Two-Tone Kitchen with Island
transitional_679.jpg.description: Contemporary kitchen featuring a striking contrast between white perimeter cabinets and a navy blue island. The space includes patterned tile backsplash, pendant lighting, and colorful bar stools. A decorative runner adds warmth to the hardwood floors.

coastal_395.jpg.title: Modern Coastal Bathroom Renovation
coastal_395.jpg.description: A bright and airy bathroom featuring white shiplap walls, a large oval mirror with black frame, and modern fixtures. The space includes a glass shower enclosure, white vanity with quartz countertop, and coastal-themed artwork. The design combines modern functionality with beach-house aesthetics.

tropical_452.jpg.title: Retro Cottage Kitchen with Green Tile
tropical_452.jpg.description: A charming vintage-style kitchen featuring bright green subway tile backsplash, white beadboard cabinets, butcher block countertops, and cream-colored vintage appliances. The space has a vaulted ceiling with exposed beams painted white, and natural light streams in through plantation shuttered windows.

contemporary_755.jpg.title: Pots and Pans Storage Pull Out
contemporary_755.jpg.description: This image shows a pull-out cabinet drawer designed for efficient storage of pots, pans, and their lids. The drawer is made of light-colored wood and features multiple shelves. The top shelves are specifically designed to hold pot lids, while the lower part of the drawer accommodates various sizes of pots and pans stacked neatly. The drawer is part of a kitchen cabinet, and the overall design maximizes space and organization in a kitchen setting.

scandinavian_570.jpg.title: Neutral Safari Nursery
scandinavian_570.jpg.description: A bright and airy nursery featuring a white crib with animal-themed bedding and a soft gray blanket. Above the crib hang three framed black and white prints of a lion, giraffe, and elephant against a subtle chevron wallpaper. A large fiddle-leaf fig tree in a woven basket adds a touch of nature to the space. A stuffed sloth sits atop the crib, adding a playful element to the room.

french-country_210.jpg.title: Elegant Kitchen with Island Seating
french-country_210.jpg.description: This is a well-lit, elegant kitchen featuring a large central island with seating. The island has a rich wood countertop and white base, and is accessorized with fruit and flowers. The surrounding cabinetry is white, with glass-fronted cabinets displaying china. The floor is a cool gray tile, which provides a neutral base for the warm wood and soft colors.

industrial_311.jpg.title: Modern Shipping Container Interior
industrial_311.jpg.description: An interior view showcasing a modern living space designed within shipping containers. The design features exposed steel beams and shipping container walls, complemented by modern furniture. The living area includes a leather chair, a round glass table, and a rug. A bookshelf and TV are visible against a container wall. The kitchen area features wooden cabinets, a kitchen island with bar stools, and a window offering an outdoor view. Concrete flooring adds to the industrial aesthetic.

transitional_651.jpg.title: Elegant Home Sauna
transitional_651.jpg.description: This image showcases a modern home sauna with a clean and sophisticated design. The sauna is constructed of light wood, with horizontal planks forming the walls, benches, and floor. A clear glass door and side panel allow a view of the interior from the outside hallway. The sauna's heating unit is enclosed in a wooden box with horizontal slats. The room outside the sauna has marble flooring and leads into a well-lit living space with a couch, wooden floors, and natural light. The design is minimalistic and functional, emphasizing relaxation and health.

rustic_275.jpg.title: Mountain Retreat Cabin
rustic_275.jpg.description: This image showcases the exterior of a modern mountain cabin set amidst tall pine trees. The cabin features a striking wall of windows framed with dark metal, allowing ample natural light to fill the interior. A prominent stone chimney adds a rustic touch to the contemporary design. The structure blends seamlessly with the natural environment, emphasizing a sense of tranquility and connection with nature. The lighting from within the cabin casts a warm glow, contrasting with the cool tones of the surrounding twilight.

shabby-chic-style_95.jpg.title: Elegant White Christmas Tree
shabby-chic-style_95.jpg.description: A close-up shot of a beautifully decorated Christmas tree with a predominantly white and pastel color scheme. The tree is flocked, giving it a snowy appearance. It's adorned with ornaments in shades of gold, silver, white, and light pink, creating a soft and elegant aesthetic. A white feather boa-like garland is draped across the tree, adding texture and a touch of whimsy. The tree is illuminated with soft white lights, and a large snowflake tree topper completes the look. The background is softly blurred, suggesting a bright and airy room.

shabby-chic-style_482.jpg.title: Beachside Bedroom with Ocean View
shabby-chic-style_482.jpg.description: A serene bedroom bathed in natural light features a chaise lounge, a distressed blue dresser, and floor-to-ceiling curtains that frame an expansive ocean view. The room is decorated in soft, neutral tones, enhancing the airy and tranquil ambiance. A decorative floral mirror hangs above the dresser, adding a touch of elegance.

transitional_889.jpg.title: Open Concept Living and Kitchen Area
transitional_889.jpg.description: This image showcases an open-concept living and kitchen area. The living room features a beige sofa with striped cushions, a patterned armchair, and a brown throw blanket. In the kitchen, there's a blue island with a brown bar stool, white cabinets, a stainless steel refrigerator, and a microwave. The dining area includes a round wooden table and wooden chairs. Artwork adorns the walls, and various light fixtures are visible, including a chandelier above the dining table and modern lighting in the kitchen. The flooring is light wood, and the overall design aesthetic appears to be a blend of traditional and contemporary elements.

craftsman_133.jpg.title: Cozy Home Office with Wood Accents
craftsman_133.jpg.description: A well-lit home office featuring rich wood tones. A built-in desk wraps around a corner with multiple windows, providing ample natural light. A classic wooden chair sits in front of the desk, which is adorned with a globe, books, and a vase of white tulips. The room has hardwood floors that match the desk and window frames, creating a cohesive and warm atmosphere. A bookshelf is integrated into the desk's design, filled with books. The window design is characterized by geometric patterns in the mullions. A small window nook with a cushioned seat is visible on the left.

craftsman_655.jpg.title: Powder Room Detail
craftsman_655.jpg.description: Close-up of a powder room with light blue walls, white trim, and a mosaic tile accent border. A white toilet with a plant on top is featured.

mediterranean_796.jpg.title: Bathroom Vanity with Wicker Accents
mediterranean_796.jpg.description: A stylish bathroom scene showcases a blue vanity cabinet with black hardware. The vanity is topped with a white countertop featuring a vessel sink and gold-toned faucet. A wicker-framed mirror hangs above, flanked by sconces. Wicker baskets sit beneath the vanity, adding a touch of texture. A plant and towel introduce natural elements, while the white walls contribute to the bright, clean aesthetic.

transitional_137.jpg.title: Elegant Bathroom with Marble Accents
transitional_137.jpg.description: This image showcases a bright and elegant bathroom with a focus on marble elements. A vanity with a white cabinet and marble countertop sits to the left, adorned with a bouquet of flowers in a glass vase. Above the vanity are sconce lighting fixtures and a mirror, adding to the room's ambiance. The shower enclosure features clear glass walls and a door, with marble tiling covering the interior walls. A built-in niche is visible in the shower wall, offering storage. The bathroom is painted in light, neutral tones, creating a calming and sophisticated atmosphere.

rustic_513.jpg.title: Cozy Rustic Living Room with Fireplace
rustic_513.jpg.description: A warm and inviting living room is centered around a stone fireplace with a burning fire. Two light-colored sofas face each other, flanking a rustic wooden coffee table. Wooden side tables, a faux cowhide rug, and a chandelier with candle-style lights add to the cozy ambiance. Windows on either side show a nighttime view of trees and water, and decorative elements like crossed skis and a wooden mantle contribute to the rustic aesthetic.

industrial_477.jpg.title: Rustic Bathroom with Shiplap Walls
industrial_477.jpg.description: A cozy, rustic-style bathroom featuring white shiplap walls, wooden floating shelves, and a wood vanity with a gray countertop. A patterned window shade adds a touch of elegance, while the overall design exudes a warm, inviting atmosphere.

asian_291.jpg.title: Tranquil Zen Garden
asian_291.jpg.description: A peaceful outdoor Zen garden featuring a gravel area with carefully placed stones, stepping stones leading through dark mulch, and a border of lush green grass. A wooden fence encloses the space, providing privacy and a sense of enclosure. The design incorporates natural elements for a serene and contemplative atmosphere.

scandinavian_216.jpg.title: Modern Scandinavian Living Room
scandinavian_216.jpg.description: A bright, airy living room featuring white walls and floating shelves decorated with plants and decor items. The space includes a modern entertainment setup with a wall-mounted TV above a wooden media console. A light gray sectional sofa is paired with a round wooden coffee table displaying fresh yellow flowers. The room is grounded by a deep green area rug and accented with yellow throw pillows.

southwestern_913.jpg.title: Rustic Living Room with Gray Wood Floors
southwestern_913.jpg.description: A warm, inviting living room featuring luxury vinyl or laminate gray wood flooring, stone fireplace, and natural light from large windows. The space combines rustic and modern elements with comfortable seating and decorative accents.

french-country_576.jpg.title: Elegant French Country Home Exterior
french-country_576.jpg.description: Exterior view of a sophisticated two-story home featuring a covered porch with wooden posts, cream stucco walls, slate roof, and manicured landscaping. The porch area includes stone foundation details and boxwood hedging along the perimeter.

farmhouse_359.jpg.title: Modern Subway Tile Bathroom with Wood Accents
farmhouse_359.jpg.description: A contemporary bathroom featuring white subway tile walls, a walk-in shower with black fixtures, and a wooden countertop vanity. The space includes a high window for natural light, industrial-style lighting, and hexagonal floor tiles. The layout is clean and efficient with open shelving below the vanity.

industrial_463.jpg.title: Minimalist White Bedroom with Black-Framed Windows
industrial_463.jpg.description: A bright, airy bedroom featuring stark white walls and floors contrasted with dramatic black-framed windows. The room has high ceilings with exposed industrial elements and natural light streaming through large windows. A simple white bed with crisp linens serves as the focal point, while sheer white curtains add softness to the space.

asian_285.jpg.title: Tropical Modern Entryway
asian_285.jpg.description: A luxurious entryway featuring vertical wood slat walls and abundant tropical plants. The space combines indoor-outdoor elements with black river rocks, palm fronds, and architectural lighting. The pathway leads to an interior space with a visible fireplace in the background.

scandinavian_202.jpg.title: Modern Floating Double Vanity Bathroom
scandinavian_202.jpg.description: Contemporary bathroom featuring a floating wooden double vanity with marble countertops. The setup includes two separate sinks with matte black faucets, matching framed mirrors, and wall-mounted globe sconces. The clean lines and minimal design create an elegant, spa-like atmosphere.

southwestern_907.jpg.title: Modern Desert Home Entrance
southwestern_907.jpg.description: Contemporary southwestern home exterior featuring a curved facade with large windows and a modern entrance. The landscaping includes desert-appropriate gravel, cacti, and accent lighting. The entrance is highlighted by warm interior lighting visible through glass panels and windows at dusk/sunset with dramatic pink and purple sky.

tropical_320.jpg.title: Luxury Tropical Pool Retreat at Dusk
tropical_320.jpg.description: An elegant curved swimming pool surrounded by tropical landscaping and palm trees at sunset. The pool area features high-end outdoor furniture and a covered pergola. The design incorporates natural stone pavers and multiple seating areas with mood lighting.

craftsman_641.jpg.title: Modern Craftsman Home Entrance
craftsman_641.jpg.description: Exterior view of a luxury craftsman-style home entrance at sunset, featuring a dramatic red-orange sky. The entrance showcases a contemporary glass door with decorative timber frame accents, stone veneer foundation, and professional landscape lighting. The home has tan siding, a dark gray roof, and an attached garage.

mid-century-modern_486.jpg.title: Bright Modern Kitchen Design
mid-century-modern_486.jpg.description: A well-lit kitchen features light wood cabinets, a black countertop, and a large window overlooking greenery. The space is illuminated by modern pendant lights and wall sconces. The open shelving complements the minimalist aesthetic. A stainless steel oven and range hood add a touch of industrial chic.

mediterranean_782.jpg.title: Charming Kitchen with Island and Arched Entry
mediterranean_782.jpg.description: This is a well-lit kitchen featuring dark blue base cabinets, a butcher block island with bar stools, and white upper cabinets. An arched doorway leads into the kitchen, and an oriental rug adds color to the wood floor. A farmhouse sink is located beneath a window overlooking a green outdoor space. Open shelves add storage and display space, while pendant lights illuminate the island.

rustic_507.jpg.title: Elegant Home Bar with Stone Backsplash
rustic_507.jpg.description: This image showcases a beautifully designed home bar area. The bar features open shelving with a dark wood finish, creating a sophisticated and warm ambiance. The backsplash is made of textured stone, adding a natural and elegant touch to the space. The shelves are illuminated with LED strip lighting, highlighting the various barware and glassware displayed. There are wine glasses, drinking glasses, and a metal ice bucket arranged neatly on the shelves. The countertop is a wooden butcher block, providing a functional and aesthetically pleasing surface. A stylish faucet is installed on the countertop next to a small sink. A red basket with limes is placed on the lower right of the counter, adding a pop of color. Greenery is draped over the top shelf, bringing a touch of nature to the indoor space. The overall design blends rustic and modern elements to create a luxurious and inviting home bar area.

craftsman_899.jpg.title: Elegant Interior with Custom Built-Ins and Craftsman Details
craftsman_899.jpg.description: This interior showcases a well-lit space featuring custom built-in shelving topped with a smooth countertop. Square white columns with ornate detailing divide the room, leading the eye upward to a unique, geometric pendant light hanging from the high, peaked ceiling. The space is further adorned with framed artwork along a soft green wall, and dark wood doors add a touch of warmth. The design reflects a Craftsman-inspired aesthetic, evident in the architectural details and clean lines.

transitional_123.jpg.title: Elegant Dining Room with Natural Light
transitional_123.jpg.description: A beautifully lit dining room showcasing a blend of classic and contemporary elements. The focal point is a rectangular wooden dining table adorned with a centerpiece of lush greenery in a dark container. A large white paper lantern hangs from the ceiling, providing soft, diffused light. Around the table, there are wooden chairs, some with upholstered seats, while a striking blue striped armchair adds a modern touch. The room features full-length beige curtains framing a large window, offering a view of an outdoor scene. An antique-style chair with floral upholstery is placed against the wall, adding a vintage accent. The hardwood floors and light-colored walls enhance the room's airy feel. The ceiling is painted in a muted green shade.

rustic_261.jpg.title: Cozy Bedroom with Rustic Accents
rustic_261.jpg.description: A well-lit bedroom features a large wrought-iron bed dressed with a white quilted coverlet and an array of decorative pillows in varying patterns and textures. The bed faces a window offering a view of lush greenery. Above, a wooden-beamed ceiling adds a rustic touch to the room, while a sliding barn door on the left contributes to the room's charm. The room is illuminated by a table lamp beside the bed, enhancing the cozy atmosphere.

transitional_645.jpg.title: Organized Pantry with White Cabinets and Woven Baskets
transitional_645.jpg.description: A well-organized pantry featuring white cabinets, woven baskets, and a dark countertop. The pantry has floor-to-ceiling built-in shelving filled with neatly arranged food items, books, and decorative objects. The counter space includes a variety of kitchen appliances, such as toasters and a coffee maker. The drawers are adorned with sleek, black handles, adding a touch of modern contrast to the traditional design.

shabby-chic-style_496.jpg.title: Cozy Living Room
shabby-chic-style_496.jpg.description: A living room featuring a variety of furniture and decorative elements. A large, brown sectional sofa is positioned on the left side of the image, adorned with patterned throw pillows. Opposite the sofa, a gray armchair faces a uniquely designed coffee table with a glass top and painted legs. A wooden side table, topped with a vase of flowers, sits next to the armchair. The room is grounded by a circular patterned rug in muted tones of blue, brown, and cream. A white brick fireplace serves as a focal point, decorated with vases and other ornaments. A rocking chair with a patterned seat is placed near the fireplace. Natural light floods the room through a large window on the left, enhancing the bright and airy feel. The walls are painted in a light color, complemented by decorative wall hangings.

craftsman_127.jpg.title: Lush Garden Path
craftsman_127.jpg.description: This image captures a serene garden scene featuring a winding stone path flanked by a variety of plants and shrubs. The path, composed of irregularly shaped gray stones, leads the viewer into the depths of the garden. The vegetation is dense and diverse, with various shades of green and hints of other colors, creating a vibrant and natural atmosphere. A wooden fence in the background provides a sense of enclosure and privacy. The overall impression is one of tranquility and natural beauty.

tropical_446.jpg.title: Luxurious Coastal Bedroom
tropical_446.jpg.description: A bright and airy coastal bedroom featuring a king-size bed with white linens and decorative pillows, set against a textured wood wall. A large abstract art piece hangs above the bed. The room is illuminated by a unique ceiling fan and recessed lighting. Large sliding glass doors offer a view of the ocean and manicured lawn. A blue area rug anchors the bed, and a decorative paddle hangs on the wall. The room incorporates natural elements and a calming color palette.

contemporary_741.jpg.title: Stylish Bathroom with Geometric Tile
contemporary_741.jpg.description: A contemporary bathroom featuring a freestanding white bathtub set against a backdrop of vibrant geometric patterned blue and white tile. The tile extends from the floor up the wall and onto the ceiling, creating a cohesive and bold design statement. The bathtub is accessorized with rolled towels and a small side table holding a potted plant. White wall tiles complement the geometric pattern, and a glass shower door provides access to the bathing area, equipped with both a rainfall showerhead and a handheld shower. Black hardware accents the space, adding a modern touch.

french-country_204.jpg.title: Elegant Dining and Kitchen Area
french-country_204.jpg.description: A beautifully designed dining and kitchen area featuring a large wooden dining table with ornate white chairs and a crystal chandelier. The kitchen includes a breakfast bar with grey bar stools, a wooden structure separating the spaces, and a view into a living room with a fireplace. The color palette includes whites, woods, and touches of green and blue.

industrial_305.jpg.title: Outdoor Bar Setting with Wine
industrial_305.jpg.description: Image shows a man and a woman sitting at an outdoor bar, enjoying wine. The bar has a light gray countertop and a dark gray base. The bar stools are bright green. A bottle of wine and two glasses are on the bar. There are decorative lanterns and lighting fixtures around. Behind them is a wood slat wall. A potted plant is in the lower right corner. The overall ambiance is relaxed and inviting.

french-country_953.jpg.title: Cozy Bedroom with Manchester United Theme
french-country_953.jpg.description: A top-down view showcases a well-lit, cozy bedroom with a Manchester United theme. A large, comfortable bed dominates the space, covered with a gray comforter, a white blanket, and multiple pillows, including decorative cushions. Above the bed, a large canvas print featuring the Manchester United logo adds a personalized touch. The room is illuminated by natural light from a window, which is enhanced by a light-colored curtain. A built-in window seat is adorned with additional decorative pillows, creating a relaxing nook. A bedside table with a lamp sits next to the bed, providing ambient lighting. The floor is covered with a modern rug featuring stripes and geometric patterns in neutral tones, complementing the room's overall color scheme.

industrial_852.jpg.title: Contemporary Fireplace with Floating Shelves
industrial_852.jpg.description: The image showcases a modern fireplace design with a minimalist aesthetic. The fireplace itself is a long, horizontal rectangle set within a light-colored tiled wall. Above the fireplace, a thick, dark-stained wooden mantel extends across the wall, creating a shelf for decorative items. To the right of the fireplace, built-in shelves are visible, displaying books and small decorative objects, illuminated by subtle lighting. A similar wooden shelf or ledge runs along the bottom of the fireplace, extending the length of the wall. The flooring is dark hardwood, adding warmth and contrast to the lighter elements of the fireplace surround and wall. The overall impression is one of clean lines, natural materials, and a cozy, inviting atmosphere.

shabby-chic-style_119.jpg.title: Luxurious Bathroom with Wood Ceiling and Chandelier
shabby-chic-style_119.jpg.description: A sophisticated bathroom features a walk-in shower tiled in horizontal beige planks and a herringbone-patterned floor. Above, a rustic wood-paneled ceiling is illuminated by an ornate crystal chandelier. Adjacent to the shower is a vanity with an oval sink, set beneath an elaborately framed mirror. A wall sconce provides additional lighting, and a neutral color palette enhances the room's serene atmosphere.

rustic_936.jpg.title: Rustic Modern Kitchen with Knotty Alder Cabinets
rustic_936.jpg.description: A contemporary kitchen featuring natural wood cabinetry with dark soapstone or granite countertops. The space includes stainless steel appliances, a built-in gas cooktop, and hardwood flooring. The kitchen exhibits a blend of rustic and modern elements with clean lines and natural materials.

coastal_626.jpg.title: Modern Blue Laundry Room with View
coastal_626.jpg.description: A contemporary laundry room featuring blue-gray cabinetry, white countertops, and modern front-loading washer and dryer. The space includes a black-framed window providing natural light and outdoor views, built-in storage solutions, and decorative wire baskets. A farmhouse-style sign adds rustic charm.

traditional_149.jpg.title: Elegant Blue Door with Custom Metal Awning
traditional_149.jpg.description: A striking turquoise blue front door with decorative metal awning and ornate wall-mounted lanterns. The entrance is flanked by two matching potted evergreen shrubs in decorative planters. The door features artistic detailing and a centered door knocker. The metal awning above has a sophisticated curved design with scrollwork supports.

eclectic_707.jpg.title: Eclectic Living Room with Tufted Sofa
eclectic_707.jpg.description: A cozy living room featuring a mix of patterns and textures. The space is anchored by a tufted blue sofa and complemented by a chevron accent chair. Large abstract artwork dominates one wall, while a gallery wall of smaller framed pieces adds visual interest. Natural light streams through a white-trimmed window.

coastal_140.jpg.title: Modern White Laundry Room with Patterned Backsplash
coastal_140.jpg.description: A bright, contemporary laundry room featuring white shaker-style cabinets, side-by-side washer and dryer units, and a geometric patterned tile backsplash. The space includes upper and lower cabinets with black hardware, a white countertop, and a glass panel door for natural light.

victorian_111.jpg.title: Victorian Queen Anne House Exterior
victorian_111.jpg.description: Elegant Victorian-era Queen Anne style home featuring ornate architectural details including decorative gables, wraparound porch, turret with conical roof, and intricate white trim work. The house is painted in a soft pink/beige color with white accents. The entrance features a grand covered porch with symmetrical landscaping including flowering bushes.

scandinavian_68.jpg.title: Modern Wood-Paneled Kitchen and Living Space
scandinavian_68.jpg.description: Contemporary open-concept living space featuring wood-paneled walls and ceiling, with a sleek kitchen and living area. The space showcases a minimalist design with warm wood tones, industrial pendant lighting, and a breakfast bar with metal stools. The living area includes a modern sofa with turquoise accent pillows.

mid-century-modern_109.jpg.title: Modern Mid-Century Living Room with Marble Fireplace
mid-century-modern_109.jpg.description: A sophisticated living room featuring a white marble fireplace as the focal point, flanked by dark wood built-ins. The space includes classic mid-century modern furniture pieces set on a plush cream area rug against dark hardwood floors. A large arching floor lamp and natural light from windows create bright, airy ambiance.

scandinavian_955.jpg.title: Modern Attic Bathroom with Woven Chair
scandinavian_955.jpg.description: A minimalist attic bathroom featuring sloped ceilings and hardwood flooring. The space includes a wall-mounted black vanity with a white sink, a framed mirror, and a stylish woven wooden chair. The room has clean white walls with subtle tile work and modern lighting fixtures.

southwestern_250.jpg.title: Natural Rock Garden with Purple Blooms
southwestern_250.jpg.description: A rustic garden landscape featuring natural stone work and diverse plantings. The garden includes purple verbena, delicate pink flowers, and various ornamental grasses arranged in a naturalistic style. The design incorporates reddish stone walls and ground-level rock features creating multiple levels and visual interest.

rustic_25.jpg.title: Modern Woodland Bedroom with Fireplace
rustic_25.jpg.description: A luxurious master bedroom featuring floor-to-ceiling windows overlooking a forest setting. The room centers around a modern stone fireplace with a lit fire. The space combines natural materials with contemporary design, featuring hardwood floors and stone accents. The bed has crisp white linens and is positioned to take advantage of both the fireplace and forest views.

tropical_877.jpg.title: Luxury Coastal Pool Home at Night
tropical_877.jpg.description: Evening exterior view of a modern coastal home featuring a curved swimming pool with spa. The white-sided house has dramatic architectural elements including exposed beams and multiple levels. The well-lit exterior shows warm interior lighting through large windows. A curved concrete pathway leads to the pool area, complemented by tropical landscaping with palm trees.

scandinavian_941.jpg.title: Scandinavian Nursery Corner
scandinavian_941.jpg.description: A minimalist nursery corner featuring a rustic wooden cabinet with a modern two-tone wall treatment. The upper portion is white while the lower section is painted in a muted sage green. Decorative elements include a floating white shelf displaying a plush dolphin and various small decorative items. A stuffed elephant sits atop the wooden cabinet alongside what appears to be a white lamp or container.

southwestern_244.jpg.title: Tuscan Kitchen with Custom Range Hood
southwestern_244.jpg.description: Luxury Mediterranean-style kitchen featuring a dramatic custom stucco range hood in warm ochre, complemented by dark wood cabinetry and stone backsplash. The professional gas cooktop is centered under the hood, with built-in appliances and storage integrated into the custom cabinetry.

tropical_863.jpg.title: Luxury Tropical Pool Pavilion
tropical_863.jpg.description: An elegant infinity pool deck featuring a Balinese-style pavilion with flowing white curtains and red cushions. The wooden deck overlooks a lush tropical landscape with palm trees. The infinity pool merges seamlessly with the horizon, complemented by circular stone water features and premium teak loungers.

mediterranean_219.jpg.title: Modern Minimalist Kitchen with Floating Shelves
mediterranean_219.jpg.description: A contemporary kitchen featuring a marble-look backsplash and counter, warm wood accents, and floating shelves. The space includes globe pendant lights, wooden bar stools, and a clean-lined island design. Natural elements include a dried floral arrangement in a vase.

rustic_922.jpg.title: Traditional Entryway with Herringbone Brick Floor
rustic_922.jpg.description: Interior space featuring a traditional wooden settee with cushions against a white wall, decorated with framed artwork. The most striking feature is the herringbone-patterned brick flooring. The settee is adorned with multiple throw pillows in red, pink, and gray tones.

victorian_663.jpg.title: Bright Traditional Sunroom with Wicker Furniture
victorian_663.jpg.description: A welcoming sunroom featuring diamond-paned windows, vaulted ceiling with exposed beams, and comfortable wicker seating. The space is flooded with natural light and showcases a mix of traditional and coastal elements, including a large area rug and an ornate hanging lantern.

coastal_632.jpg.title: Inviting Gray Home Exterior with Stone Accents
coastal_632.jpg.description: This image showcases the exterior of a home with a combination of gray siding, stone accents, and white trim. The entrance features a stone-clad porch with square columns that transition to white at the top. A wooden door with a vertical glass insert is flanked by a small square window. The landscape includes green shrubbery and a natural rock element. The overall style is sophisticated and blends natural materials with a modern aesthetic.

french-country_947.jpg.title: Minimalist Bathroom Interior
french-country_947.jpg.description: A clean and bright bathroom featuring a minimalist design. The room includes a white vanity with a built-in sink and mirror, a sliding door, and a tiled floor. A shower tray is placed in the corner, contributing to the functional layout.

southwestern_522.jpg.title: Rustic Living Room with Brick Walls
southwestern_522.jpg.description: A rustic living room features exposed brick walls, wooden beamed ceiling, and a cozy fireplace. Two light-colored sofas face each other across a coffee table on an ornate rug. Two armchairs flank one sofa, while windows provide natural light and a view to the outdoors. A telescope stands near one of the windows, adding a touch of personality to the space.

mid-century-modern_653.jpg.title: Mid-Century Modern Living Room
mid-century-modern_653.jpg.description: A stylish living room featuring mid-century modern design elements. The focal point is a beige sofa adorned with blue and patterned pillows. A wooden oval coffee table sits atop a geometric patterned rug. A wooden accent wall provides a warm backdrop. A table lamp and artwork decorate a side table, completing the cozy and sophisticated atmosphere.

craftsman_494.jpg.title: Elegant Bathroom with Freestanding Tub
craftsman_494.jpg.description: A beautifully designed bathroom featuring a classic freestanding bathtub positioned near a stained-glass window, providing natural light. The room boasts built-in wooden shelves filled with neatly stacked towels and decorative items. A wooden vanity with a marble countertop is equipped with dual sinks and framed mirrors. The floor is covered with a mosaic pattern of neutral tiles. The walls are painted in a warm, creamy tone, complementing the wood accents throughout the space.

shabby-chic-style_125.jpg.title: Bright Neutral Bedroom with Rattan Accents
shabby-chic-style_125.jpg.description: This bright and airy bedroom features a neutral color palette accented with natural materials like rattan and woven textures. The room is filled with natural light from a large window, which offers a scenic view of the outside. The bed is dressed with layers of pillows and a cozy throw, creating an inviting space. The rattan bench at the foot of the bed adds a touch of bohemian charm, while the greenery from the potted tree brings a sense of life to the room.

tropical_77.jpg.title: Cozy Window Seat with Tropical View
tropical_77.jpg.description: A charming interior features a cozy window seat nestled within a room bathed in natural light. The seat is upholstered in a soft green fabric and adorned with colorful striped and solid red pillows, creating an inviting space for relaxation. A light beige throw blanket is draped casually over the cushion. Above the seat, three staggered wooden shelves display a collection of books and decorative items. A dark-colored adjustable wall-mounted lamp provides focused lighting for reading. A window with a wooden frame offers a view of lush tropical greenery, including palm trees and flowering plants. The room's walls are lined with narrow vertical panels painted in a light cream color. A vintage-looking surfboard stands beside the window seat.

victorian_893.jpg.title: Hallway with Eiffel Tower Mural
victorian_893.jpg.description: A hallway features a large mural of the Eiffel Tower, creating an immersive Parisian view. The hallway is decorated with white walls, door frames, and a built-in shelf. The neutral-toned rug complements the overall decor, while a vase of flowers and a coat add a touch of warmth.

traditional_613.jpg.title: Elegant Dining Room with Rustic Accents
traditional_613.jpg.description: A well-lit dining room features a rustic wooden table surrounded by upholstered chairs with nailhead trim. A modern chandelier hangs above the table, which is adorned with floral arrangements and candles. A large grid-patterned mirror leans against the wall, reflecting the natural light from the windows. The walls are painted a warm beige, and the room is accessorized with sconces and a dark wood console table. The space is designed with a blend of rustic and contemporary elements, creating an inviting and stylish atmosphere.

contemporary_594.jpg.title: Cozy Living Room with Staircase and Bookshelves
contemporary_594.jpg.description: This image showcases a stylish and inviting living room featuring a unique staircase design. The space is anchored by a large area rug and centered around a black coffee table. An orange daybed provides a pop of color, complemented by a wooden stool. Floor-to-ceiling bookshelves filled with books add a touch of intellectual warmth. The staircase, with its open risers and minimalist railing, adds a modern architectural element. The room's color palette includes neutral tones, punctuated by the orange daybed and colorful book spines.

rustic_19.jpg.title: Barn-Style House Exterior
rustic_19.jpg.description: An eye-level, full shot presents the exterior of a modern barn-style house, set against a backdrop of trees and a hazy mountain range under a partly cloudy sky. The house features a symmetrical facade with vertical wooden plank siding, a metal roof, and two decorative cupolas. A stone pathway leads to a front door flanked by windows and bordered by meticulously arranged landscaping. Various plants and small shrubs create a natural aesthetic in front of the house, while a paved section is visible on one side. The overall composition conveys a sense of rural elegance and modern design.

tropical_693.jpg.title: Elegant Open Concept Living and Dining Area
tropical_693.jpg.description: This image showcases an elegant open-concept living and dining area with a seamless transition to an outdoor lush garden. The space features a high, wood-paneled vaulted ceiling, a stone-clad fireplace, and warm hardwood flooring. A modern spherical pendant light hangs above the dining table, which is surrounded by six chairs. A curved white sofa sits near the fireplace, creating a cozy seating area. A grand piano is placed near the large sliding glass doors that open to the vibrant green landscape, complete with a waterfall feature. The color palette is dominated by warm wood tones, complemented by the natural greens of the outdoors, creating a sophisticated and inviting atmosphere.

asian_736.jpg.title: Modern Bathroom with Double Vanity
asian_736.jpg.description: This image showcases a contemporary bathroom featuring a double vanity with sleek, minimalist design. The light wood cabinetry provides a warm contrast to the white marble countertop, creating a clean and airy atmosphere. Each vanity is equipped with a modern black faucet and a rectangular mirror, one of which is illuminated with LED lighting. A small window with blinds offers natural light, complemented by the light-colored walls. The floor is tiled in a dark gray, adding depth and grounding the space. A wooden stool is tucked neatly beneath the vanity, adding a touch of natural texture. The overall aesthetic is one of sophistication and functionality, perfect for a modern home.

farmhouse_826.jpg.title: Rustic Western Bar Design
farmhouse_826.jpg.description: A beautifully designed home bar with a rustic western theme. The bar features a wooden plank facade, a concrete countertop, and three industrial-style pendant lights hanging above. Leather bar stools provide seating, and a black and white portrait of a cowboy adds to the western aesthetic. The bar is backed by a brick wall with open shelving displaying various bottles. White shiplap siding and a rustic wooden door complete the design.

traditional_175.jpg.title: Organized Spice and Sauce Drawers
traditional_175.jpg.description: This image features two neatly organized wooden drawers, likely in a kitchen setting. The top drawer is filled with an assortment of spices in various jars and containers, arranged for easy access. The bottom drawer contains a collection of hot sauces in diverse bottles, also arranged neatly. The drawers are likely located adjacent to a stainless steel oven, with a light-colored countertop above. The wooden cabinets have modern, rectangular metal handles, and the floor is made of light-colored wooden planks. The overall impression is one of efficient kitchen organization and aesthetic appeal.

mediterranean_231.jpg.title: Cozy Kitchen with Dutch Door
mediterranean_231.jpg.description: A charming kitchen corner featuring a dark brown Dutch door with brass hardware, wooden floating shelves adorned with kitchenware and plants, a wooden cabinet base with open storage and counter space, and a small dog sitting patiently on the hardwood floor. The room is naturally lit through a window, highlighting the warm color palette.

transitional_490.jpg.title: Luxurious Covered Patio Lounge
transitional_490.jpg.description: An elegant covered outdoor living space featuring a vaulted white ceiling with exposed beams and a modern ceiling fan. The space includes a symmetrical furniture arrangement with comfortable lounge seating and is framed by French doors and wall sconces. The flooring appears to be natural stone pavers, and there are subtle landscaping elements visible.

mid-century-modern_135.jpg.title: Mid-Century Modern Bedroom with Wood Paneling
mid-century-modern_135.jpg.description: A stylish bedroom featuring warm wood paneled walls and a sloped white ceiling. The space includes a modern platform bed with chartreuse upholstered headboard and white bedding accented with coral pillows. Wall-mounted brass sconces provide lighting, and there's a modern wooden nightstand. A decorative wall hanging and framed artwork complete the decor.

shabby-chic-style_643.jpg.title: Feminine Vanity Corner with Pink Walls
shabby-chic-style_643.jpg.description: A elegant vanity corner featuring a white vintage-style desk with a gilded ornate mirror. The walls are painted in a soft pink shade, complemented by string lights. Fresh purple flowers in white vases add a romantic touch. A plush upholstered chair in beige adds comfort and sophistication.

scandinavian_54.jpg.title: Modern Farmhouse Kitchen with Open Dining Area
scandinavian_54.jpg.description: Spacious open-concept kitchen featuring a large island with farmhouse sink, black dome pendant lights, and hardwood flooring. The space flows into a dining area with large windows offering natural light. A vintage-style rug adds warmth to the modern design. The kitchen includes dark countertops and wood cabinetry with a mix of contemporary and rustic elements.

traditional_161.jpg.title: Modern Gray and White Bathroom with Glass Shower
traditional_161.jpg.description: A clean, contemporary bathroom featuring a frameless glass shower enclosure with gray subway tile walls. The space includes plantation shutters for natural light control, a white vanity cabinet, and a mosaic tile floor. The shower has multiple fixtures and a built-in niche.

mediterranean_225.jpg.title: Gray Farmhouse Kitchen Cabinetry Detail
mediterranean_225.jpg.description: Close-up detail of custom kitchen cabinetry featuring weathered gray wood finish. The cabinet design includes raised panel doors and drawers with black hardware. A stone veneer accent wall is visible on the right side.

transitional_484.jpg.title: Modern Black and White Bathroom with Green Accents
transitional_484.jpg.description: A clean, contemporary bathroom featuring a black vanity cabinet with chrome hardware, white subway tile walls, and black and white hexagon floor tiles. The space is brightened by a large window with white curtains and decorated with vibrant green fiddle leaf fig stems in a vase. A framed artistic print adds a pop of color to the wall.

coastal_168.jpg.title: Modern White Kitchen with Hexagonal Backsplash
coastal_168.jpg.description: Luxurious contemporary kitchen featuring white cabinetry, a large central island with gray-washed wood paneling, and white marble countertops. The space is illuminated by clear glass globe pendant lights with brass hardware. A striking hexagonal tile backsplash in white adds geometric interest, while brass fixtures and hardware provide warm accents.

mid-century-modern_121.jpg.title: Modern Vintage Bathroom with White Subway Tile
mid-century-modern_121.jpg.description: A compact bathroom featuring floor-to-ceiling white subway tile with dark grout. The space includes a wooden storage cabinet and vintage-style fixtures. The room leads to a hallway visible through a doorway, showing dark hardwood flooring. The ceiling has flush-mount lighting fixtures and appears to be painted white.

scandinavian_40.jpg.title: Space-Saving Built-in Bed Nook
scandinavian_40.jpg.description: A cleverly designed built-in bed nook featuring a light wood headboard with integrated storage and desk functionality. The bed has orange bedding and white pillows, with a wall-mounted industrial-style reading lamp above. The vertical wooden wall paneling and minimalist design creates a cozy, efficient sleeping space.

shabby-chic-style_657.jpg.title: Rustic Farmhouse Kitchen with Natural Light
shabby-chic-style_657.jpg.description: A bright, airy kitchen featuring exposed wooden ceiling beams painted white, large windows bringing in natural light, and a blend of rustic and modern elements. The space includes a wooden farmhouse table, white cabinetry, and a traditional range hood. Fresh flowers in a vase and potted plants add natural elements to the space.

contemporary_580.jpg.title: Modern Mountain View Living Room
contemporary_580.jpg.description: Contemporary open-concept living room with floor-to-ceiling windows offering mountain views. Features high ceilings, reclaimed wood accent wall, and modern furnishings. The space flows into a dining area with red accents.

southwestern_278.jpg.title: Modern Desert Home Exterior
southwestern_278.jpg.description: Contemporary southwestern style home exterior with adobe-style architecture featuring a tan stucco finish. The property includes desert landscaping with native plants, decorative gravel, and architectural cacti. A clean driveway leads to an attached garage, and the entrance is accented by modern outdoor lighting and thoughtful xeriscaping.

asian_722.jpg.title: Japanese Garden Corner with Bonsai
asian_722.jpg.description: A peaceful corner of a Japanese-inspired garden featuring a sculpted bonsai tree, stone lantern, and dry riverbed design. The area is bordered by a bamboo fence and includes a thoughtfully arranged rock garden with various sized stones and emerging ornamental grasses.

farmhouse_832.jpg.title: Modern Farmhouse Master Bedroom
farmhouse_832.jpg.description: A bright and airy master bedroom featuring exposed wooden beams, French doors, and a sophisticated blend of modern and rustic elements. The room showcases a large upholstered bed with layered bedding in whites and blues, flanked by matching nightstands and wall sconces.

modern_932.jpg.title: Modern Luxury Kitchen with Island
modern_932.jpg.description: Spacious contemporary kitchen featuring a large central island with integrated appliances. Floor-to-ceiling windows provide natural light and garden views. The space combines dark wood cabinetry with white surfaces and metallic accents.

mid-century-modern_647.jpg.title: Modern Farmhouse Corner Kitchen
mid-century-modern_647.jpg.description: Bright corner kitchen featuring navy blue lower cabinets, white subway tile backsplash, open shelving, and brass fixtures. The space showcases a corner sink setup with a modern faucet and natural light from a window. The design combines contemporary and traditional elements with clean lines and mixed metals.

shabby-chic-style_131.jpg.title: Elegant White Dining Room with Geometric Chandelier
shabby-chic-style_131.jpg.description: A bright, airy dining room featuring a round white table with slipcovered dining chairs. The space is anchored by a modern geometric box chandelier in black metal. A fresh green plant adds organic texture while a decorative bowl centerpiece completes the sophisticated look. Natural light floods in through Roman shades.

tropical_63.jpg.title: Coastal Stairway with Tropical Mural
tropical_63.jpg.description: An elegant staircase corner featuring a hand-painted tropical mural with palm trees and ocean scenery. The space includes a traditional wooden staircase with turned balusters, a blue and white wallpapered wall, and a framed seascape painting. A decorative upholstered bench with tufted cushioning adds a sophisticated touch.

traditional_607.jpg.title: Luxury Media Room with Custom Bar
traditional_607.jpg.description: A high-end basement media room featuring a large flat-screen TV displaying sports content, complemented by a custom live-edge wood bar counter. The space includes coffered ceilings with recessed lighting and glass pendant fixtures. A plush brown sectional sofa provides comfortable viewing, positioned on a rust-colored area rug. The room demonstrates excellent entertainment space planning with modern amenities.

mediterranean_543.jpg.title: Elegant Modern White Bedroom Suite
mediterranean_543.jpg.description: Luxurious master bedroom featuring a modern design with attached bathroom. The space showcases a monochromatic white color scheme with hardwood flooring. A statement glass chandelier serves as a focal point. The room includes framed artwork arranged in a grid pattern and connects to a bathroom through an archway.

coastal_21.jpg.title: Modern Zen Bathroom Design
coastal_21.jpg.description: A spacious, contemporary bathroom featuring a seamless glass shower enclosure, white subway tile wainscoting contrasting with large format grey wall tiles. The room includes a freestanding soaking tub, floating vanity, and natural wooden accessories. A vertical window provides natural lighting.

transitional_309.jpg.title: Modern Coastal Kitchen with Rattan Bar Stools
transitional_309.jpg.description: A contemporary kitchen featuring a white marble backsplash, black range hood, and four woven rattan bar stools. The space includes gold pendant lights, floating shelves, and a clean white countertop with brass fixtures. The kitchen combines modern and coastal elements with dark cabinetry and natural textures.

mid-century-modern_874.jpg.title: Modern Zen Garden Path
mid-century-modern_874.jpg.description: A contemporary garden pathway featuring concrete pavers set in black gravel, bordered by drought-tolerant ornamental grasses and yellow flowering plants. The space includes modern landscape lighting and a pergola structure in the background, creating a serene, low-maintenance garden design.

traditional_834.jpg.title: Organized Custom Walk-In Closet
traditional_834.jpg.description: A meticulously organized walk-in closet featuring custom white built-in shelving and hanging rods. The closet showcases color-coordinated clothing arranged by type and shade, from light to dark. Upper shelving contains storage boxes and designer bags. The space includes a crystal chandelier and multiple hanging sections for different clothing categories.

modern_701.jpg.title: Modern Home Exterior Night Lighting
modern_701.jpg.description: Contemporary two-story home exterior at night featuring dramatic landscape lighting, floating concrete walkway steps with LED underlighting, and wood accent facades. The property showcases professional landscaping with well-lit lawn areas and decorative rock beds between pathway sections.

french-country_748.jpg.title: Modern Lounge Seating with Hanging Plants
french-country_748.jpg.description: A minimalist seating arrangement featuring two Platner-style wire chairs with light cushions against a whitewashed brick wall. Dramatic hanging plants cascade down the wall in metal planters, creating an organic contrast to the industrial elements. A small round black side table sits between the chairs with a simple vase decoration.

industrial_649.jpg.title: Modern Industrial Staircase with Geometric Screen
industrial_649.jpg.description: An architecturally striking staircase installation featuring a dramatic black geometric screen wall made of vertical metal panels. The screen follows the ascending line of white stairs against a white brick wall, creating a strong contrast and contemporary spatial division.

farmhouse_601.jpg.title: Modern Gray and White Bathroom with Pull-out Storage
farmhouse_601.jpg.description: A contemporary bathroom featuring a gray vanity cabinet with brass hardware and a clever pull-out storage solution. The space showcases herringbone pattern white tile backsplash, black-framed windows, and a built-in bathtub. The design incorporates modern sconce lighting and minimalist decor elements.

southwestern_293.jpg.title: Bathroom Vanity and Mirror
southwestern_293.jpg.description: This image shows a bathroom with a dark wood vanity and a light colored rug. The vanity has two mirrors, one large and one small, and a light fixture above the smaller mirror. There are two wall sconces on either side of the mirrors. The countertop is a light colored granite or marble and the sink is dark. There is a small chair tucked into the vanity area. The rug is rectangular and lies on a tile floor.

coastal_183.jpg.title: Coastal Twin Bedroom with Coral Art
coastal_183.jpg.description: A cozy attic bedroom featuring two twin beds with white bedding and striped bed skirts. Matching coral fan art prints hang above each bed. A pendant light with a square shade provides ambient lighting. The room has white shiplap walls and a sisal or jute area rug.

eclectic_908.jpg.title: Vibrant Laundry Room with Floral Wallpaper
eclectic_908.jpg.description: A well-lit laundry room featuring floral wallpaper on the ceiling and a long runner rug leading to a back door. The room includes blue cabinetry with brass hardware, white front-loading washer and dryer, and a hanging rod for clothes. Natural light streams in through the door, illuminating the space and highlighting the colorful decor.

craftsman_319.jpg.title: Warm Kitchen with Wood Accents
craftsman_319.jpg.description: This kitchen showcases warm wood cabinetry and a unique backsplash. The wooden cabinets are a rich, medium tone, and the backsplash features a mix of green and yellow tiles. A wooden range hood complements the cabinets, and the ceiling is also clad in wood, adding to the room's warmth. Three pendant lights hang above the island, providing focused lighting. Stainless steel appliances add a modern touch, and a window provides natural light.

coastal_197.jpg.title: Elegant Living Room Design
coastal_197.jpg.description: An open-concept living room showcases a refined design with a focus on natural light and neutral colors. The space is anchored by two white sofas with an array of pillows, complemented by two armchairs with light-colored upholstery. A dark rectangular coffee table, adorned with a book and floral arrangement, sits in the center. The room is grounded by a subtle geometric-patterned area rug. Architectural details include arched doorways, recessed lighting, and a pair of elaborately patterned wooden doors that lead to the exterior. Artwork adorns the walls, adding visual interest. A decorative console table sits near the entryway, and a glimpse of greenery is visible through the doors. The overall aesthetic is clean, bright, and sophisticated.

shabby-chic-style_0.jpg.title: Charming Dining Room with Mid-Century Accents
shabby-chic-style_0.jpg.description: This image showcases a bright and airy dining room with a delightful blend of mid-century modern and contemporary design elements. The room is anchored by a round, white dining table surrounded by four blush pink tulip chairs with gold legs, placed on a cowhide rug. Above the table hangs a Sputnik-style chandelier, providing a glamorous touch. A console table with a large round mirror and a table lamp is positioned against a wall adorned with a vibrant green leaf-patterned wallpaper, adding a pop of color and nature-inspired design. The adjacent kitchen features white cabinetry and stainless steel appliances, completing the seamless flow of the open-concept space. Overall, the room exudes a welcoming and stylish atmosphere.

asian_905.jpg.title: Minimalist Interior with Elevated Platform
asian_905.jpg.description: This image showcases a minimalist interior design featuring a raised wooden platform area. The platform holds two simple wooden chairs facing a window, allowing natural light to illuminate the space. Along the walls are various pieces of furniture including a dark wood cabinet and displayed artwork. A notable feature is the dark, square recess in the ceiling, adding a unique architectural element to the room.

tropical_678.jpg.title: Tropical Bedroom Oasis
tropical_678.jpg.description: This image depicts a bright and airy bedroom exuding a tropical and serene ambiance. The room features a four-poster bed with a dark wooden frame, a neutral-toned bedspread, and a matching wooden bench at its foot. A comfortable chaise lounge is positioned near a large window offering a view of lush greenery. The room is decorated with framed botanical prints, a decorative fan, and a jute rug, complemented by a mix of wooden and light-colored furnishings.

farmhouse_615.jpg.title: Classic White Kitchen
farmhouse_615.jpg.description: A well-lit kitchen featuring white cabinetry, stainless steel appliances, and wooden countertops. A large farmhouse sink is visible on the left, with a pot rack hanging overhead. The appliances are integrated seamlessly into the cabinetry, creating a cohesive look. The wooden floor adds warmth to the space.

southwestern_287.jpg.title: Elegant Bathroom with Exposed Beams
southwestern_287.jpg.description: An elegantly designed bathroom features a warm and inviting color palette complemented by dark wooden accents. The eye is drawn to the exposed wooden beams that run across the ceiling, adding a rustic yet sophisticated touch. Below, a vanity with a dark countertop houses two sinks, reflecting light from the multiple vanity lights above. A large mirror stretches across the length of the vanity, enhancing the sense of space. A deep soaking tub sits beneath a window with a view of greenery outside, suggesting a tranquil and private setting. A patterned rug adds a pop of color to the room, while a cushioned bench invites relaxation. A framed artwork hangs on the wall, completing the sophisticated look of the space.

farmhouse_173.jpg.title: Charming Porch Design
farmhouse_173.jpg.description: Front view of a house showcasing a quaint porch design. The entrance features a wooden front door surrounded by windows, providing a warm and inviting feel. The porch has classic white columns supporting the roof, with ceiling fans visible above. Seating areas are arranged with wicker chairs and ceramic stools, complemented by potted plants. The steps are made of brick, leading up from a gravel pathway lined with various flowers and greenery. The overall color scheme is neutral with pops of color from the plants and door.

french-country_984.jpg.title: Closet with Drawers and Doors
french-country_984.jpg.description: Close-up of a built-in closet featuring two doors at the top and two drawers beneath. The cabinetry is painted a soft gray with a subtle wash effect, highlighting the panel detailing. Black knobs serve as hardware on both the doors and drawers. The closet is framed by a white wall with panel molding to the left and the edge of an open door on the right, with the doorknob in clear view. Light streams in from the door opening, casting soft shadows on the surrounding surfaces.

modern_715.jpg.title: Modern House with Outdoor Fire Pit
modern_715.jpg.description: A modern two-story house with large windows is showcased at dusk. A gravel-covered patio features a concrete fire pit surrounded by chairs. Stepping stones lead toward the house amidst ground cover plants. A wooden fence borders the yard, with lights illuminating the landscape.

contemporary_219.jpg.title: Cozy Kitchenette with Wooden Accents
contemporary_219.jpg.description: A bright and cozy kitchenette featuring a butcher block countertop, white cabinetry, and a light wood plank ceiling. Natural light streams in through two windows above the sink, highlighting the clean and minimalist design. A small square planter with faux grass adds a touch of greenery to the space.

industrial_885.jpg.title: Stylish Industrial Kitchen
industrial_885.jpg.description: A well-lit modern industrial kitchen features exposed brick walls and light wood floors. A central wooden island with three leather-topped stools serves as a focal point. The kitchen cabinets are a mix of white and glossy blue-grey, with pendant lights hanging above the island. A black framed door is visible on the left, and various decorative items adorn the walls.

coastal_35.jpg.title: Coastal Bay Window Seating Area
coastal_35.jpg.description: A bright and airy coastal-themed bay window seating area. Three large arched windows frame a stunning ocean view. A cushioned window seat stretches along the base of the windows, adorned with decorative pillows in shades of blue and light turquoise. A rustic wooden trunk serves as a coffee table, decorated with a white coral fan and a floral arrangement. Light gray armchairs face the window seat, completing the inviting space. The overall aesthetic evokes a sense of calm and relaxation, perfect for enjoying the beautiful seaside scenery.

mid-century-modern_860.jpg.title: Outdoor Kayak Storage Rack
mid-century-modern_860.jpg.description: A wall-mounted storage rack displaying multiple kayaks and paddleboards against a white exterior wall. The rack features a tiered design with three levels holding colorful watercraft including yellow and red kayaks and a green paddleboard. The rack is mounted under a roof overhang with some greenery visible in the background.

rustic_739.jpg.title: Live Edge Walnut Window Sill Counter
rustic_739.jpg.description: A stunning natural edge walnut slab installed as a window sill or counter, featuring dramatic wood grain patterns and a natural crack/void. The piece runs along multiple windows with honey-colored wood trim. The slab shows rich walnut coloring and has been finished to highlight its natural beauty.

victorian_878.jpg.title: Minimalist Scandinavian Kitchen Detail
victorian_878.jpg.description: A clean, modern kitchen featuring floating wooden shelves displaying kitchenware and decorative items. The scene includes a white countertop with a candleholder and cookbook stand. The shelving showcases a mix of black plates, glass containers, and small plants.

coastal_829.jpg.title: Nautical Bunk Room with Ocean View
coastal_829.jpg.description: A coastal-inspired bunk room featuring built-in twin beds arranged perpendicular to a large window with water views. The room has white built-in bunks with storage drawers underneath, navy and white striped bedding, and decorative red accent pillows. A geometric pendant light fixture hangs from the ceiling, and a coordinating blue plaid area rug covers the floor. A patterned Roman shade adorns the window.

traditional_820.jpg.title: Modern Pantry Organization with Produce Storage
traditional_820.jpg.description: A well-organized kitchen pantry featuring floating wooden shelves displaying glass storage jars, and a lower section with wire produce baskets containing colorful fruits. The space includes a marble or quartz countertop, wooden cutting boards, and a modern toaster. The storage system demonstrates efficient use of vertical space with clear containers for dry goods and organized fruit storage.

contemporary_231.jpg.title: Modern Herringbone Marble Shower
contemporary_231.jpg.description: Luxurious bathroom featuring a frameless glass shower enclosure with herringbone pattern marble tile walls. The shower includes multiple matte black fixtures including body sprays, handheld shower, and rain shower head. Adjacent is a modern wall-mounted toilet and floating wood vanity.

french-country_774.jpg.title: Modern Two-Tone Kitchen with Navy Island
french-country_774.jpg.description: Contemporary kitchen featuring a striking navy blue island with X-detail paneling contrasting against white perimeter cabinets. The space includes glass globe pendant lights, stainless steel appliances, and a white quartz or marble countertop. The backsplash features white subway tiles, and hardwood flooring adds warmth to the design.

industrial_675.jpg.title: Modern Industrial Bathroom with Glass Partition
industrial_675.jpg.description: A contemporary bathroom featuring a striking black-framed glass partition wall. The space showcases white subway tile walls, hardwood flooring, and a luxurious marble countertop with an undermount sink. The adjacent bedroom is visible through a doorway, revealing dark accent walls and light bedding.

transitional_70.jpg.title: Navy and White Powder Room
transitional_70.jpg.description: An elegant powder room featuring a two-tone wall treatment with navy blue paint above white wainscoting. The space includes wall-mounted sconces with white shades, a traditional pedestal sink, and framed botanical artwork. The room demonstrates a perfect balance of classic and contemporary design elements.

rustic_711.jpg.title: Rustic Basement Bar with Lantern Lighting
rustic_711.jpg.description: A cozy basement bar area featuring custom wood cabinetry with glass-front display cases, wrought iron lantern pendant lights, and a raised bar counter with upholstered bar stools. The space showcases warm ambient lighting and stone flooring.

transitional_335.jpg.title: Modern Dining Room with Black Shelving Unit
transitional_335.jpg.description: A sophisticated dining area featuring a black built-in shelving unit with decorative glass vessels and books. The dining set includes navy blue upholstered chairs around a dark wooden table. A fresh greenery centerpiece adds organic appeal. Modern pendant lights hang above, creating ambiance.

mid-century-modern_848.jpg.title: Modern Blue Townhouse Exterior at Dusk
mid-century-modern_848.jpg.description: Evening exterior view of a renovated urban townhouse featuring a striking blue painted brick facade. The three-story structure shows warm interior lighting through multiple windows. Modern architectural details include clean lines, contemporary windows, and thoughtful landscape lighting. The entrance level features glass doors and built-in planters with architectural vegetation.

victorian_850.jpg.title: Modern Gold Bathroom Faucet
victorian_850.jpg.description: A minimalist brushed gold single-handle faucet mounted on a white porcelain sink against a black beadboard wall. Water is running from the faucet, creating a clean, contemporary bathroom aesthetic. A white electrical outlet is visible in the background.

mediterranean_594.jpg.title: Luxury Kitchen with Fireplace Feature Wall
mediterranean_594.jpg.description: Elegant kitchen space featuring a dramatic floor-to-ceiling fireplace wall with geometric wallpaper pattern. The room includes custom cream-colored cabinetry, a large center island with granite countertop, wrought iron chandelier, and marble flooring. The fireplace is flanked by glass doors and the space showcases high-end finishes throughout.

craftsman_457.jpg.title: Luxury Kitchen Bar with Dark Wood Columns
craftsman_457.jpg.description: An elegant kitchen bar area featuring dark stained wood columns and cabinetry. The space includes a wooden bar counter with leather bar stools, pendant lighting, and hardwood flooring. The design incorporates crown molding and a wood-paneled ceiling treatment.

coastal_801.jpg.title: Modern Coastal Mudroom with Built-ins
coastal_801.jpg.description: A bright and airy mudroom featuring floor-to-ceiling white built-in storage cabinets with a wooden bench seat. The space includes shiplap walls painted in light gray, geometric floor tiles in gray and white, and a glass-paneled entry door. Natural light floods the space through the door windows, and decorative elements include woven storage baskets and minimal decor.

traditional_808.jpg.title: Traditional Green Living Room with Garden Views
traditional_808.jpg.description: A luxurious living room featuring deep green walls and exposed wooden beams. The space is anchored by a large window with floral curtains overlooking a garden. The room combines rich textures with a mix of seating including velvet upholstery and plaid patterns. A prominent blue Oriental rug adds contrast to the green theme.

victorian_688.jpg.title: Intimate Bar Nook with Exposed Brick
victorian_688.jpg.description: A cozy, intimate bar alcove featuring exposed brick walls, warm lighting, and built-in wooden shelving. The space includes recessed ceiling lights and a pendant chandelier creating ambient lighting. Custom wood wainscoting lines the lower walls, with glass bottle storage and display shelving above.

craftsman_331.jpg.title: Traditional Brick Home Entry
craftsman_331.jpg.description: Front entrance of an upscale residential home featuring a covered porch with brick and stone facade. The entryway includes landscaping with black mulch beds and young plants. A brick paver porch floor adds warmth and character.

scandinavian_97.jpg.title: Modern Minimalist Shower Detail
scandinavian_97.jpg.description: A contemporary shower space featuring vertical gray tile walls with a high horizontal window. The space includes a wooden bench holding coral-colored towels and dark glass bottles. A modern black shower fixture is mounted on the wall.

shabby-chic-style_680.jpg.title: Elegant Bedroom with High Ceilings
shabby-chic-style_680.jpg.description: A bright and airy bedroom featuring high vaulted ceilings and neutral tones. A white wooden bed with white bedding dominates the scene, complemented by matching white nightstands and dresser. Soft natural light streams in through the French doors, adding to the serene atmosphere. Framed artwork hangs above the nightstand on the left, and a round mirror sits above the dresser on the right.

eclectic_920.jpg.title: Bright Bathroom with Chevron Floor
eclectic_920.jpg.description: A bright bathroom features a corner bathtub beneath a window with potted plants. A wooden cabinet wraps the tub, complemented by two small wooden stools. A white toilet sits near the wall, adorned with decorative metal wall art and a sconce. The dark gray herringbone floor adds a modern touch, contrasting with the white walls and door.

transitional_453.jpg.title: Elegant Bathroom Vanity with Makeup Area
transitional_453.jpg.description: This image showcases a luxurious bathroom featuring a large vanity with a makeup area. The vanity is painted in a soft gray color and topped with a light-colored countertop, likely marble or quartz. It has ample storage with drawers and cabinets. A large mirror is centered above the sink area, reflecting the shower and natural light coming from a window with blinds. Flanking the mirror are two tall cabinets. To the right, there's a dedicated makeup area with a small vanity and a decorative mirror, along with a red cushioned stool. The flooring appears to be a light-colored tile or marble. The overall design aesthetic is clean, elegant, and bright.

shabby-chic-style_858.jpg.title: Inviting Backyard Pool
shabby-chic-style_858.jpg.description: An inviting rectangular swimming pool with clear blue water is centered in a lush backyard. A large rock accents the foreground edge of the pool. Stone pavers surround the pool, leading to well-manicured greenery and shrubbery. A charming house with a visible dormer window and porch is visible in the background, with trees lining the landscape.

industrial_113.jpg.title: Bright Kitchen with Island and Wooden Floors
industrial_113.jpg.description: A bright, well-lit kitchen features an island with a white countertop and wooden bar stools. The kitchen is equipped with stainless steel appliances, white cabinets, and a tiled backsplash. Natural light floods the room through a set of windows above the sink. Open shelving displays colorful dishware, and pendant lights hang from the ceiling.

tropical_888.jpg.title: Backyard Pool with Waterfall
tropical_888.jpg.description: This image showcases a luxurious backyard featuring a beautifully designed swimming pool with a rock waterfall. The pool is surrounded by a light-colored stone patio and lush green lawn, creating a serene and inviting outdoor space. Mature trees provide shade and add to the natural ambiance of the landscape. In the background, expansive green fields stretch to the horizon, enhancing the sense of openness and tranquility.

contemporary_557.jpg.title: Modern Kitchen with White and Wood Accents
contemporary_557.jpg.description: A well-lit kitchen features a combination of sleek white upper cabinets and warm wood lower cabinets, creating a modern and inviting space. The countertops are a neutral gray, complemented by a white herringbone tile backsplash. A stainless steel stove and range hood are centrally located, and a colorful framed artwork adds a touch of personality. The overall design is clean, functional, and aesthetically pleasing.

tropical_650.jpg.title: Tropical Landscaping Design
tropical_650.jpg.description: A lush tropical landscaping design featuring a variety of colorful plants arranged in garden beds along the front of a light blue house. The landscaping includes bromeliads, crotons, and bird of paradise plants, accented with dark mulch and stone borders. A palm tree stands near the house, enhancing the tropical feel. The house features a light-colored roof and white trim, with visible exterior lighting fixtures.

industrial_107.jpg.title: Modern Conference Room
industrial_107.jpg.description: A well-lit modern conference room with exposed ductwork, brick walls, and a large whiteboard featuring diagrams. The room is furnished with a long, dark table surrounded by black rolling chairs. Natural light pours in through a large window.

scandinavian_766.jpg.title: Modern Farmhouse Exterior
scandinavian_766.jpg.description: The exterior of a modern farmhouse is captured in this daytime shot. The house features a white facade, a black metal roof, and black-framed windows. A glass garage door reveals a white car inside. The driveway is concrete, and landscaping includes plants in rectangular planters. The sky is blue with light clouds.

asian_939.jpg.title: Minimalist Bedroom Interior
asian_939.jpg.description: A minimalist bedroom with light wood paneling and a compact design. Features include a built-in closet with sliding doors, a small doorway, and a mini-split air conditioner mounted on the wall. The room is decorated with a few small items on the wall and a colorful patterned bedspread.

farmhouse_629.jpg.title: Elegant Home Office Setup
farmhouse_629.jpg.description: A sophisticated home office features custom-built dark green cabinets, open shelving with decorative items, a wall-mounted flat-screen TV, and a wooden desktop with gold hardware. A black leather office chair is positioned at the desk, contributing to the room's organized and stylish atmosphere.

tropical_644.jpg.title: Elegant Palm-Lined Home Entrance
