french-country_871.jpg.description: Close-up shot of dark wood cabinets with Fleur-de-Lis shaped brass knobs. The knobs are prominent against the darker wood, and a shadow adds depth. The image highlights the detail of the knobs and the wood grain.

modern_838.jpg.title: Green Oasis Front Yard
modern_838.jpg.description: A vibrant and well-manicured front yard features a lush lawn, diverse greenery, and striking rock landscaping. The main house has a light green exterior with white-framed windows and a covered porch. A detached garage or secondary structure stands in the background, surrounded by trees. The foreground showcases a variety of plants, including a large agave, ground cover, and decorative rocks, creating a natural and inviting scene.

tropical_955.jpg.title: Coastal Home Exterior
tropical_955.jpg.description: A charming coastal home with a white exterior is nestled among lush greenery and palm trees under a clear blue sky. A garden filled with flowering plants and a low stone wall with a wooden fence add to the property's curb appeal. The house features a prominent wooden front door, a second-story balcony with wooden shutters, and carefully landscaped grounds.

farmhouse_938.jpg.title: Bright Kitchen with Two-Tone Cabinets
farmhouse_938.jpg.description: A bright and cheerful kitchen features white upper cabinets and sea green lower cabinets, providing a fresh and modern look. A stainless steel oven and microwave complement the color scheme, while a small island with a wooden countertop adds functionality and warmth to the space. The white subway tile backsplash and wooden floors enhance the overall aesthetic.

asian_88.jpg.title: Eclectic Staircase with Tile Risers
asian_88.jpg.description: This image showcases an eclectic staircase design, featuring light wood treads contrasted with vibrant, patterned tile risers. The staircase has a dark metal railing with wooden handrails, leading up a white wall adorned with a circular golden mandala. Underneath the stairs, there's built-in wooden storage. The entrance to a room is seen with a wooden door and frame, adding warmth. Light-colored wood flooring complements the staircase's natural tones. A small stool and a decorative mirror add detail to the hallway beside the staircase.

asian_628.jpg.title: Modern Bathroom Retreat with Freestanding Tub
asian_628.jpg.description: This is a luxurious, modern bathroom featuring a freestanding, oval bathtub as its centerpiece. The tub is positioned in front of a large picture window, offering a view of a lush green forest. Above the tub, three pendant lights with round, white shades provide soft illumination. A wooden shelf runs along the wall above the tub, holding decorative items. The bathroom has a contemporary feel with gray tiles, glass-enclosed showers on either side, and minimalist fixtures. A woven basket with a rolled towel and a small vase add organic textures to the space.

southwestern_372.jpg.title: Cozy Living Room with Stone Fireplace
southwestern_372.jpg.description: A warm and inviting living room is centered around a stone fireplace with a wooden mantel. A large television is mounted on the wall to the right of the fireplace. The room features a large window offering a view of the outdoors. The furniture includes a sectional sofa, wooden coffee tables, and leather ottomans. The floor is covered with an ornate rug. The walls are painted in a neutral tone, and recessed lighting provides illumination. Decorative items are placed throughout the room, including artwork above the fireplace and on the wall near the television.

scandinavian_877.jpg.title: Cozy Nursery Interior
scandinavian_877.jpg.description: A well-lit and cozy nursery interior featuring a chest of drawers, a cloud mobile, and various decorative elements. The room has a light and airy feel with a geometric triangle patterned wallpaper and a wooden floor. A beanbag chair and a small chair provide seating, while a basket offers storage. The overall ambiance is calm and inviting, perfect for a child's space.

modern_186.jpg.title: Modern Bathroom with Rectangular Sink
modern_186.jpg.description: This image showcases a modern bathroom with a rectangular concrete sink set into a light-colored countertop. The vanity is a dark brown with sleek, minimalist hardware. Two chrome faucets are mounted on the wall above the sink, and a vase of pink flowers and a candle add a touch of color and warmth to the space. A large mirror hangs above the sink, reflecting the bathroom's features. The walls and floor are covered in large format gray tiles, and a shower area is visible to the left. Hanging light fixtures with multiple bulbs provide ambient lighting. Overall, the bathroom exudes a contemporary and sophisticated style with a focus on clean lines and neutral colors.

eclectic_625.jpg.title: Stylish Home Bar Setup
eclectic_625.jpg.description: A stylish home bar setup featuring a metal-framed bar cart with multiple drawers and shelves. The cart is well-stocked with various liquors, glassware, and bar tools. Above the cart hangs a large abstract artwork in black and white. A white vase with greenery and red berries sits on the cart, adding a touch of nature. A bar stool is partially visible on the right side of the frame. The walls are painted in a muted blue-gray tone, creating a sophisticated backdrop.

farmhouse_910.jpg.title: Elegant Kitchen Interior
farmhouse_910.jpg.description: A kitchen featuring a stainless steel refrigerator with a wine rack, light grey upper cabinets, a stainless steel oven, dark wood flooring, an island with dark wood base and light countertop, and bar stools.

scandinavian_687.jpg.title: Bright Modern Kitchen
scandinavian_687.jpg.description: A well-lit, modern kitchen featuring white cabinetry, light countertops, and gold hardware. A black gas range with a double oven sits below a white range hood. The backsplash is white subway tile. A wooden cutting board and a Buddha statue add decorative touches. A gold faucet is visible against a window with plants on a wooden shelf. Wood floors and a few potted plants provide warmth and natural elements.

shabby-chic-style_775.jpg.title: Elegant Bathroom Design
shabby-chic-style_775.jpg.description: This image showcases an elegant bathroom featuring ornate white mirrors flanking a double vanity with light blue cabinets and gold hardware. A freestanding white bathtub sits near a window with white shutters. The walls are adorned with a subtle patterned wallpaper in light blue and white. The room has white flooring and ceiling, creating a bright and airy atmosphere. A stylish green glass pendant light hangs above the bathtub.

rustic_182.jpg.title: Reflective Rustic Retreat
rustic_182.jpg.description: A scenic view of a grand, rustic-style home reflected in a tranquil body of water at dusk. The house features a mix of stone and wood construction, with large windows and multiple chimneys. The warm interior lights create a welcoming glow, mirroring in the water to create a serene atmosphere. The surrounding landscape includes grassy areas and hints of foliage, enhancing the natural beauty of the scene. The sky is soft with pastel hues of pink and orange, suggesting either sunrise or sunset.

mediterranean_307.jpg.title: Luxury Home with Pool
mediterranean_307.jpg.description: An exterior shot of a luxurious home featuring a beautiful swimming pool. The house is painted white with a red tile roof and black window frames. Lush landscaping surrounds the building. Reflections of the house and sky are visible in the pool.

mediterranean_461.jpg.title: Elegant Kitchen Island with Dark Cabinetry
mediterranean_461.jpg.description: This image showcases a bright and modern kitchen featuring a large island with a white countertop and dark base. The island is decorated with a vase of leafy branches and a bowl of fruit, and two golden stools are tucked underneath. Dark cabinetry lines the wall, accented with gold hardware. Natural light streams in through a window with a beige shade. The overall design creates a sophisticated and inviting space.

traditional_725.jpg.title: Romantic Garden Scene
traditional_725.jpg.description: A beautiful garden scene featuring an archway covered in white and purple flowering vines. The archway frames a green hedge backdrop with a large, green ceramic water feature in front. Several potted plants and lush greenery surround the area, creating a serene and inviting atmosphere.

farmhouse_71.jpg.title: Rustic Powder Room
farmhouse_71.jpg.description: This image showcases a stylish and well-designed powder room with a rustic touch. The focal point is a unique sink area, featuring a thick, reclaimed wooden countertop mounted on a gray-toned vanity with three drawers and gold pulls. Above the sink, a round mirror with a leather strap hangs against a backdrop of vertically stacked wood-look tiles. Flanking the mirror are two sconces, providing soft, ambient lighting. A towel ring on the right wall holds a patterned towel, and the walls are painted in a soft blue hue. The overall design combines rustic elements with contemporary touches, creating a warm and inviting space.

mid-century-modern_765.jpg.title: Modern Bathroom with Large Window
mid-century-modern_765.jpg.description: A bright and modern bathroom features a large window with a wood frame that offers a view of an outdoor garden. The garden contains cacti and other desert plants. The bathroom includes a white bathtub, a wooden vanity with a white countertop, and dark gray tile flooring. Natural light floods the space.

french-country_859.jpg.title: Walk-In Closet with Built-In Shelves
french-country_859.jpg.description: An interior shot of a walk-in closet featuring built-in shelves on both sides, contrasting with the warm tones of the wood flooring. The walls are painted in a neutral tone, enhancing the brightness from the overhead light. A wooden rod is installed for hanging clothes, adding functionality to the space.

modern_810.jpg.title: Cozy Fireplace Setting
modern_810.jpg.description: A warm and inviting living room scene showcases a modern fireplace with a sleek black frame. Flames dance behind the glass, illuminating the simulated logs. Above the fireplace, a dark wood mantel provides a display surface for a large, abstract art piece featuring blue and white tones, possibly depicting a landscape. Symmetrical shelving units flank the fireplace, adorned with decorative vases and organic shapes. The wall behind the fireplace is clad in a light-colored, horizontal-patterned material, contrasting with the soft beige of the surrounding walls. Recessed lighting is positioned above the fireplace, casting a gentle glow. A single orchid adds a touch of nature. The flooring appears to be light-colored wood, adding to the bright and airy feel of the room.

industrial_780.jpg.title: Modern Bathroom with Stone Texture
industrial_780.jpg.description: A sleek and modern bathroom featuring a textured gray stone design, encompassing the walls, floor, and bench. A niche is integrated into the wall, providing storage. A shower fixture stands near a decorative corner with shelves. The room has a minimalist and contemporary aesthetic.

french-country_681.jpg.title: Elegant Mediterranean Courtyard
french-country_681.jpg.description: A charming Mediterranean-style courtyard featuring a round iron patio set with four chairs, placed on a flagstone patio interspersed with low-growing greenery. The patio is surrounded by vibrant flowerbeds with lavender, pink, and yellow flowers. A small fountain stands against the stucco wall of the house, which is adorned with arched windows and sconce lighting. A tree adds vertical interest, and various other plants create a lush, inviting outdoor space.

southwestern_428.jpg.title: Yellow Flowering Bush
southwestern_428.jpg.description: A bright yellow flowering bush takes center stage in an outdoor landscape, surrounded by gravel and with a backdrop of other trees and residential buildings under a blue sky with scattered clouds.

modern_804.jpg.title: Modern Home Bar with Dark Cabinetry
modern_804.jpg.description: A modern home bar features dark cabinetry with open shelves, a gray countertop, and three upholstered bar stools. The shelves display glassware, bottles, and decorative items, illuminated by pendant lights. A small sink is built into the countertop. A plant in a black bowl adds a natural element.

asian_172.jpg.title: Cozy Lounge Area with Exposed Brick Wall
asian_172.jpg.description: This image showcases a stylish lounge area featuring a blend of modern comfort and rustic charm. The focal point is an exposed brick wall with a weathered appearance, adding texture and character to the space. A modern fireplace is integrated into a sleek white wall, providing a warm and inviting ambiance. Seating includes a long blue sofa adorned with colorful throw pillows, as well as several round, plush chairs upholstered in a gray fabric. Small round tables are placed around the seating arrangement, perfect for holding beverages or decorative items. The flooring is a light-colored wood-look material that complements the overall design. Overall, the space is designed for relaxation and conversation.

traditional_731.jpg.title: Rustic Soapstone Fireplace
traditional_731.jpg.description: A large, rustic fireplace constructed from soapstone dominates the room, featuring a visible fire burning behind glass doors. The fireplace includes a small oven-like compartment on the left with a wooden-slatted door. Above the firebox is a decorative stone relief. The surrounding room has light wood floors and neutral-colored walls. A kitchen area is visible in the background with white cabinets.

coastal_738.jpg.title: Blue Accent Bathroom
coastal_738.jpg.description: A cozy bathroom with a striking blue accent wall complements the white subway tiles and fixtures. The stained glass window adds a touch of elegance, while the pedestal sink and toilet contribute to the classic design.

victorian_769.jpg.title: Elegant Dining Room with Chandelier
victorian_769.jpg.description: A tastefully decorated dining room features a rustic wooden dining table surrounded by upholstered chairs, illuminated by an ornate chandelier. White shutters filter the natural light, while blush-toned curtains add a soft touch. A patterned area rug grounds the space, and a display cabinet stands against the wall, completing the sophisticated ambiance.

mid-century-modern_771.jpg.title: Modern Kitchen with Black Cabinets and Wood Countertops
mid-century-modern_771.jpg.description: This image showcases a modern kitchen featuring a sleek design with black cabinets and warm wood countertops. The kitchen is well-lit, possibly by natural light from the window above the sink. The countertops are adorned with greenery and various kitchen essentials, adding a touch of life and practicality to the space. Floating shelves add storage and decorative space for plants and small decor. The floors are light wood adding warmth to the kitchen.

shabby-chic-style_761.jpg.title: Charming Bedroom Corner Details
shabby-chic-style_761.jpg.description: A cozy bedroom corner showcasing a blend of vintage and chic design elements. The wall is painted in a soft, muted pink that provides a gentle backdrop for the decorative items. A small, dark wood chest of drawers with multiple small drawers acts as a side table, adorned with a pair of distressed white architectural corbels featuring intricate scrollwork. Above, a framed picture with a white mat and dark frame adds a touch of sophistication to the wall. The edge of a bed with a white wrought-iron headboard is visible, dressed with a patterned bedspread and pink decorative pillows, suggesting a feminine touch. To the right, a glimpse of a white upholstered chair with a high back contributes to the room's elegant and comfortable atmosphere.

eclectic_619.jpg.title: Bed with Built-In Bookcase Headboard
eclectic_619.jpg.description: A cozy bedroom scene featuring a bed with a built-in bookcase headboard. The bed is neatly made with a white quilted bedspread, brown blanket, and orange throw. Two white pillows with a geometric pattern and two orange pillows add to the comfort. The headboard is a rich brown wood with shelves filled with books, decorative items, and framed pictures. A framed artwork is hung on the wall behind the bed. The room is well-lit, creating a warm and inviting atmosphere.

rustic_196.jpg.title: Rustic Living Room with Stone Fireplace
rustic_196.jpg.description: A grand, rustic living room featuring exposed wooden beams supporting a high, vaulted ceiling. A tall stone fireplace stands as the room's focal point, with a traditional black chandelier hanging above it. Comfortable armchairs are arranged around a central coffee table, inviting conversation. Large windows offer natural light and views of the outside. The interior blends natural materials with a refined sensibility, creating a warm and inviting atmosphere.

asian_614.jpg.title: Narrow Kitchen with Garden View
asian_614.jpg.description: This is an image of a narrow kitchen with a view to a garden. The kitchen features wooden cabinets, stainless steel appliances, and green backsplash. Light wooden floors run through the galley layout, leading to an open doorway that reveals a private garden space with fencing and greenery. The design emphasizes natural light and a connection to the outdoors.

farmhouse_737.jpg.title: Modern Kitchen with Rustic Accents
farmhouse_737.jpg.description: A modern kitchen featuring light blue cabinets, a large white countertop island, and rustic wooden beams. The island has dark wood cabinets underneath and is lined with bar stools. An elaborate light fixture hangs above the island, composed of multiple caged pendant lights suspended from a wooden beam. The backsplash consists of multi-colored brick-style tiles, adding texture and visual interest to the space. Stainless steel appliances, including a refrigerator and oven, are visible. Large windows allow natural light to flood the room. The ceiling is vaulted with dark wooden beams, complementing the rustic elements of the kitchen design.

asian_827.jpg.title: Modern Bathroom with Stone Accents
asian_827.jpg.description: A modern bathroom features a large sliding glass door opening to a wooden deck and outdoor space. The interior showcases stone tiling on the floor and accent wall, contrasting with white wall tiles and a sleek vanity. The scene is bright and airy, blending indoor comfort with outdoor serenity.

modern_151.jpg.title: Elegant Kitchen Design
modern_151.jpg.description: A well-designed kitchen features dark blue-grey cabinets complemented by a wooden kitchen island with a marble countertop. A large gold pendant light hangs above the island, illuminating the space. The backsplash is tiled in a neutral tone, and a custom range hood with a wooden accent adds a touch of rustic charm. Branches in a vase serve as a natural element, enhancing the overall aesthetic.

transitional_559.jpg.title: Elegant Navy Blue Kitchen with Island
transitional_559.jpg.description: A well-lit, elegant kitchen featuring navy blue cabinets, a central island, and modern lighting fixtures. The island is topped with a dark countertop, and surrounded by three bar stools. Natural light streams in from a window above the sink. The design incorporates open shelving and a decorative backsplash.

traditional_902.jpg.title: Charming White Brick Cottage Exterior
traditional_902.jpg.description: An exterior shot of a quaint white brick cottage on a sunny day. The house features a dark shingled roof, black shutters, and a small covered porch with white columns. A concrete walkway leads from the sidewalk through a well-manicured lawn to the front door. The house is surrounded by mature trees and landscaping, adding to its charm and curb appeal.

traditional_55.jpg.title: Charming House Exterior with Blue Door
traditional_55.jpg.description: This image captures the charming exterior of a house, highlighting its architectural features and inviting ambiance. The focal point is a vibrant blue front door, complemented by white trim and a covered porch area. The facade is painted in a neutral gray, with decorative shingles adding texture to the upper section. Black shutters flank the windows, providing a striking contrast. The landscape includes fall foliage and decorative pumpkins, enhancing the welcoming atmosphere. The porch is furnished with two wicker chairs and a small table, creating a cozy outdoor seating area. The overall design exudes a sense of warmth and character.

french-country_51.jpg.title: Charming Exterior of French Country Home
french-country_51.jpg.description: A serene outdoor scene showcasing a charming French Country style home surrounded by lush greenery. The house features a steeply pitched roof with dormer windows, a stone chimney, and a neutral-colored stucco exterior. A pergola adorned with climbing plants covers a patio area, extending from the house. The patio leads to a well-manicured lawn. The lighting suggests it's either dusk or dawn, adding a soft glow to the windows and patio. Visible outdoor furniture hints at a space designed for relaxation and entertaining.

mid-century-modern_942.jpg.title: Modern Living Room and Kitchen with Brown Leather Chairs
mid-century-modern_942.jpg.description: This image showcases a modern living room and kitchen space. The living area features two brown leather chairs with chrome frames, positioned on a gray rug in front of a dark brown coffee table with books. A tall green plant stands near a white door, and the light wooden floor adds warmth to the space. The kitchen, visible in the background, includes a dark countertop with bar stools, a black backsplash, and wooden cabinets. Three pendant lights hang above the bar area, adding a pop of color to the scene. The overall design is contemporary and minimalist, with a focus on clean lines and natural materials.

eclectic_194.jpg.title: Bohemian Bedroom with Basket Wall Art
eclectic_194.jpg.description: A cozy bedroom scene featuring a woman arranging a striped lumbar pillow on a king-size bed. The bed is adorned with white and striped textiles, complemented by a live-edge wood headboard. Behind the bed, a collection of woven baskets creates a visually appealing gallery wall. A framed art piece hangs on the left wall, and a sconce provides warm lighting on the right. The room is painted in a deep blue hue, enhancing the bohemian vibe.

victorian_37.jpg.title: Luxurious Traditional Study
victorian_37.jpg.description: A beautifully appointed traditional study features rich wood paneling, a curved window dressed with elegant gold curtains, and a central chandelier. A comfortable sofa is positioned under the window, with a glass-topped coffee table adorned with a bouquet of pink peonies. The room is lit by table lamps and has built-in bookshelves to the side. The overall design exudes warmth and sophistication.

asian_199.jpg.title: Elegant Bedroom with Black and White Accents
asian_199.jpg.description: A well-lit bedroom features a large platform bed with white linens and decorative pillows in black and white patterns. The room is styled with full-length gray curtains that add depth and texture to the walls. Matching dark wooden nightstands flank the bed, each topped with a lamp with a white shade. The room is further decorated with Asian-inspired wall art and a patterned black and white rug that adds a bold contrast to the room's neutral tones. The ceiling is kept clean and features a white ceiling fan.

traditional_1007.jpg.title: Sophisticated Bathroom with Dark Walls
traditional_1007.jpg.description: A stylish bathroom features dark blue-green walls paired with a classic black and white checkered floor. A navy blue vanity with a marble top and gold hardware stands against the wall. Above the vanity, a mirror reflects the room's dark tones. A white clawfoot bathtub is set against the back wall, draped with a light gray shower curtain. Green tiled wainscoting adds a touch of color, and gold fixtures provide a luxurious accent throughout the space.

modern_637.jpg.title: Contemporary Home Exterior
modern_637.jpg.description: Exterior view of a modern two-story house featuring a combination of light-colored stucco and stone accents. Large windows illuminate the interior, reflecting the warm glow of indoor lighting. A small balcony with a metal railing is visible. The house sits on a slightly elevated lot with a concrete retaining wall and lush landscaping, including trees and shrubs. A sidewalk runs along the front of the property, and a street lamp is visible in the distance. The overall composition emphasizes clean lines and a sophisticated, contemporary aesthetic.

modern_623.jpg.title: Modern Bathroom with Dark Tile
modern_623.jpg.description: This is a modern bathroom with a minimalist aesthetic. The dominant color scheme is dark gray and white. The floor and walls are covered in large, dark gray tiles. A light gray wooden door is centrally located, with a sleek silver handle. On either side of the door, there are floating white vanities with square sinks and silver faucets. Mirrors hang above the vanities. To the right of the right vanity is a chrome heated towel rack. Part of a white bathtub is visible in the lower left corner.

traditional_916.jpg.title: Modern Farmhouse Exterior
traditional_916.jpg.description: An exterior view of a modern farmhouse-style home featuring dark blue vertical siding, a light grey metal roof, and wooden accents. The house has a covered porch with seating, and the landscaping includes brick walkways and garden areas. The overall style is modern and rustic, with a clean and simple aesthetic.

craftsman_549.jpg.title: Outdoor Kitchen with Stone Base
craftsman_549.jpg.description: A well-designed outdoor kitchen area with a U-shaped layout. The base is constructed from stacked stones in varied shades of brown and beige, supporting gray countertops. A stainless steel grill is centrally placed, flanked by a sink area on one side with a white farmhouse sink and modern faucet. The flooring consists of large, rectangular stone tiles in various shades of gray and tan, creating a rustic yet elegant look. The kitchen area is surrounded by lush greenery, including trees and bushes, and a black metal fence is visible in the background. Decorative elements include a vase of flowers and a fruit bowl, adding pops of color.

traditional_41.jpg.title: Warm and Inviting Kitchen with Dining Area
traditional_41.jpg.description: This is a well-lit, inviting kitchen and dining area with a warm and earthy color palette. The kitchen features custom green cabinetry, a central island with a contrasting dark wood base and light countertop, and stainless steel appliances. Above the island, pendant lights hang, illuminating the space. The dining area has a round table surrounded by white upholstered chairs, bathed in natural light from the large windows. Hardwood flooring flows throughout the space, contributing to the overall warmth of the design. The walls are painted in a soft, complementary green shade that harmonizes with the cabinetry. The scene creates a comforting and functional culinary and dining environment.

french-country_45.jpg.title: Cozy Living Room with Garden View
french-country_45.jpg.description: This image captures a cozy and inviting living room, bathed in natural light. Two olive-green sofas face each other, flanking a small, round table adorned with pink flowers and books. Above the table, a large painting hangs above the mantel, depicting a landscape scene with trees and a path. Tall curtains with a floral pattern frame the windows, which offer a view of the garden outside. A jute rug covers the floor, adding texture to the space. A ceramic garden stool sits near one of the sofas, adding a touch of whimsy. The overall color scheme is warm and earthy, creating a relaxed and welcoming atmosphere.

mid-century-modern_956.jpg.title: Bright and Modern Kitchen
mid-century-modern_956.jpg.description: This is a well-lit and modern kitchen featuring white cabinets, a kitchen island with yellow shelving, and a sleek range hood. The countertop is a light-colored material with a subtle pattern, while the backsplash consists of textured white tiles. A window above the counter allows natural light to illuminate the space, and a small tree can be seen outside. The floor is hardwood. The overall aesthetic is clean and minimalist.

victorian_23.jpg.title: Elegant and Eclectic Interior
victorian_23.jpg.description: A richly decorated room featuring dark wallpaper with a repeating pattern, ornate gold-framed paintings, a marble fireplace, a built-in cabinet, and comfortable seating arrangements including an armchair and ottoman. The room is illuminated by a chandelier and sconces, creating a warm and inviting atmosphere.

eclectic_180.jpg.title: Modern Home Exterior with Dark Blue Siding
eclectic_180.jpg.description: A modern home with dark blue siding stands amidst a forest. The home features a combination of board and batten siding on the lower level and horizontal siding on the upper level. A wooden deck extends from the upper level, supported by a wooden post. The house has a dark grey roof and black window frames. The yard is landscaped with large rocks and small evergreen trees. The surrounding forest features tall, mature evergreen trees.

rustic_169.jpg.title: Modern Mountain Home Exterior
rustic_169.jpg.description: Exterior view of a modern mountain home with light wood siding, a metal roof, and a long driveway leading up to a two-car garage with glass doors. The house is situated in a landscape with mountains visible in the background under a partly cloudy sky. The landscaping includes newly planted shrubs and trees.

farmhouse_723.jpg.title: Cozy Living Room with Rustic Elements
farmhouse_723.jpg.description: A charming living room features a neutral color palette with natural accents. The room is centered around a fireplace with a light-colored mantel, decorated with artwork and decorative objects. A wooden coffee table in front of a white sofa holds a bowl of pinecones, a vase with a flower, and a stack of books. Two large fig plants flank either side of the room, adding a touch of greenery. The windows are adorned with light-colored curtains, and a rustic chandelier hangs from the ceiling. The overall style is casual and inviting, with a blend of rustic and farmhouse elements.

asian_833.jpg.title: Modern Kitchen Interior
asian_833.jpg.description: A well-lit, modern kitchen featuring a color scheme of white, grey, and black. The kitchen includes white upper cabinets with a grey accent strip above, grey lower cabinets with a black countertop, a black range hood, and a white tile backsplash. A built-in unit houses a microwave and open shelving for decorative items. The floor is tiled in white, enhancing the brightness of the space.

contemporary_449.jpg.title: Modern Kitchen with Wood Accents and Staircase
contemporary_449.jpg.description: This image showcases a modern kitchen with clean lines and a blend of natural and contemporary elements. The kitchen features two long countertops, one with gray cabinets and a light-colored countertop, and the other with wooden cabinets and a darker countertop. Stainless steel appliances are integrated into the design. The floors are light wood, adding warmth to the space. Above, concrete beams are visible, adding an industrial touch. Beyond the kitchen, a staircase with metal railings leads to an upper level. A bookshelf filled with books is partially visible on the right side. The overall design is a mix of modern and rustic styles.

modern_145.jpg.title: Modern Kitchen with Island and Scenic View
modern_145.jpg.description: A modern kitchen features a large gray island with a white countertop and two wooden stools. Three glass pendant lights hang above the island. The kitchen has white cabinets along the wall with a matching countertop and backsplash. A large window offers a view of a green hillside and mountains. A sliding glass door leads to an outdoor patio with furniture.

rustic_141.jpg.title: Rustic Home Office with Bookcase
rustic_141.jpg.description: An interior shot showcases a rustic home office featuring wood paneled walls, a corrugated metal ceiling, and a large bookcase filled with books. A wooden desk sits in front of a window providing natural light, with an office chair positioned for use. The room is illuminated by recessed lighting and a ceiling fan, contributing to a warm and inviting atmosphere. A neutral-toned rug covers the floor, adding to the room's cozy feel.

craftsman_207.jpg.title: Cozy Craftsman Dining Room
craftsman_207.jpg.description: A warm and inviting dining room featuring Craftsman style elements. The room is painted in soft shades of green and yellow, complemented by rich wood trim. A round wooden table is surrounded by matching chairs, and the space is illuminated by a decorative hanging light fixture. Artwork adorns the walls, and a glimpse into the adjacent kitchen reveals a person standing by the sink.

tropical_766.jpg.title: Tropical-Themed Outdoor Living Space
tropical_766.jpg.description: This vibrant outdoor living space features a tropical theme with bright turquoise walls, colorful furniture, and island-inspired decor. A rustic wooden coffee table is placed in front of a weathered green daybed adorned with colorful throw pillows in shades of blue, yellow, and red, including two decorative fish-shaped cushions. A table with brightly colored chairs sits beneath the covered area, adjacent to a bar adorned with a thatched roof, a whimsical lizard sculpture, and a painting. The floor is a textured concrete, and the ceiling features a fan and turquoise support beams, enhancing the tropical atmosphere.

southwestern_399.jpg.title: Rustic Bathroom with Copper Accents
southwestern_399.jpg.description: A rustic bathroom features a double vanity with a wood cabinet base and a hammered copper countertop. Two vessel sinks made of copper are centered on the countertop, each paired with a dark metal faucet. Above the vanity, a large framed mirror reflects the rest of the bathroom, including stone walls and a glass-enclosed shower. The stone walls contribute to the rustic aesthetic of the space.

scandinavian_644.jpg.title: Stylish Entryway with Bold Blue Wall
scandinavian_644.jpg.description: An inviting entryway features a bold blue wall adorned with a large floral art print and a modern wooden dresser. A white table lamp sits atop the dresser, providing soft lighting. A doorway leads to a well-lit bathroom with patterned tile flooring and a round mirror above a sleek vanity.

french-country_124.jpg.title: Cozy Living Room with Stone Fireplace
french-country_124.jpg.description: A warm and inviting living room scene with a large stone fireplace as the focal point. The room features exposed wooden beams, light wood flooring, and neutral-toned furniture accented with pops of orange and black. A variety of fall decorations, including pumpkins and gourds, are arranged on the fireplace mantel, adding to the cozy and festive atmosphere. Two wooden chairs flank a wicker basket in the foreground, while a glimpse into an adjacent room reveals a hallway with artwork on the walls.

asian_63.jpg.title: Modern Bathroom with Floating Vanity
asian_63.jpg.description: A modern bathroom features a floating vanity cabinet with six drawers and a white vessel sink. The vanity has a white countertop and a dark wood-toned cabinet. A frameless rectangular mirror hangs above the sink, flanked by small floating shelves. The wall behind the vanity is covered in a matching dark wood panel. The floor is tiled in a dark gray.

industrial_743.jpg.title: Rustic Dining Area with Live Edge Table
industrial_743.jpg.description: A dining area features a large, square, live-edge wood dining table with a light finish and metal legs. The table is set with a white bowl, a wooden cutting board with fruit, and decorative items. Seating is provided by a mix of wooden chairs with metal frames and a matching wooden bench. The room has a rustic, industrial vibe with a concrete wall backdrop adorned with framed artwork. A wooden sideboard with drawers sits against the wall, adding storage space. A dark, textured rug grounds the space beneath the table. Floral arrangement in a tall vase stands beside the sideboard.

scandinavian_122.jpg.title: Bright and Airy Living Room with Eclectic Accents
scandinavian_122.jpg.description: A bright and airy living room showcases a blend of modern and bohemian elements. The space is anchored by a large, intricately patterned Persian rug with deep reds and blues. Two rustic, dark wooden stools are placed centrally in front of a sleek white marble coffee table, which holds a cactus in a white pot, a small wooden tray, and a stack of books. A light gray sofa with throw pillows provides comfortable seating, complemented by a wooden-framed armchair draped with a sheepskin throw. A tall fiddle leaf fig tree adds a touch of greenery, while a large framed monochrome cityscape print hangs on the wall. The dining area in the background features a long wooden table surrounded by black chairs and a modern chandelier.

traditional_69.jpg.title: Mudroom with Built-in Storage and Pets
traditional_69.jpg.description: A well-organized mudroom featuring built-in storage solutions and two adorable dogs. The mudroom boasts a series of white lockers with drawers at the bottom, cushioned seating, and overhead cubbies. Hooks are mounted on the back panels of the lockers, providing convenient storage for coats and bags. The lockers are arranged against a blue wall, creating a pleasant contrast. The dogs, one white and one brown, are sitting on the cushioned seats, adding a touch of warmth to the scene. Baskets, bags, and clothing items are neatly placed in the lockers, enhancing the room's functionality and aesthetic appeal.

coastal_937.jpg.title: Elegant Hallway with Window Seat and Bar
coastal_937.jpg.description: An elegant hallway with a window seat, a built-in bar, and a view to a distant room with a scenic view. The window seat is fitted with a cushioned pad, illuminated by a large window with black frames and a neutral-toned blind. The walls are lined with white shiplap, complemented by a sconce of geometric design. The built-in bar features white cabinetry, a marble countertop with a small sink and a beverage cooler. The floor is covered in light wood planks and a patterned runner. An open doorway leads to a brighter room with a comfortable chair and a coastal view.

craftsman_561.jpg.title: Craftsman-Style Home Entrance
craftsman_561.jpg.description: A charming Craftsman-style home entrance with a welcoming porch. The entrance features a dark wood door with side lights, complemented by a gabled porch roof supported by brick pillars. The house is painted in muted green tones, and the brickwork extends to the steps and driveway, creating a cohesive and inviting exterior.

transitional_203.jpg.title: Modern Bathroom with Gray Subway Tile
transitional_203.jpg.description: This is a modern bathroom featuring a white bathtub enclosed by light gray subway tile, extending from the base of the tub to the ceiling. There's a built-in niche with three shelves in the tiled wall for storage. A showerhead is visible above the bathtub. The room includes a white toilet and vanity, and the floor appears to be light marble. A decorative chandelier-style light fixture hangs from the ceiling, and a small window provides natural light. The door is painted white, and the room has a clean, simple aesthetic.

coastal_923.jpg.title: Elegant Coastal Home Exterior
coastal_923.jpg.description: This image showcases the exterior of an elegant coastal home during twilight. The house is painted in a light gray color and features multiple windows, including dormer windows on the roof. A stone retaining wall with landscaping creates a terraced effect in the front yard, and a patio area with outdoor seating is visible. The surrounding greenery and trees provide a serene backdrop to the property.

french-country_79.jpg.title: Elegant Living and Dining Room
french-country_79.jpg.description: This is a beautifully decorated living room that seamlessly blends into a dining area. The room features warm, inviting tones and classic furniture pieces. The dining area is furnished with a dark wood table surrounded by upholstered chairs, creating an elegant dining setting. Artwork hangs on the wall, adding a touch of color. The living area is centered around a coffee table layered with books and decor. Accent chairs with ottomans are arranged near the fireplace, which is adorned with a round mirror and decorative items. Natural light floods the room through windows dressed with patterned curtains. Overall, the space has a cozy, luxurious feel with a traditional design aesthetic.

transitional_217.jpg.title: Elegant Gray Kitchen with Island
transitional_217.jpg.description: A well-lit kitchen featuring gray cabinets, a central island with a gas stovetop, and a white refrigerator. The cabinets have brushed gold hardware and are complemented by a light countertop. A small oriental rug adds a touch of color. The vent hood is sleek and modern. The kitchen's design is both functional and aesthetically pleasing.

industrial_757.jpg.title: Modern Bedroom with Concrete Accents
industrial_757.jpg.description: A modern bedroom featuring a raw concrete wall as the headboard backdrop, accented by a triptych of abstract art in black and white. The bed is a unique platform design constructed from large, roughly hewn wooden blocks, topped with a light gray linen bedding and a white faux fur throw. Matching black bedside tables flank the bed, each illuminated by small task lamps. A skateboard and guitar lean casually against the wall, adding to the relaxed atmosphere. The overall style is minimalist and industrial chic, with a touch of bohemian flair.

scandinavian_136.jpg.title: Cozy Bedroom with Gallery Wall
scandinavian_136.jpg.description: A well-lit bedroom featuring a minimalist design. The room is anchored by a low-profile wooden bed with a light-colored linen duvet and a chunky knit throw. Above the bed, a gallery wall is composed of several framed art prints and photographs. A black ceiling fan is mounted on the white ceiling, and a pendant light hangs beside the bed. The window is covered with gray linen curtains, and a small wooden stool is placed in the corner.

contemporary_313.jpg.title: Modern Kitchen with Blue Island
contemporary_313.jpg.description: This is a bright, modern kitchen featuring a blue island with a white countertop, surrounded by white chairs with black legs. The backdrop includes sleek black cabinets and a stainless steel range hood, complemented by a geometric tile backsplash. Large windows offer views of lush greenery, enhancing the natural light in the space. The floor is a light wood tone, adding to the airy feel of the kitchen.

scandinavian_888.jpg.title: Bright Dining Area
scandinavian_888.jpg.description: A bright and airy dining area features a large white countertop island with seating for six, illuminated by pendant lights hanging from the ceiling. A large window with a roller blind provides natural light, while sliding glass doors open to a balcony. White walls and minimalist decor contribute to the clean, modern aesthetic.

contemporary_475.jpg.title: Compact Workspace Nook with Natural Light
contemporary_475.jpg.description: A modern, compact workspace nook featuring a tall, narrow window that provides ample natural light and a view of the outdoors. The space is defined by a built-in desk with drawers and a cushioned stool. The color palette is neutral, with beige walls and cabinetry. A small potted plant adds a touch of greenery. The design emphasizes simplicity and functionality.

modern_179.jpg.title: Modern Gray Kitchen with Wine Rack
modern_179.jpg.description: This is a modern kitchen featuring gray cabinetry and countertops. The space includes upper and lower cabinets, open shelving with decorative bowls and plates, and an integrated wine rack. A stainless steel oven is centered in the lower cabinets. The walls and backsplash are a textured gray, complementing the overall color scheme. Accessories include wooden bowls, utensils, and a white countertop appliance. Natural light enters from a nearby window.

scandinavian_650.jpg.title: Playful Kids Room with Natural Light
scandinavian_650.jpg.description: This is a bright and inviting kids' room that balances playful elements with a touch of minimalist design. A large window floods the room with natural light, framed by sheer white curtains and a charming garland of white pennants. A round table with white chairs sits near the window, a perfect spot for crafts or tea parties. The floor is covered with a textured jute rug, adding warmth and a natural touch. A unique bunk bed structure dominates one corner, crafted from light wood and accessed by a simple ladder. The beds are piled with cushions and throws in neutral colors and playful patterns. Black triangle decals adorn the wall near the bunk bed, adding a touch of whimsy. A wooden rocking horse sits in the foreground, ready for play.

french-country_130.jpg.title: Elegant Master Bedroom
french-country_130.jpg.description: This image showcases a serene and elegant master bedroom with a neutral color palette. The focal point is a large, upholstered headboard bed, dressed with a white duvet and an array of decorative pillows in beige and cream tones. A wooden bench sits at the foot of the bed, adding a touch of rustic charm. The room is lit by bedside lamps on dark wood nightstands. The walls are painted in a soft beige, complementing the light gray carpeting. The arched ceiling with its decorative molding enhances the room's spacious feel. A doorway leads to another room, visible in the background.

asian_77.jpg.title: Cozy Niche Bedroom
asian_77.jpg.description: A compact bedroom features a built-in platform bed nestled into a warm, wood-paneled niche. The bed is adorned with neutral-toned pillows and a patterned throw. Symmetrical sconces flank the headboard, providing focused lighting. A series of framed pictures decorate the wall to the right of the niche, while a row of succulents and a small Buddha statue sit atop a radiator cover by the window.

transitional_571.jpg.title: Elegant Coastal Bedroom
transitional_571.jpg.description: An elegant coastal-style bedroom with a neutral color palette features a tufted headboard, a modern chandelier, and large windows offering a stunning view. The room is decorated with a metal wall sculpture and matching lamps on bedside tables. Light beige curtains frame the windows, and a potted plant adds a touch of greenery.

mid-century-modern_1.jpg.title: Modern Bathroom Vanity with Double Sinks
mid-century-modern_1.jpg.description: A modern bathroom featuring a double vanity with a walnut wood cabinet, a white countertop with two integrated sinks, and matching gold faucets. Above the vanity, two rectangular mirrors with gold frames are symmetrically placed. Sconces with gold fixtures and cylindrical white shades flank the mirrors. The backdrop is a white subway tile wall. A small vase with purple flowers adds a touch of color to the countertop. A shelf below the vanity holds towels and decorative items. The overall design is clean, modern, and sophisticated.

craftsman_213.jpg.title: Bright and Airy Dining and Living Space
craftsman_213.jpg.description: A well-lit and inviting dining and living space is presented. The dining area features a dark wood table with white-painted legs, surrounded by a mix of white and blue upholstered chairs. A simple centerpiece adorns the table, setting a serene tone. In the background, a cozy living area is visible, featuring white armchairs and a navy blue sofa. A fireplace with a TV above it serves as a focal point. The hardwood floors add warmth, while the light-colored walls and large windows ensure ample natural light, creating a harmonious and comfortable environment.

mediterranean_887.jpg.title: Cozy Wine Cellar Nook
mediterranean_887.jpg.description: An intimate wine cellar nook featuring a small, well-lit space dedicated to wine storage and tasting. The design incorporates wooden wine racks on either side of a central barrel table, topped with a bottle of wine, a candle, and a small vase of flowers. The walls are clad in textured stone, creating a rustic atmosphere, while a mural depicting a vineyard scene adds a touch of elegance. Overhead lighting and sconces illuminate the display, highlighting the archway framed by wooden doors. The floor is a light-colored tile, complementing the overall warm and inviting ambiance.

victorian_543.jpg.title: Opulent Bedroom Nook with Canopy Bed
victorian_543.jpg.description: This image showcases a luxurious bedroom nook featuring an elaborate canopy bed and sumptuous decor. The focal point is the bed, adorned with a tufted headboard, ornate detailing, and a decorative chandelier suspended above. Heavy drapes frame the bed, adding to the sense of grandeur. Flanking the entrance to the nook are decorative vases atop ornate stands, and a petite chair with a patterned fabric adds a touch of whimsy. The overall color palette is soft and muted, with blues, creams, and touches of red accentuating the space.

eclectic_355.jpg.title: Cozy Home Library with Rolling Ladder
eclectic_355.jpg.description: This image showcases a stylish home library nook. A built-in bookshelf, painted in a deep teal, houses a collection of books. A rolling wooden ladder provides access to the upper shelves. A window seat with a black and white patterned cushion and a decorative pillow add to the cozy atmosphere. The photograph also features a hallway with vibrant orange door leading to another room, showcasing an eclectic and colorful interior design.

coastal_512.jpg.title: Stylish Bathroom with Green Accents
coastal_512.jpg.description: A well-lit bathroom features a harmonious blend of modern and natural elements. The green subway tile shower area with a black shower rod and white shower curtain creates a refreshing focal point. A light wood vanity with a white countertop, black hardware, and a curved black-framed mirror offers a clean and contemporary feel. The patterned floor tiles add a touch of character and complement the overall color scheme. Decorative shelves with greenery and a framed plant print introduce natural elements.

craftsman_944.jpg.title: Green Garage with White Accents
craftsman_944.jpg.description: A well-maintained green garage stands as part of a two-story building, showcasing a unique combination of architectural design and functional elements. The garage door is a prominent feature, painted in a lighter shade of green with white trim, dividing it into vertical panels with glazed rectangular sections along the top. A shallow awning, clad in similar roofing material as the main structure, protects the entrance. The building is painted in a light green hue, complemented by white corner boards and trim around the windows, creating a clean, crisp contrast. The second story features a window equipped with an air conditioning unit, suggesting a living or working space above the garage. An electrical conduit runs along the side of the building, providing necessary power connections. To the right, a section of the building extends, with a matching window and a small shed roof. A white fence is partially visible in the foreground, subtly defining the property line. The setting is an urban or suburban neighborhood, with greenery visible in the background, suggesting well-maintained landscaping. The image is sharp and well-lit, showcasing the building's architectural details and color palette.

asian_358.jpg.title: Exotic Bathroom with Bamboo Accents
asian_358.jpg.description: This image showcases a unique and exotic bathroom design. The focal point is a spacious walk-in shower with multiple shower heads, complemented by a pebble floor and light-colored wall tiles that mimic wood grain. A curved bamboo screen adds privacy and a touch of nature. A wooden tub sits adjacent to the shower. The bathroom features a mixed flooring of pebble stones and octagonal tiles, adding to the eclectic feel. A doorway leads to a bedroom with a visible bed, connecting the spaces. The overall design blends natural elements with modern fixtures.

farmhouse_290.jpg.title: Elegant Bathroom with Double Vanity
farmhouse_290.jpg.description: A bright and stylish bathroom features a double vanity with a wooden cabinet, black countertops, and white subway tile walls. The sinks are fitted with black faucets, and the mirrors are framed in black with gold accents. A black tray on the counter holds decorative items, and plants add a touch of greenery.

southwestern_602.jpg.title: Cozy Outdoor Courtyard with Fireplace
southwestern_602.jpg.description: This image showcases a charming outdoor courtyard with a Spanish-style aesthetic. The courtyard features a red tiled floor, white stucco walls, and a prominent outdoor fireplace with decorative tile accents. A small seating area is arranged around a low table, comprising of chairs, while additional plants add a touch of greenery. The architecture includes details like a clay tile roof and wrought iron accents, contributing to the space's warm and inviting atmosphere.

modern_390.jpg.title: Wall-Mounted Climbers
modern_390.jpg.description: This is a close-up shot of a wooden wall-mounted plant trellis with climbing plants. The trellis consists of wooden planks running horizontally, with metal bars arranged vertically to create sections. Vines are trailing and climbing through the metal bars, displaying green leaves and bright pink trumpet-shaped flowers. The warm tones of the wood contrast with the cool metal of the trellis and the vibrant green and pink of the flowering vines.

contemporary_844.jpg.title: Modern Kitchen Interior
contemporary_844.jpg.description: A bright, modern kitchen featuring a blend of white and natural wood elements. A large window offers a view of lush greenery, while the countertop is adorned with an espresso machine and snack plates. The kitchen island serves as a focal point with a sleek countertop and seating.

mediterranean_139.jpg.title: Pull-out Trash Cans
mediterranean_139.jpg.description: The image showcases a kitchen with a pull-out trash can system integrated into the cabinetry. Two gray, rectangular trash bins are housed within a wooden cabinet frame, resting on a metal sliding mechanism. The cabinet door, adorned with a decorative panel and a dark handle, is partially open, revealing the bins. The kitchen floor features a patterned tile design in warm earthy tones. The overall design is practical and blends seamlessly with the kitchen's aesthetic.

eclectic_433.jpg.title: Modern House Exterior
eclectic_433.jpg.description: A modern house is pictured in a natural setting, displaying its exterior design. The house features a dark blue or gray color scheme, contrasting with the surrounding green trees. A notable design element is a small balcony with metal railings extending from the second story. The landscaping includes large rocks and minimal greenery, enhancing the natural feel of the setting.

coastal_274.jpg.title: Cozy Attic Sofa Nook
coastal_274.jpg.description: A comfortable and inviting attic space featuring a gray sofa adorned with decorative pillows and a throw blanket, illuminated by recessed lighting. The space is framed by a small window and white-painted walls, creating a cozy nook.

transitional_798.jpg.title: Contemporary Kitchen with Blue Tile Backsplash
transitional_798.jpg.description: A well-lit contemporary kitchen features a large island with a white countertop and light wood panelling. Three black pendant lights hang above the island, illuminating the space. White cabinets with black handles flank a stainless steel range hood, set against a vibrant blue and white patterned tile backsplash. The island is surrounded by white and black bar stools.

victorian_225.jpg.title: Opulent Interior with Candelabra and Velvet Curtains
victorian_225.jpg.description: This image showcases an opulent interior featuring a large, ornate candelabra as a focal point. The candelabra is adorned with multiple lit candles, creating a warm and inviting glow. Flanking the candelabra are luxurious velvet curtains in rich shades of red and purple, embellished with gold trim and tassels, adding a touch of elegance and drama to the scene. The room's design incorporates dark wood paneling with gothic-inspired details, enhancing the room's sense of sophistication and history. A wall sconce provides ambient lighting, and glimpses of the outside world are visible through the window, offering a subtle contrast to the rich, interior elements.

transitional_940.jpg.title: Cozy Nursery Corner
transitional_940.jpg.description: A bright and airy nursery corner featuring a plush, beige rocking chair with two soft dolls, positioned next to a large window with a white Roman shade. A window seat with two playful, round pillows with sleepy faces sits beneath the window. The wall is decorated with subtle star patterns, and a woven basket adds a touch of natural texture to the room.

traditional_269.jpg.title: Classical Porch with Columns
traditional_269.jpg.description: A long, elegant porch with several white, classical columns supporting the roof. The porch floor is painted a light blue-gray, and potted ferns are placed along the side. A traditional lantern-style light fixture hangs from the center of the porch roof. The house has white window frames with open shutters.

coastal_260.jpg.title: Modern White Beach House Exterior
coastal_260.jpg.description: Exterior view of a modern white beach house featuring a unique architectural design with rounded edges, a spiral staircase leading to a rooftop, large windows, and a spacious patio area. The house appears to be constructed from white materials with textural elements resembling smooth rocks or sculpted surfaces. The patio is paved with light-colored tiles, and the scene is bathed in sunlight under a clear blue sky. The building includes what looks like a tower element, adding vertical interest to the structure. A partial view of the sea can be seen in the background. The overall style is minimalist with a touch of whimsy.

eclectic_427.jpg.title: Elegant Kitchen with Contrasting Cabinets
eclectic_427.jpg.description: A well-lit, long, galley-style kitchen featuring contrasting cabinet colors and materials. On the left, blue cabinets with white countertops and a stainless steel range hood complement the dark brown range. White subway tiles form the backsplash. On the right, dark wood cabinets with a white countertop and an apron-front sink provide ample counter space. The floor is light-colored hardwood. A sliding barn door is visible in the background. Recessed lighting illuminates the space, and decorative pendant lights hang over the right countertop. A small rug lies in the center of the kitchen.

victorian_231.jpg.title: Victorian Home in San Francisco
victorian_231.jpg.description: Exterior shot of a tall, narrow Victorian house in San Francisco, California, painted in shades of pale gray and blue. The house has intricate architectural details, including elaborate trim around the windows, a decorative pediment, and a covered front porch with stairs leading up to it. The house is nestled between two other homes of similar design, one painted in a lighter blue and the other in a pale yellow. A man in a beige outfit walks in front of the central house. A streetlight and some plants are also visible, along with some parking space

transitional_954.jpg.title: Bathroom with Plantation Shutters
transitional_954.jpg.description: This bathroom features a walk-in shower with a vintage-style shower head and controls. The walls are covered in light brown horizontal tiles. A window with white plantation shutters allows natural light to filter through, and a floating wooden shelf displays toiletries.

mid-century-modern_229.jpg.title: Cozy Reading Nook with Fireplace and Built-ins
mid-century-modern_229.jpg.description: A warm and inviting reading nook features a textured copper fireplace surround with a decorative screen, flanked by custom built-in shelving and a media center. Two vibrant blue velvet armchairs face the fireplace, complementing the plush area rug and round marble-topped coffee table. A wingback chair in the same blue fabric is tucked into the corner, illuminated by a floor lamp. The room is softly lit by recessed lighting and a modern chandelier.

contemporary_688.jpg.title: Elegant Bedroom with Stunning City Views
contemporary_688.jpg.description: A serene and sophisticated bedroom featuring a king-size bed adorned with light-colored bedding, including a quilted coverlet and plush pillows. A neutral-toned bolster pillow rests on top. Large windows frame a breathtaking cityscape and ocean view, filtered by sheer curtains that allow natural light to fill the space. A small side table with a bouquet of flowers sits beside the bed, while a stylish wall sconce provides ambient lighting. The room is decorated with a large abstract painting in muted tones, contributing to the room's calm and luxurious atmosphere.

modern_384.jpg.title: Modern Bathroom with Glass Shower and Vanity
modern_384.jpg.description: This image showcases a modern bathroom featuring a glass-enclosed shower, a freestanding bathtub, and a sleek vanity. The shower area is tiled with gray and white panels, complemented by a glass door. A white towel hangs on a towel rack inside the shower. Adjacent to the shower is a modern, freestanding white bathtub with wall-mounted faucets. The floor is covered with large gray tiles that extend throughout the bathroom. The vanity area includes a wooden cabinet, a gray countertop, a sink, and a mirror. A decorative mosaic tile backsplash adds a touch of visual interest. The overall design is minimalist and contemporary, with a focus on clean lines and neutral colors.

southwestern_170.jpg.title: Elegant Dining Room with Textured Walls
southwestern_170.jpg.description: An inviting dining room featuring textured terracotta walls, ornate wooden furniture, and a decorative chandelier. Three framed art pieces adorn the wall above the table, enhancing the room's aesthetic appeal.

contemporary_850.jpg.title: Modern Bathroom with Floating Vanity
contemporary_850.jpg.description: A brightly lit modern bathroom features a floating wooden vanity with a white countertop and sink. An oval mirror hangs above the vanity, reflecting light and the vase of pink flowers. A small white stool is positioned beside the vanity, holding a book and a decorative bowl. The walls are painted a neutral white, and the floor is covered with light-colored tiles. A wooden beam is visible near the ceiling, adding a touch of rustic charm.

farmhouse_284.jpg.title: Bright Kitchen with Farmhouse Sink
farmhouse_284.jpg.description: This image showcases a bright and airy kitchen with a classic farmhouse aesthetic. Natural light floods the space through a series of large windows positioned above the kitchen sink. The sink itself is a traditional white farmhouse sink with a bridge faucet. Cream-colored cabinets with brass hardware line the lower portion of the wall, complemented by a light countertop that extends across the length. A stainless steel dishwasher sits to the right of the sink. The rich, dark wood flooring contrasts with the light-colored elements, adding warmth to the room. An intricate rug with red and blue patterns lies on the floor, adding a touch of color and character. Sconces flank the windows, providing additional lighting. The view through the windows reveals lush greenery, enhancing the room's connection to the outdoors. A glass-fronted cabinet stands at the end of the countertop, displaying decorative items. The overall design emphasizes natural light, clean lines, and a harmonious blend of classic and modern elements.

southwestern_616.jpg.title: Cozy Living Room with Southwest Flair
southwestern_616.jpg.description: This inviting living room exudes warmth and character with its Southwestern-inspired design. A large, light-colored sectional sofa anchors the space, adorned with colorful, patterned cushions that echo the rug's rich tones. A stone fireplace serves as a focal point, topped with a framed print of a canyon. Above the sofa, a striking textile panel adds visual interest. Wooden ceiling beams add rustic charm, while the light wood flooring complements the room's natural aesthetic. Accessories like wooden bowls and decorative platters enhance the Southwest theme.

shabby-chic-style_239.jpg.title: Secret Bookshelf Doorway to Closet
shabby-chic-style_239.jpg.description: A creative interior design featuring a secret bookshelf doorway leading into a closet. The bookshelf, filled with books and decorative items, pivots open to reveal a walk-in closet filled with clothes. The room is painted in a soft pink hue, complemented by hardwood floors and a white dresser. The overall aesthetic is both whimsical and practical, blending functionality with a touch of mystery.

craftsman_50.jpg.title: Elegant Bathroom with Clawfoot Tub
craftsman_50.jpg.description: A stylish bathroom showcases a classic clawfoot tub as its centerpiece. The tub is positioned against a backdrop of white beadboard paneling that extends to the mid-wall level, topped by a soothing gray painted upper wall. Two windows framed with white trim and molding allow natural light to filter into the space. The floor is covered with hexagonal tiles, adding a subtle pattern and texture to the room. Beside the tub sits a decorative white stool, adorned with a small vase holding green flowers, providing a touch of nature. A folded gray towel is draped over the edge of the tub, adding a pop of color and a sense of comfort. The room's elegant and serene ambiance is enhanced by the thoughtful combination of textures, colors, and natural light.

mediterranean_893.jpg.title: Swimming Pool and Outdoor Living Area
mediterranean_893.jpg.description: A wide-angle shot showcasing a rectangular swimming pool adjacent to a well-designed outdoor living area. The pool is bordered by light-colored pavers, transitioning into a surrounding landscape of grass and garden beds. Beyond the pool, a patio area features several lounge chairs arranged neatly, providing a space for relaxation. A pergola-covered outdoor kitchen with a grill, bar, and seating enhances the entertainment capabilities of the area. The house, visible in the background, has a light-colored exterior and a green tiled roof, which adds a touch of color to the overall setting. A large umbrella provides shade to a dining table set, creating a comfortable outdoor dining space. The sky is overcast, casting a soft light over the scene.

victorian_557.jpg.title: Elegant Living Room with Detailed Ceiling
victorian_557.jpg.description: This is an elegant living room featuring a coffered ceiling with intricate detailing. The walls are a light, muted green color. The focal point is a cream-colored sofa with decorative pillows. A pair of armchairs upholstered in a similar color flank a coffee table. A gilded mirror hangs above the sofa, reflecting greenery from outside. Two tall windows are dressed with full-length draperies. The room is lit by a decorative chandelier. Additional decorative urns and a small table with a lamp add to the room's sophisticated ambiance.

coastal_506.jpg.title: Stylish Powder Room with Deer Wallpaper
coastal_506.jpg.description: A stylish powder room featuring a striking deer-themed wallpaper in black and white, paired with a marble-topped sink and modern metal stand. A gold towel ring complements the sophisticated design.

eclectic_341.jpg.title: Home Exterior with Deck
eclectic_341.jpg.description: Exterior view of a dark green house with a dark gray shingle roof. A large deck is attached to the back of the house, featuring metal railings and outdoor furniture, including a small round table and chairs. The house is surrounded by lush green vegetation and trees, creating a natural and serene setting.

craftsman_950.jpg.title: Stylish Home Bar with Warm Wood Accents
craftsman_950.jpg.description: A well-appointed home bar featuring a rich wood countertop and backsplash made of white subway tiles. The bar area is illuminated by three pendant lights with glass shades hanging above sleek metal bar stools. Built-in cabinetry with glass shelves displays an array of liquor bottles and accessories. A wine rack is integrated to the side, and a beverage cooler is installed under the counter. The surrounding walls are painted in a light gray, contrasting with the white trim of the staircase in the background. The space is modern and inviting, perfect for entertaining.

french-country_483.jpg.title: Bright Living Room with Fireplace and Built-Ins
french-country_483.jpg.description: A spacious living room is bathed in natural light, showcasing a neutral palette and modern design elements. The focal point is a white fireplace with a marble surround, flanked by built-in bookshelves filled with white shelves. Large windows frame an outdoor scene with trees and houses, while French doors provide access to the outside. The room features gray wood-look flooring, complementing the light gray walls. A ceiling fan with gray blades adds to the room's functionality and style. Recessed lighting provides additional illumination.

industrial_582.jpg.title: Garden Trellis Gate
industrial_582.jpg.description: An outdoor garden features a rusted metal frame with a wooden slat gate. The gate is partially open, revealing a view of the garden beyond. Tall grasses and plants surround the structure, adding to the natural, serene atmosphere.

asian_364.jpg.title: Traditional Japanese Interior with Garden View
asian_364.jpg.description: This image showcases a tranquil Japanese-style interior with a clear view of a lush green garden. The room features tatami mats, shoji screens, and calligraphy scrolls, creating a serene and minimalist atmosphere. The light-colored wood framework and natural materials contribute to the room's peaceful ambiance. A low coffee table and floor seating enhance the traditional Japanese design. The space is well-lit with soft, natural light filtering through the shoji screens, creating a calming and inviting environment.

craftsman_78.jpg.title: Craftsman Style House Exterior
craftsman_78.jpg.description: Exterior view of a craftsman style house with green siding, wood shingles, and stone accents. The house has a prominent front porch with white columns and a wood door. The lawn is well-maintained and there is landscaping with bushes and trees. The sky is blue.

mid-century-modern_567.jpg.title: Elegant Dining Room with Modern Chandelier
mid-century-modern_567.jpg.description: This image showcases a sophisticated dining room featuring a large, live-edge wooden table surrounded by black wishbone chairs. Above the table hangs a modern chandelier comprised of numerous spherical lights suspended at varying heights. The room is bathed in natural light thanks to expansive black-framed windows, offering scenic outdoor views. The interior design blends natural elements with contemporary fixtures.

eclectic_369.jpg.title: Cozy and Stylish Alcove Seating Area
eclectic_369.jpg.description: A view of a cozy and stylish alcove seating area, featuring a grey sofa with throw pillows, a unique patterned wallpaper, and a sunburst mirror. The alcove is painted in a dark grey, contrasting with the lighter elements of the room. A round table with floral arrangement sits in front of the sofa, and a leather ottoman with books is placed to the side. The room is accessorized with wall sconces and decorative items, creating a warm and inviting atmosphere.

traditional_527.jpg.title: Cozy Living Room with Fireplace
traditional_527.jpg.description: A well-organized living room features matching cream-colored armchairs facing a fireplace with built-in bookshelves on either side. A large, patterned area rug ties the seating area together. Above the fireplace is a television, and the room is painted in neutral tones with white trim.

mediterranean_663.jpg.title: Cozy Southwestern Living Room
mediterranean_663.jpg.description: A warmly decorated living room featuring a rustic southwest aesthetic. The room includes two off-white armchairs with red pillows, a brown leather sofa adorned with a patterned throw pillow, and a wooden coffee table. A vibrant area rug with geometric patterns in red, orange, and yellow anchors the space. The room also features a unique fireplace with a curved hearth, topped with a red vase. A large window with white curtains allows natural light to flood the space. A potted plant is positioned in the corner, adding a touch of greenery.

traditional_241.jpg.title: Bright and Elegant Kitchen Dining Area
traditional_241.jpg.description: A bright and elegantly designed kitchen dining area featuring a round dining table with a cream-colored top and a gold base, surrounded by six woven-back chairs with light blue patterned cushions. Overhead lighting includes a large drum pendant light and two spherical pendant lights. The kitchen in the background features white cabinets, a stainless steel refrigerator, and a dark island with a stove.

mediterranean_105.jpg.title: Elegant Kitchen with Custom Range Hood
mediterranean_105.jpg.description: A well-lit, elegant kitchen featuring a stainless steel professional range with double ovens and a custom-built range hood with a wooden accent. The kitchen is finished with light-colored cabinetry, marble countertops, and warm-toned flooring. Natural light streams in through a window, showcasing the exterior brickwork and landscape. Wooden utensils, cutting boards, and a knife block add a touch of rustic charm to the modern space.

rustic_380.jpg.title: Spacious Basement Interior
rustic_380.jpg.description: This image showcases a well-lit and spacious basement interior, designed for entertainment and relaxation. The foreground features a comfortable leather sectional sofa, complemented by a rustic wooden side table. The flooring consists of wood-like planks, which extend into the open layout. A pool table sits prominently in the middle ground, suggesting a recreational area. The room is illuminated by recessed lighting and natural light filtering through windows. A partially visible staircase leads to another level, and a bar area with a stainless steel refrigerator and a barrel-shaped table adds to the room's appeal. The ceiling is adorned with coffered beams, enhancing the architectural detail. Neutral wall colors create a calm atmosphere.

coastal_248.jpg.title: Nautical Bathroom Design
coastal_248.jpg.description: This image showcases a nautical-themed bathroom with a harmonious blend of modern and classic elements. The walls and ceiling are painted in a deep navy blue, providing a striking contrast to the white fixtures and trim. A rectangular mirror with a black frame hangs above a sleek, white floating vanity with a black faucet. To the left, a nautical-style sconce with a cage fixture adds a touch of maritime charm. The floor features a geometric tile pattern in shades of blue and white, complementing the overall color scheme. A white paneled door stands ajar, revealing a glimpse of a bright room with a painting of sailboats. To the right, a glass-enclosed shower with blue tile walls and black hardware completes the scene. The design combines functionality with a distinctive nautical aesthetic, creating a visually appealing and cohesive space.

victorian_219.jpg.title: Elegant Traditional Kitchen
victorian_219.jpg.description: This image showcases an elegant, traditional kitchen with a warm and inviting atmosphere. The kitchen features custom white cabinetry with arched openings, glass-fronted cabinets, and panel detailing. The dark hardwood floors contrast beautifully with the light-colored cabinets, adding depth and warmth to the space. The design includes a bar-like counter area and recessed lighting, enhancing the functional and aesthetic appeal of the kitchen. The overall impression is one of sophistication and timeless style.

mid-century-modern_201.jpg.title: Serene Blue Bedroom
mid-century-modern_201.jpg.description: This image showcases a bedroom designed with a serene and calming ambiance. The focal point is a large bed with a light blue upholstered headboard and matching bedding. The bed is flanked by white nightstands, each topped with a white lamp with a round base. Above the bed, a collection of framed black and white portraits creates a visually interesting gallery wall. The walls are covered in a textured light blue wallpaper, adding depth to the room. A plush blue rug covers the floor, contributing to the overall cozy feel. A textured white bench is placed at the foot of the bed. The room is well-lit and exudes a peaceful atmosphere.

shabby-chic-style_577.jpg.title: Bohemian Bedroom with Woven Accents
shabby-chic-style_577.jpg.description: A bright, airy bedroom features bohemian-inspired decor. A white-painted room with a wooden stool acting as a side table next to a bed. A woven wall hanging complements a braided bench at the foot of the bed. A kilim rug adds a pop of color to the white floor.

southwestern_158.jpg.title: Stylish Home Office with Textured Wall
southwestern_158.jpg.description: An interior shot of a modern home office. The focal point is a geometric textured wall in shades of gold and silver, complemented by grey floating shelves and matching lower cabinets. A white-topped desk with a geometric base stands on a light grey rug, paired with a contemporary chair. A unique, gold-toned chandelier hangs from the ceiling. The room has access to a balcony with a view through wooden-framed glass doors.

contemporary_878.jpg.title: Luxury Outdoor Living Space with Fireplace
contemporary_878.jpg.description: A beautifully designed outdoor living area features a tall, light-gray brick fireplace with a linear gas firebox. The space includes comfortable wooden frame chairs with black and white striped cushions, complemented by a dark wooden coffee table with decorative bowls. A nearby outdoor kitchen is equipped with a grill and countertop space. Overhead, a wooden plank ceiling adds warmth, and a large spherical pendant light fixture hangs above. The area opens to a lush green garden, enhancing the serene and luxurious atmosphere.

scandinavian_485.jpg.title: Bright Modern Kitchen Interior
scandinavian_485.jpg.description: A bright, modern kitchen features white cabinetry paired with light wood accents. A bowl of green apples sits on the countertop, with bar stools positioned beneath the island. The backsplash is light gray, and natural light enters through a window on the left.

asian_416.jpg.title: Modern Japanese Style Kitchen
asian_416.jpg.description: A well-lit kitchen space featuring a modern Japanese design aesthetic. The room is painted in a calming pale blue, providing a serene backdrop for the wooden cabinetry and light wooden flooring. To the left, a large window with shoji screens allows natural light to filter into the space. The cabinets are a warm-toned wood with sleek, minimalist hardware. A vase with tall branches sits on the countertop, adding a touch of nature. The countertop is a light-colored material, likely quartz or marble.
