The architecture hints at modern or contemporary design elements. Gravel borders the edge of the putting green, adding textural contrast. The lighting suggests a bright, sunny day.

southwestern_881.jpg.title: Desert Oasis Walkway
southwestern_881.jpg.description: A serene outdoor space features a narrow pathway made of beige pavers, leading through a desert landscape. The path is bordered by gravel mulch and native plants, including shrubs with purple and green foliage. Walls of stucco and brick enclose the area, with climbing plants on metal trellises adding a touch of vertical greenery. A mesquite tree provides shade in the background.

asian_303.jpg.title: Outdoor Grill Area with Concrete Tiles
asian_303.jpg.description: This image shows an outdoor grill area. It features a stainless steel grill with a storage unit below, flanked by countertop surfaces made of concrete tiles. A red ceramic kamado grill is visible on the right side, while a smaller grill is on the left. The surrounding flooring is composed of large, light gray concrete tiles. A black wooden fence serves as a backdrop, and greenery is present in the foreground and in pots on the countertops.

rustic_481.jpg.title: Rustic Bunk Room with Reading Nook
rustic_481.jpg.description: This image showcases a cozy, rustic bunk room. The focal point is a built-in bunk bed alcove constructed from rough-hewn wood, featuring a metal ladder for access. Each bunk has a simple mattress, neutral-toned bedding, and patterned pillows. Storage drawers are integrated beneath the lower bunk. To the left, a large window with a dark frame illuminates the room, highlighting a comfortable armchair and ottoman. The room's design elements include a wooden ceiling with a unique light fixture, hardwood flooring, and natural textures that contribute to the room's rustic charm.

coastal_549.jpg.title: Modern Kitchen with Rope Bar Stools
coastal_549.jpg.description: A bright, modern kitchen featuring a breakfast bar with three rope bar stools. The stools have light gray woven rope seats and backs, and wooden frames. The breakfast bar has a gray countertop. Behind the bar is a light gray tile backsplash and white cabinets with silver hardware. A stainless steel range hood is mounted above a cooktop. A fern plant sits on the bar to the left.

traditional_540.jpg.title: Cozy Breakfast Nook with Blue Accents
traditional_540.jpg.description: A charming breakfast nook is featured in this inviting image. A round, dark wood table is centered, surrounded by two black Windsor chairs with wooden arms. Above the table hangs a unique, multi-tiered black chandelier with candle-style lights. The nook is nestled against a large window with a custom blue and white striped roman shade accented with a red trim, under which is a built-in window seat cushioned with a dark blue pad and an array of decorative pillows in various blue, white, and beige patterns. The walls are covered in a subtle, textured wallpaper, adding depth to the space. Outside, a view of a garden is visible through the large windows and glass doors, enhancing the room's connection to the outdoors. A clear glass vase filled with yellow flowers and a bowl of fruit adorn the table, adding a touch of freshness.

mediterranean_604.jpg.title: Inviting Courtyard Patio
mediterranean_604.jpg.description: This image showcases a beautifully designed courtyard patio with a warm and inviting atmosphere. The patio features a rectangular wooden dining table surrounded by modern black chairs. A built-in fireplace with flanking seating areas adds a focal point. Three small windows line the upper wall. The flooring is patterned tile. To the right is an outdoor bar area with bar stools. The walls are painted in a light neutral tone, complemented by the dark trim and roof details. Potted plants add greenery to the space. Wall-mounted light fixtures provide illumination.

mid-century-modern_500.jpg.title: Mid-Century Modern Living Room
mid-century-modern_500.jpg.description: This image showcases a bright and airy living room with a mid-century modern aesthetic. Large windows provide a panoramic view of a lush outdoor setting, allowing natural light to flood the space. The room features a coordinated color palette of blues and greens. Two matching teal armchairs with striped throw pillows are placed near a low, round coffee table. A curved gold floor lamp adds a touch of elegance. A teal side table sits between the armchairs, topped with decorative items. The overall design creates a welcoming and stylish atmosphere.

victorian_518.jpg.title: Elegant Kitchen Interior
victorian_518.jpg.description: An elegantly designed kitchen features dark wood cabinetry, a large central island with seating, and two ornate chandeliers. Marble countertops and backsplash add a luxurious touch, while a light-colored ceiling with recessed lighting enhances the brightness. The floor is laid with a light wood in a herringbone pattern, complementing the overall sophisticated aesthetic.

mid-century-modern_266.jpg.title: Modern Bathroom with Double Vanity
mid-century-modern_266.jpg.description: A stylish bathroom featuring a double vanity with a dark wood finish, gold hardware, and a white marble countertop. Two round gold-framed mirrors are hung above, flanked by sconces mounted on a vertical stripe of patterned tiles. The shower is enclosed in glass with a light blue tile finish, complemented by gold hardware. A decorative vase with dried flowers sits on the countertop between the sinks. A toilet is partially visible to the left.

shabby-chic-style_510.jpg.title: Bathroom Interior Design
shabby-chic-style_510.jpg.description: A bathroom interior featuring a vintage-style wooden vanity with a white countertop, a white toilet, and a glass-enclosed shower. The walls are covered in marble-like tiles, and the floor has light-colored tiles. A potted cactus sits on the vanity, and another plant is on top of the toilet. A blue rug is partially visible in the foreground.

traditional_226.jpg.title: Charming White House with Green Accents
traditional_226.jpg.description: A charming white house with green accents is framed by a leafy tree in the foreground. The house boasts a welcoming porch with white railings and green trim, perfect for enjoying the outdoors. The exterior features a mix of textures, including siding and a shingled roof. A small dormer window adds character to the upper level, while the front yard is neatly landscaped. The overall ambiance is one of tranquility and comfort.

mediterranean_162.jpg.title: Elegant Kitchen and Dining Area
mediterranean_162.jpg.description: A well-lit, elegant kitchen and dining area featuring white cabinetry, wooden accents, and modern light fixtures. The kitchen island has a wooden base with a light blue upholstered bar stool, while the dining area includes a wooden table surrounded by white chairs. The kitchen is equipped with stainless steel appliances and a decorative range hood. Plants and ceramic vases decorate the countertops and dining table, adding a touch of natural elements to the space.

eclectic_468.jpg.title: Eclectic Bathroom Decor with Blue and Gold Accents
eclectic_468.jpg.description: A vibrant bathroom space showcasing a blend of textures and colors. The focal point is a floating wooden vanity with a glossy gold sink and decorative accents. Behind the vanity, a panel of mosaic hexagonal tiles in shades of blue, white, and gold adds depth and visual interest. A silver pendant light hangs above, casting a soft glow. The right side of the image features a wall adorned with blue peacock feather wallpaper and a plant in a white pot with a gold stand. A doorway with a black frame hints at the adjoining space. The overall design is eclectic and luxurious.

industrial_283.jpg.title: Office Lobby with Staircase and Seating
industrial_283.jpg.description: An office lobby featuring a metal staircase with carpeted steps and glass railings. A small seating area is arranged under the lower portion of the stairs, with a patterned armchair, a lamp, and a small side table. To the left of the stairs, a large banner for 'EVOQUA' stands on the landing. In the background, an office area is visible with cabinetry and a service counter. A large window provides natural light. The color palette is muted, with shades of beige, blue-gray, and brown.

contemporary_348.jpg.title: Bright Modern Bathroom
contemporary_348.jpg.description: This is a picture of a bright and modern bathroom. The space is brightly lit with natural light from the windows and skylight. The color palette is predominantly white with touches of blue and natural wood tones. The bathroom features a long vanity with wooden cabinets and a white countertop, a freestanding bathtub with a view of greenery outside the window, and a glass-enclosed shower area. Plants are strategically placed to add a touch of nature to the interior. The overall design is clean and minimalist, emphasizing natural light and open space.

modern_644.jpg.title: Modern Home Sauna
modern_644.jpg.description: A well-lit, contemporary home sauna with wooden interior and glass door. The sauna features horizontal wooden slats for the walls and benches, providing a clean and minimalist aesthetic. A box-like structure sits at the bottom left, possibly for holding sauna stones. The space outside the sauna is tiled and leads to a white wall with a modern sink or counter.

victorian_929.jpg.title: Elegant Bathroom Design
victorian_929.jpg.description: A well-appointed bathroom with an elegant and vintage aesthetic. The room features a clawfoot bathtub positioned near a window with white shutters, allowing for natural light. A vanity with a distressed finish and marble countertop sits beneath a framed mirror flanked by sconces. The walls are painted in a textured neutral tone, and there is a small table with flowers adding a pop of color. The flooring has a subtle pattern. The overall impression is one of luxury and timeless style.

french-country_22.jpg.title: Elegant Kitchen with Stone Floors and Wooden Beams
french-country_22.jpg.description: This is an image of a well-appointed kitchen featuring a large island with a white countertop and three upholstered bar stools. The floor is covered in large gray stone tiles, and wooden beams adorn the ceiling. The kitchen includes white cabinets and a prominent copper range hood. The overall design suggests a luxurious and functional cooking space.

rustic_668.jpg.title: Luxurious Sunroom with Stone Fireplace
rustic_668.jpg.description: This image showcases a luxurious sunroom with a rustic yet elegant design. The room is bathed in natural light filtering through a glass ceiling with exposed wooden beams. A grand stone fireplace serves as the focal point, with a flat-screen television mounted above it. Comfortable seating arrangements flank the fireplace, including a sofa and woven chairs adorned with cushions. A long dining table is set in the foreground, adding a touch of formality. The room is surrounded by large windows that offer views of the outdoor landscape. The overall ambiance is warm and inviting, blending natural elements with sophisticated design.

mid-century-modern_931.jpg.title: Modern Landscape Design
mid-century-modern_931.jpg.description: An elevated view shows a modern landscape design featuring a concrete pathway flanked by contemporary wooden slat fences. The pathway is lined with diverse plantings including pink flowering shrubs, ornamental grasses, and other foliage, set against mulch beds. The fences provide privacy and visual interest, while the plants add color and texture to the outdoor space.

victorian_44.jpg.title: Dark and Moody Bathroom Design
victorian_44.jpg.description: A modern bathroom with a dark and moody aesthetic. The walls and ceiling are painted in a dark gray or black, creating a dramatic backdrop. A large, ornate black-framed mirror hangs above the bathtub, reflecting the room and enhancing the sense of space. The bathtub is set into a light gray tiled surround, with a white tiled backsplash featuring a niche for toiletries and decorative items. A black chair with wooden legs is placed next to the bathtub, and a gray and white striped towel hangs on a hook. Touches of greenery, such as small plants in the niche and a larger plant on the counter, add a natural element to the space.

traditional_971.jpg.title: Kitchen Cabinet Design
traditional_971.jpg.description: This image showcases a kitchen cabinet design featuring drawers of various sizes and depths. The cabinets are made of wood with a dark brown finish on the door fronts and a lighter natural wood finish on the drawer boxes. The drawers are open, revealing their interiors and contents, including bowls. The hardware consists of brushed metal handles.

traditional_26.jpg.title: Gazebo in a Landscaped Garden
traditional_26.jpg.description: This image captures a beautifully landscaped garden featuring a gazebo as the focal point. The gazebo, with its dark roof and light wooden structure, stands on a circular base adjacent to a red gravel area. Tiered retaining walls built of light-colored stones, adorned with various plants and flowers, add depth and texture to the landscape. In the background, trees and a building provide a natural and architectural context. The composition highlights the harmonious integration of constructed elements and natural vegetation.

coastal_978.jpg.title: Cozy Kitchen Corner with Spice Drawer
coastal_978.jpg.description: A warm and inviting kitchen scene featuring a spice drawer, a stove with a red pot, and a cookbook stand. The drawer is filled with various spices, and the stove has a stylish red pot sitting on it. In the background, there's a cookbook stand with a book open, along with a container of wooden utensils. The kitchen has grey tile backsplash, granite countertops, and white cabinetry. The overall atmosphere is homey and functional.

craftsman_248.jpg.title: Elegant Garage Doors with Bracket Details
craftsman_248.jpg.description: A close-up shot showcasing three elegant wooden garage doors, each with a distinct arched window design. The doors are rich brown and accentuated by crisp white trim, including decorative brackets above each door. The garage exterior is covered in light-colored siding, divided horizontally by a darker trim line. The base of the door frames is accented with stacked stone details. The pavement in front of the garage is a patterned brick. The scene captures a blend of classic and contemporary styles with a focus on architectural details.

shabby-chic-style_921.jpg.title: Shabby Chic Dining Room
shabby-chic-style_921.jpg.description: An indoor dining area bathed in natural light features a distressed white dining table adorned with a linen runner and floral centerpieces in shades of purple. The table is surrounded by a mix of seating options, including an elegant cane-backed chair and folding bistro-style chairs. The room is accessorized with a grandfather clock, a chandelier, and other decorative items, all contributing to a shabby chic aesthetic.

eclectic_681.jpg.title: Modern Rustic House with Forest Backdrop
eclectic_681.jpg.description: This image showcases a modern rustic house surrounded by a lush forest. The house features a striking dark blue exterior with a combination of horizontal and vertical siding. A small wooden deck with metal railings extends from the second story. The landscape includes large boulders and newly planted trees, adding a natural element to the modern design. The overall aesthetic is clean, contemporary, and harmonious with the surrounding environment.

tropical_729.jpg.title: Lush Tropical Landscape Design
tropical_729.jpg.description: This image showcases a beautifully landscaped garden with a tropical theme. A lush green lawn curves around a planting bed filled with vibrant bromeliads and other tropical plants. Decorative black rocks create a defined border between the lawn and the garden bed. In the background, a white building is adorned with climbing vines and tall, blue planters. Various palm trees and tropical foliage complete the scene, creating a serene and inviting outdoor space.

modern_122.jpg.title: Modern Kitchen with Island
modern_122.jpg.description: A bright and modern kitchen features white upper cabinets and wood-toned lower cabinets. A white countertop island stands in the foreground with two black stools. The backsplash is white, and a black-framed window provides natural light. Open wood shelving is present on the right wall, and a stainless steel range hood hangs above the stove.

farmhouse_988.jpg.title: Bright Marble Shower with Bench
farmhouse_988.jpg.description: A bright and airy bathroom features a shower enclosed with clear glass, accented by marble-patterned wall tiles and a contrasting dark-toned tile floor. Sunlight streams in through a window, illuminating the space and highlighting the wooden bench placed underneath. The shower fittings, including the showerhead and faucet, are finished in a shiny metal, contributing to the clean and modern aesthetic.

asian_38.jpg.title: Serene Asian-Inspired Garden with Waterfall Feature
asian_38.jpg.description: A meticulously crafted Asian-inspired garden features a multi-tiered waterfall element with stacked slate stone. A Buddha statue and a Japanese lantern adorn the upper levels, surrounded by lush greenery. The water cascades into a pebbled channel, adding to the tranquil atmosphere. The garden is bordered by a modern gray wall and a warm-toned wooden fence, blending contemporary design with traditional Asian elements.

asian_698.jpg.title: Modern Kitchen with Bold Color Accents
asian_698.jpg.description: A modern kitchen featuring a high-contrast color palette with white cabinets, dark countertops, and a bold purple accent wall. A wooden beam frames the kitchen entrance, and wooden stools with blue metal legs sit at the kitchen island. The floor is hardwood.

farmhouse_750.jpg.title: Modern Kitchen Design
farmhouse_750.jpg.description: A bright and modern kitchen featuring a navy blue island with a white countertop and gray bar stools. The cabinets are white with glass-paneled uppers. The backsplash is a textured dark blue tile, and stainless steel appliances and a range hood are visible. Open wooden shelves are above the coffee maker. The floor is light-colored wood, and pendant lights hang over the island.

asian_840.jpg.title: Modern Living Room with Bookshelves
asian_840.jpg.description: A modern living room featuring a large gray sectional sofa with blue accent pillows, centered on a brown rug. In front of the sofa is a round coffee table with decorative vases and books, accompanied by an ottoman. The room boasts a double-height ceiling, with a mezzanine level above showcasing a white bookshelf filled with books and decorative items. Below the mezzanine, a long wooden shelf with additional books and decor runs along the wall. Large windows offer a view of the outside, contributing to the room's bright and airy atmosphere.

modern_136.jpg.title: Modern Kitchen with Island and Wood Accents
modern_136.jpg.description: A contemporary kitchen featuring a central island with a white countertop and seating, contrasted by mixed wood and grey cabinets. Marble backsplash adds elegance.

eclectic_695.jpg.title: Green Tiled Bathroom
eclectic_695.jpg.description: This image depicts a bright and modern bathroom with a focus on green subway tile. The walls are clad in glossy, light green subway tiles arranged in a horizontal pattern. A glass-enclosed shower stall is located in the corner, providing a clear view into the shower area. Inside the shower, there's a built-in niche for toiletries. Adjacent to the shower, a modern vanity features a white countertop and a dark wood cabinet. A rectangular mirror with a gold frame hangs above the vanity. The mirror reflects part of the bathroom, including a decorative star-shaped light fixture. An orchid in a white pot sits on the vanity. The bathroom has a contemporary feel, combining clean lines with a pop of color.

french-country_36.jpg.title: Elegant Dining Area
french-country_36.jpg.description: A bright and airy dining area features a white marble-topped table, a silver centerpiece filled with blue hydrangeas, and a window seat with decorative pillows. Botanical art adorns the wall, adding a touch of nature. A light-colored chair complements the neutral palette.

transitional_258.jpg.title: Elegant Bedroom Design
transitional_258.jpg.description: A bright and airy bedroom featuring a neutral color palette with pops of blue and gold. The focal point is the king-sized bed dressed in a light gray patterned duvet cover, complemented by a blue velvet bench at the foot. Gold decorative accents are clustered on the wall above the bed, enhancing the room's sophisticated ambiance. Natural light streams in through curtained windows, illuminating the space and highlighting the tray ceiling.

victorian_50.jpg.title: Cozy Kitchen with Dining Area
victorian_50.jpg.description: This image showcases a cozy and inviting kitchen design. The kitchen features light green cabinetry on either side of a dark wood floor, creating a balanced and aesthetically pleasing look. A round marble dining table is situated in the center of the kitchen, surrounded by four wooden chairs with black leather seats. The kitchen seamlessly transitions into an adjacent living area, which is painted in a contrasting green hue. The living area features a central wooden table and cozy seating arrangements. Overall, the design creates a warm and harmonious living space.

traditional_965.jpg.title: Inviting Entrance with Arched Doorway
traditional_965.jpg.description: This image showcases a beautifully designed entrance with a dark gray, arched double door partially open, revealing a warm, inviting interior. The door is framed by a beige stucco wall adorned with two lantern-style sconces, one on each side. Two large, weathered stone planters with lush greenery and purple flowers flank the entrance. The floor is made of stone steps, and the arched doorway is accented with brick. Inside, a chandelier hangs from the ceiling, and a dining area with a table and chairs is visible in the background.

modern_650.jpg.title: Elegant Blue Bathroom Vanity
modern_650.jpg.description: A well-appointed bathroom features a double vanity with a calming blue hue. The vanity is flanked by two mirrors with black frames and matching sconces that emit a warm light. A faux Monstera leaf arrangement adds a touch of nature to the space, while the neutral countertop provides a clean contrast to the blue cabinetry.

industrial_718.jpg.title: Eclectic Loft Living Room
industrial_718.jpg.description: An expansive, eclectic loft living room features a blend of industrial and luxurious elements. The exposed ceiling with wooden beams and metal panels adds a rustic touch, contrasted by a crystal chandelier hanging above a long wooden table with floral arrangements. A green velvet sofa is paired with a modern floor lamp and a unique, curved metal chaise lounge. The space is further adorned with a patterned rug and gold-toned coffee tables. The kitchen area is partially visible, with hanging pots and pans and minimalist cabinetry. Wine racks are integrated into the wall on the right, highlighting the room's multi-functional design.

modern_888.jpg.title: Modern Home Exterior
modern_888.jpg.description: This image captures the exterior of a modern two-story house. The upper level features light-colored wooden plank siding and large, square black-framed windows. The roof has a wide overhang and a gray trim. The lower level is finished in a dark brown stucco, with two transparent garage doors framed in black. A set of concrete stairs leads up to the front door. The landscaping includes a tiered retaining wall made of large gray blocks. The overall setting is natural, with trees visible in the background. The aesthetic is clean, modern, and minimalist.

french-country_619.jpg.title: Elegant Black and Gold Living Room
french-country_619.jpg.description: A luxurious living room featuring a black and gold color scheme. The room is anchored by a marble fireplace with a golden chandelier hanging above. Black walls are adorned with framed art and sconces. A black sofa and chairs are arranged around a gold coffee table atop a patterned rug. The flooring is white marble, enhancing the room's opulent feel.

scandinavian_179.jpg.title: Modern Living Room with Kitchen Bar
scandinavian_179.jpg.description: A bright and modern living room scene showcases a minimalist aesthetic. The focus is on a kitchen bar with a light gray countertop, complemented by three white bar stools with wooden legs. A vase with pink blossoms adds a touch of color. In the foreground, a gray sofa is decorated with patterned pillows, sitting on a black and white striped rug. The background features a wall of light wood-paneled cabinets and part of a white kitchen area. The flooring is light wood, contributing to the overall brightness of the space.

traditional_795.jpg.title: Innovative Kitchen Drawer Design
traditional_795.jpg.description: The image showcases a well-organized kitchen drawer, designed to efficiently store pots, pans, and lids. The drawer has a unique layout with a sliding tray specifically for pot lids, optimizing space and preventing clutter. The pots and pans are neatly arranged beside the lid tray, making it easy to locate the desired cookware. The drawer's light wooden finish complements the stainless steel cookware, adding a touch of warmth to the design.

victorian_915.jpg.title: Bright White Bedroom
victorian_915.jpg.description: A serene bedroom features a mostly white color scheme, creating a bright and airy atmosphere. The focal point is a bed with white bedding, complemented by a gray throw. A tall mirror leans against the wall, and built-in wardrobes and storage solutions maximize space in the room. A skylight provides natural light, enhancing the room's brightness.

transitional_270.jpg.title: Bright and Airy Living Room
transitional_270.jpg.description: A well-lit and spacious living room featuring a high vaulted ceiling with wooden beams, a large neutral-toned rug, and a cohesive color palette. The room is furnished with two comfortable armchairs, a long sofa with decorative pillows, and a unique coffee table. Wall-mounted sconces add a modern touch. The bay window is adorned with layered window treatments, combining blinds and striped curtains to let in ample natural light.

coastal_944.jpg.title: Elegant Outdoor Living Space
coastal_944.jpg.description: A serene outdoor living space with a covered patio, featuring rattan furniture, a glass-topped dining table with pink flowers, and retractable shades. The area overlooks a body of water and a neighboring building, with a color palette of light blues, browns, and neutrals.

craftsman_512.jpg.title: Kitchen Sink with Woven Blinds
craftsman_512.jpg.description: A kitchen view showcases a white farmhouse sink positioned beneath three windows adorned with woven bamboo-style blinds. Two industrial-style black pendant lights are mounted on the ceiling, providing illumination. White subway tiles serve as the backsplash, and a lush green outdoor view is visible through the windows. The countertops appear to be light-colored, adding to the bright and airy feel of the kitchen.

contemporary_374.jpg.title: Modern Kitchen with Wood Accents
contemporary_374.jpg.description: A bright, modern kitchen featuring light wood floors, dark wood cabinetry, and exposed wooden beams. A large island with a white countertop and three bar stools stands in the center. Two black pendant lights hang above the island. The kitchen also includes stainless steel appliances and built-in shelving.

modern_678.jpg.title: Modern Bedroom with Accent Wall
modern_678.jpg.description: A modern bedroom showcases a striking contrast with a black accent wall complemented by vertical wood paneling. A beige upholstered headboard is set against the accent wall, layered with white bedding, a chunky grey knit blanket, and multiple pillows. Two pendant lights with glass shades hang on either side of the bed, illuminating the nightstands. A modern black ceiling fan adds a dramatic touch. The room is filled with natural light from large windows that offer a view of lush greenery. The overall aesthetic is clean, contemporary, and inviting.

scandinavian_151.jpg.title: Modern Bathroom with Wood Accents
scandinavian_151.jpg.description: A bright, modern bathroom features natural light and wood accents. A double vanity with a light wood finish and concrete countertop is the focal point, complemented by round mirrors and pendant lighting. A sliding mirrored door partially reveals the shower area, which has white subway tiles. Open shelving adds storage, while a tall cabinet provides additional space. The color palette is neutral, with light wood tones and white walls.

french-country_631.jpg.title: Elegant Living Room with Brick Archway
french-country_631.jpg.description: This image showcases a well-designed living room that seamlessly blends traditional and modern elements. The focal point is a large, rustic brick archway leading into the kitchen area, adding texture and warmth to the space. The living room features comfortable white sofas with blue accent pillows, two neutral-toned armchairs, and a substantial wooden coffee table with a decorative tray. A circular chandelier hangs from the coffered ceiling, providing ample lighting. The adjacent kitchen is visible through the archway, featuring light cabinetry and pendant lighting. To the right, a staircase with dark railings and white risers adds architectural interest.

scandinavian_637.jpg.title: Modern Cabin at Night
scandinavian_637.jpg.description: A modern cabin with a sloping roof and wooden siding is illuminated at night. The cabin features large glass doors that offer a view into the interior, where a kitchen and living area are visible. The exterior is furnished with chairs and a table, creating a comfortable outdoor seating area. Trees surround the cabin, adding to the natural ambiance.

asian_10.jpg.title: Modern Bedroom with Black and White Accents
asian_10.jpg.description: A bright and airy bedroom features a modern aesthetic with a monochrome color palette. A bed with a wooden frame is draped in a gray blanket, facing a woven bench with a white throw. A black accent wall contrasts with the white walls, enhancing the minimalist decor. A plant in a gray pot adds a touch of greenery. The bedroom leads to another room through a black door frame.

tropical_715.jpg.title: Tropical Garden Entrance
tropical_715.jpg.description: A beautiful entryway featuring a lush tropical garden. A pathway of rectangular pavers is interspersed with green grass, leading towards a house. The path is bordered by dark gravel and diverse plantings, including a leaning palm tree and various leafy plants. Two textured columns topped with lantern-style light fixtures flank the entrance, providing a sense of welcome. The house in the background has a light blue facade with white trim and a dark wood door, adding to the serene atmosphere.

contemporary_412.jpg.title: Stylish Bathroom with Penny Tile and Wood Vanity
contemporary_412.jpg.description: This image features a well-designed bathroom with a variety of textures and finishes. The lower half of the wall is covered in black penny tile, topped with a dark wood trim. A modern wood vanity with gold hardware sits beneath a white countertop and sink. A gold faucet and matching soap dispenser add a touch of elegance. The mirror, also framed in gold, reflects a patterned towel. A vase with greenery sits to the right of the mirror, adding a touch of nature. The toilet is visible on the left side.

asian_868.jpg.title: Modern Kitchen with Wooden Accents
asian_868.jpg.description: This image showcases a modern kitchen design with a warm and inviting atmosphere. The kitchen features a U-shaped layout with wooden cabinetry and a central island with a built-in cooktop. The countertops are a contrasting dark color, adding depth to the space. Windows provide natural light, and the grey flooring reflects the light, creating a spacious feel. The kitchen includes modern appliances and a unique wooden structure above the range hood, adding an architectural element. The color palette is primarily wood tones, grey, and touches of white.

eclectic_865.jpg.title: Exterior of a House with Deck
eclectic_865.jpg.description: This image showcases the exterior of a house featuring a spacious deck area. The house has a layered roof design with dark shingles, and a color scheme that blends greens and browns. The deck is constructed with dark wooden planks and a modern black railing, offering a seating area with a round table and chairs. The surrounding landscape includes lush greenery, with trees in the background providing a natural setting.

craftsman_274.jpg.title: Arts and Crafts Style House Exterior
craftsman_274.jpg.description: The exterior of an Arts and Crafts style house is captured in this image. The house features a stone chimney, shingle siding, and multiple windows with dark trim. The lawn is well-manicured and the sky is clear, suggesting a bright day.

transitional_516.jpg.title: Bright and Airy Kitchen with Island
transitional_516.jpg.description: A modern kitchen featuring light blue island with a white countertop, complemented by brown leather bar stools with gold legs. The kitchen has white cabinets, a custom wooden range hood, subway tile backsplash, and two pendant lights with black and gold accents. A golden faucet adds a touch of elegance to the setup.

eclectic_871.jpg.title: Cozy Home Library with Blue Accents
eclectic_871.jpg.description: A cozy home library with floor-to-ceiling bookshelves filled with books. A blue patterned rug anchors the room, complementing the teal settee. A dark coffee table and a small stool add to the room's charm. A cream-colored sofa is visible on the right side, adding a touch of contrast.

craftsman_260.jpg.title: Outdoor Kitchen with Guests
craftsman_260.jpg.description: The image showcases an outdoor kitchen at night, featuring a group of people gathered around a U-shaped bar. The kitchen is constructed with dark cabinetry, stone accents on the corners, and a light-colored countertop with integrated blue lighting. A grill is visible on the right side of the structure, while various dishes and glasses are placed on the bar. The flooring consists of patterned paving stones. The scene is softly illuminated by the kitchen's lighting and distant background lights, creating a warm and inviting ambiance.

shabby-chic-style_909.jpg.title: Bright Farmhouse Kitchen with Brick Floors
shabby-chic-style_909.jpg.description: This bright kitchen blends rustic and farmhouse elements with a touch of modern design. The kitchen features a large wooden island with seating, white cabinets, and brick flooring. Sunlight streams in through the window, highlighting the white walls and creating a warm, inviting atmosphere. Decorative shelves showcase vintage jars and pottery, while a bouquet of flowers adds a touch of natural elegance.

transitional_502.jpg.title: Elegant White Kitchen with Marble Backsplash
transitional_502.jpg.description: This is a bright, well-lit kitchen featuring white cabinetry, marble countertops and backsplash, and dark hardwood floors. The scene includes a stainless steel range and oven, a sink with a modern faucet, and various kitchen accessories. A vase of white hydrangeas adds a touch of elegance. The cabinets feature recessed panel doors and chrome hardware.

rustic_126.jpg.title: Elegant Modern Kitchen with Island Seating
rustic_126.jpg.description: This image showcases a sophisticated modern kitchen with high ceilings, large windows, and a spacious island featuring seating. The color palette is predominantly neutral, with shades of gray, beige, and brown. The kitchen is well-lit, thanks to both natural light and strategically placed pendant lights. Stainless steel appliances add a touch of modernity. The open design and natural elements like the orchid create a welcoming atmosphere.

scandinavian_623.jpg.title: Chic Home Office with London Accents
scandinavian_623.jpg.description: This home office features a stylish and inviting atmosphere with a touch of London charm. The room boasts light gray wood-look flooring, a clean white desk, and a striking gallery wall of black and white cityscapes. Two woven accent chairs with dalmatian-print cushions create a cozy seating area around a small white side table adorned with a succulent and a decorative book. A faux fiddle-leaf fig tree adds a touch of greenery, while a framed print of London's iconic red telephone booth injects a pop of color against a dark wall. The overall aesthetic is modern, sophisticated, and comfortable.

french-country_143.jpg.title: Cozy Living Room with Brick Fireplace
french-country_143.jpg.description: This image showcases a cozy and inviting living room with a prominent brick fireplace as its focal point. The fireplace, constructed from multi-toned bricks, features a textured design above the firebox and is flanked by brass sconces. A clear glass vase filled with large pink hydrangeas sits atop a stack of coffee table books on a distressed white metal coffee table. Clear glass candle holders with white taper candles add to the warm ambiance. A portion of a brown upholstered armchair with a white cushion is visible on the left, while a glimpse into an adjacent room reveals a white sofa and a glimpse of the outdoors through a window. The overall style is eclectic and comfortable, with a touch of rustic charm.

tropical_701.jpg.title: Outdoor Fire Pit Scene
tropical_701.jpg.description: This image shows a well-designed outdoor space featuring a fire pit area near a pool. The fire pit is circular and constructed with stone, with a metal fire pit in the center. Lounge chairs are arranged in front of the fire pit, providing seating. The area is surrounded by various plants and palm trees, adding a tropical feel. A body of water is visible in the background. The scene is set during sunset, casting warm colors across the sky and landscape.

contemporary_406.jpg.title: Modern Black and White Bathroom with Freestanding Tub
contemporary_406.jpg.description: A contemporary bathroom features a black freestanding tub positioned beneath a window, accented by a light wooden bath caddy. The walls are divided between glossy black and white vertical tiles, with integrated niches for storage. Matte black fixtures add a sleek contrast. A striped towel hangs from the tub.

contemporary_360.jpg.title: Modern Kitchen with Black Marble Backsplash
contemporary_360.jpg.description: A contemporary kitchen featuring a black marble backsplash, modern pendant lighting, and sleek wooden bar stools. The kitchen island is clad in a light wood finish, contrasting with the dark countertops and backsplash. A variety of plants and citrus fruits add a touch of nature and vibrancy to the scene.

southwestern_498.jpg.title: Eclectic Stairway with Tile Risers
southwestern_498.jpg.description: An inviting entryway and stairway showcases a blend of textures and styles. The staircase features dark wood treads accented with decorative tile risers in a patterned design, complemented by a wrought iron railing with intricate spindle detailing. A small, dark wood side table holds a gold-toned lamp, casting a warm glow on the scene. Next to the table, a comfortable, light leather chaise lounge offers a place to relax. Artwork adorns the walls, including a framed print of a cow above the chaise, and a gallery of black and white portraits on the adjacent wall. The flooring is dark wood, covered partially by a patterned rug in rich reds and blues. The walls are painted in a warm, off-white tone, adding to the cozy ambiance of the space. A simple light switch and a partially visible arched doorway complete the scene.

industrial_724.jpg.title: Modern Shipping Container Home Interior
industrial_724.jpg.description: A modern interior shot of a shipping container home featuring a staircase, hallway, and sliding glass doors. The staircase, constructed from metal, ascends from the lower level. The walls of the hallway are constructed from the corrugated metal sides of the container. A wooden ceiling with recessed lighting adds warmth to the space. Sliding glass doors line one side of the hallway, offering views of the outdoors. The flooring appears to be concrete or polished concrete. The design aesthetic blends industrial elements with modern touches.

french-country_625.jpg.title: Elegant Stone and Brick Home Exterior
french-country_625.jpg.description: A well-manicured lawn and trees surround a large, luxurious home with a combination of stone and painted brick facade. The house features multiple gables, a prominent chimney, and a covered porch leading to the front entrance. A curved driveway adds to the stately approach.

victorian_901.jpg.title: Eclectic Living Room with Pink Sofa
victorian_901.jpg.description: This image showcases an eclectic living room featuring a striking black bookshelf, a pink tufted sofa, and a color-blocked wall. The lower part of the wall is painted in a deep blue/black, contrasting with the white upper part and ceiling. The bookshelf is filled with decorative items such as swan figurines, books, and a Frida Kahlo portrait. A white fireplace is visible to the left, and a warm-toned wooden floor adds to the room's cozy feel.

traditional_781.jpg.title: Sunroom with French Doors and Garden View
traditional_781.jpg.description: This is a sunroom with a garden view featuring two plush armchairs with decorative pillows, a unique coffee table, and a sofa, creating a cozy and inviting space. French doors open to an outdoor area, allowing natural light to flood the room, highlighting the slate flooring and a chandelier overhead.

coastal_788.jpg.title: Nautical Bedroom with Ship Art
coastal_788.jpg.description: A bright and airy bedroom features a nautical theme with a large framed painting of a ship above the bed. The bed is adorned with navy blue and white striped bedding, along with accent pillows in complementary colors. The room is illuminated by two table lamps on matching nightstands, and natural light streams through the windows.

transitional_264.jpg.title: Spacious Kitchen Design
transitional_264.jpg.description: A well-lit and spacious kitchen features dark wood flooring, white cabinets, a large island with a light countertop, and stainless steel appliances. The room is open with a doorway leading to another area. A pantry with glass doors is visible in the background.

traditional_959.jpg.title: Elegant Dining Room with Floral Accents
traditional_959.jpg.description: This image showcases a beautifully designed dining room with a mix of traditional and contemporary elements. The focal point is a long, wooden dining table surrounded by upholstered chairs with nailhead trim, set upon a vibrant, patterned rug. Two unique chandeliers provide warm lighting, enhancing the room's inviting atmosphere. Large windows allow natural light to flood the space, highlighting the floral arrangement on the table and artwork visible in the adjacent room.

coastal_950.jpg.title: Elegant Bathroom Vanity with Double Mirrors
coastal_950.jpg.description: A stylish bathroom featuring a wooden vanity with reeded cabinet doors and gold knobs, topped with a light-colored countertop. Two rectangular mirrors with gold frames hang above the vanity, flanked by sconces with gold fixtures and globe lights. A plant in a woven pot adds a touch of greenery to the center of the vanity. The walls are covered in white vertical panels. A striped towel is draped over one of the cabinet doors. The floor is tiled in a light pattern, and a white rug is placed in front of the vanity.  Candles are visible on the countertop.

rustic_898.jpg.title: Rustic Bathroom with Wood Vanity and Industrial Lighting
rustic_898.jpg.description: This image showcases a rustic bathroom featuring a wooden vanity with a dark countertop, an industrial-style mirror, and complementary fixtures. The bathroom includes a wooden vanity with two cabinet doors, a black sink, and a matte black faucet. Above the vanity, a rectangular mirror is mounted with dark metal hardware, flanked by industrial-style wall sconces with orange accents. A green and white checkered hand towel hangs on a twig-shaped towel hook. A small potted plant adds a touch of greenery. The walls are painted in a light neutral tone, and the floor appears to have patterned tiles. In the background, a freestanding bathtub with a black faucet is visible, and a wooden door with dark hardware stands to the side.

victorian_732.jpg.title: Charming Green Victorian House
victorian_732.jpg.description: A quaint Victorian-style house with a green exterior, white trim, and a welcoming porch. The house features a dark red front door and matching window frames. A concrete path leads to the porch steps, surrounded by a green lawn. The architecture includes detailed ornamentation typical of Victorian design.

rustic_873.jpg.title: Rustic Bathroom with Double Vanity
rustic_873.jpg.description: A warm and inviting rustic bathroom featuring a double vanity made from raw-edged wood, topped with two stone vessel sinks and vintage-style lamps. The backsplash is a mosaic of natural stones, adding texture and visual interest. The mirrors above the sinks are framed with similarly rustic wood, complementing the overall design. A shelf beneath the vanity showcases decorative items, enhancing the cabin-like atmosphere. The walls are clad in wood paneling, contributing to the cozy and natural aesthetic of the space.

eclectic_124.jpg.title: Luxurious Bathroom with Moss Wall
eclectic_124.jpg.description: This image showcases a luxurious bathroom featuring a stunning moss wall as its focal point. A freestanding silver bathtub sits beneath the moss wall, complemented by gold-colored fixtures. The floor is tiled in a herringbone pattern, adding a touch of sophistication. The overall ambiance is clean and modern, with a touch of natural element.

victorian_87.jpg.title: Elegant House with Brick Path
victorian_87.jpg.description: Exterior shot of a house with a brick path leading to the front door. The house features a turret-style design, white pillars supporting a curved porch roof, and well-manicured landscaping. The path is lined with small, round bushes. The house is a two-story structure with light gray shingle siding and white-framed windows.

coastal_763.jpg.title: Elegant Bathroom Interior
coastal_763.jpg.description: A bright and elegant bathroom featuring a white vanity with granite countertops, dual mirrors with sconces, and a built-in makeup area with a padded stool. The walls are painted a soft gray, complementing the marble flooring and tub surround. A decorative mirror and fluffy towels add a touch of luxury.

industrial_917.jpg.title: Modern Kitchen Design
industrial_917.jpg.description: This image shows a modern kitchen design with a sleek and minimalist aesthetic. The kitchen features a large island with a dark countertop and wooden paneling, complemented by white chairs with wooden legs. The upper cabinets are made of wood, contrasting with the dark backsplash and white lower cabinets. The lighting includes a unique honeycomb-shaped pendant light and track lighting. The exposed concrete ceiling adds an industrial touch to the space. A portion of a gray sofa with a yellow patterned pillow is visible in the foreground, suggesting a living area adjacent to the kitchen.

modern_687.jpg.title: Modern Black and White Kitchen with Dining Area
modern_687.jpg.description: This image showcases a contemporary kitchen and dining area with a sleek black and white color scheme. The kitchen features black cabinetry with modern, minimalist hardware, a stainless steel range hood, and light-colored countertops. The dining area includes a black table with a vase of flowers and seating with both white and metal chairs. The floors are tiled in a neutral gray, and the walls are white, creating a bright and airy atmosphere. Natural light floods the space through skylights, enhancing the modern aesthetic.

french-country_816.jpg.title: Elegant Light Blue Kitchen
french-country_816.jpg.description: A cozy kitchen featuring light blue cabinetry, a white farmhouse sink, and a vintage-style range cooker. An island with dark wood finish and gold hardware stands out against the light color palette. The space is decorated with floral arrangements and patterned tiles, creating a warm and inviting atmosphere.

southwestern_315.jpg.title: Elegant Tile Shower with Bench
southwestern_315.jpg.description: A beautifully designed bathroom featuring a shower with a bench and two windows. The shower is tiled with square travertine-like tiles in varying shades of beige and brown. The bench is also tiled and fits snugly in the corner of the shower. Two small, open shelves are built into the wall. The shower features bronze-colored fixtures, including two shower heads and a handle. The windows provide natural light and privacy with frosted glass. The floor of the shower is tiled with smaller square tiles in a similar color palette.

farmhouse_787.jpg.title: Sleek Bathroom Design
farmhouse_787.jpg.description: A modern bathroom features a floating vanity with a light wood finish, a white countertop, and a rectangular sink. A black faucet and a tall, oval mirror with a black frame are mounted above the vanity. The shower area, enclosed by glass panels, has a double shower system with black fixtures, illuminated by a horizontal LED strip. Gray tiles cover the walls and floor, creating a minimalist and contemporary aesthetic.

scandinavian_810.jpg.title: Serene Bathroom with Wooden Accents
scandinavian_810.jpg.description: This image showcases a modern bathroom design with a focus on natural textures and a minimalist aesthetic. The central element is a freestanding oval bathtub, accented by a light wooden tub tray holding a bar of soap. The backdrop features horizontal wooden paneling, which adds warmth and character to the space. A large window provides natural light and a view of greenery outside. The floor is covered in a pebble mosaic, creating an organic and visually interesting surface. To the right, a tall white vase holding decorative branches adds a touch of elegance and complements the overall color scheme.

asian_897.jpg.title: Cozy Interior with Rustic Elements
asian_897.jpg.description: A cozy interior space featuring exposed brick walls in warm brown tones. A wooden daybed with patterned cushions is positioned beneath a window with white-painted wooden slats. A dark wooden chair stands near a doorway, which leads into a room with a patterned rug and wooden furniture. The floor is tiled in a yellow tone with decorative floral motifs. Dark wooden beams are visible on the ceiling, adding to the rustic charm of the space.

tropical_932.jpg.title: Bright Bedroom with Bohemian Accents
tropical_932.jpg.description: This image showcases a bright and inviting bedroom with a mix of bohemian and tropical design elements. The focal point is a large bed with a carved wooden headboard, crisp white linens, and an assortment of decorative pillows in neutral tones and textured patterns. Two decorative pendant lanterns hang on either side of the bed, adding a warm ambient glow. A woven storage bench sits at the foot of the bed, providing both functionality and visual interest. The room is grounded by a colorful, patterned rug. A sliding glass door leads to a lush outdoor area, bringing natural light and greenery into the space. The walls are painted in a clean white, which contributes to the room's airy feel. A ceiling fan and an air conditioning unit suggest practicality in a warm climate.

eclectic_656.jpg.title: Cozy Alcove Desk Setup
eclectic_656.jpg.description: A cozy, rustic-themed workspace nestled in an alcove. The desk is dark, possibly stone or a dark stained wood, with black metal legs. Above the desk, wooden shelving lines the alcove. On the shelves, decorative items include snowshoes, plants, framed artwork, binoculars, books, and purple glass jars. A vintage-style globe sits on the right side of the desk. A wooden chair with a simple, modern design is positioned in front of the desk. Warm recessed lighting illuminates the shelves and desk area. A leather armchair is partially visible in the foreground, adding to the cozy atmosphere.

southwestern_301.jpg.title: Grand Entrance with Stone Pillars
southwestern_301.jpg.description: This image showcases a grand entryway featuring substantial stone pillars flanking a large, multi-paneled wooden door. The door's design incorporates a transom window with a peaked top, complementing the vaulted ceiling lined with exposed wooden beams. Symmetrical lantern-style wall sconces illuminate the entrance, while a glimpse of outdoor greenery and a cactus sculpture add a touch of nature to the setting. The flooring is a smooth, neutral material that extends into the entrance, providing a welcoming transition.

scandinavian_804.jpg.title: Green bathroom with modern fixtures
scandinavian_804.jpg.description: A cozy and modern bathroom featuring a vibrant green color scheme. The lower half of the wall is tiled with glossy, dark green rectangular tiles, while the upper half is painted in a lighter, complementary shade of green. A rectangular mirror with a black frame hangs above a wall-mounted, minimalist sink with exposed plumbing. Two sconce lights with white shades flank the mirror. A wooden vanity provides storage space, topped with a white countertop decorated with small potted plants and picture frames. The toilet is a standard white model, and the floor is covered with a patterned tile in shades of white and green. A towel hangs on a hook near the sink. The overall style is contemporary with a touch of nature.

farmhouse_793.jpg.title: Rustic Kitchen with Red Runner Rug
farmhouse_793.jpg.description: This image shows a well-lit, rustic kitchen with a balanced mix of modern and traditional elements. A long, narrow red runner rug with a detailed pattern draws the eye down the center of the room, contrasting with the light wood flooring. On the left, a large island features a farmhouse sink, light countertops, and dark blue-grey cabinetry. The window above the sink provides a view of a snowy landscape. The right side of the kitchen includes a professional-grade stove with a stainless steel hood, flanked by a mix of wooden and grey cabinetry. The overall design is clean, functional, and visually appealing.

industrial_903.jpg.title: Open-Plan Living Space with Kitchen and Lounge
industrial_903.jpg.description: This image showcases a modern open-plan living space, seamlessly blending a kitchen and lounge area. The kitchen island, featuring a light wood countertop and black metal legs, serves as a focal point. A pendant light hangs above, illuminating the workspace where vegetables are being prepared on a wooden cutting board. The floors are polished concrete, leading to a lounge area with a TV and shelving unit. A small indoor garden with a tree adds a touch of nature. The color palette is neutral with pops of color from decorative items.

modern_693.jpg.title: Modern Kitchen with Island Seating
modern_693.jpg.description: This is a well-lit modern kitchen featuring a large island with seating for four. The island has a unique gray stone countertop with a waterfall edge. Matching bar stools are placed in front of the island.  The kitchen also features dark wood cabinetry, stainless steel appliances, including a refrigerator and built-in ovens, and open shelving. A large window provides a view of the outdoors. Three pendant lights hang above the island, and the flooring appears to be light-colored concrete. The backsplash is a stacked stone.

french-country_802.jpg.title: Cozy Kitchen Interior
french-country_802.jpg.description: This image showcases a cozy, traditionally styled kitchen. The room features light wood cabinetry, a white microwave, and a white stove. A small kitchen island with dark countertops is in the foreground, providing seating for three on dark wooden bar stools. The floor is covered in light beige tiles, and the walls are painted in a muted green. Recessed lighting illuminates the space, creating a warm and inviting atmosphere. To the right, a stainless steel refrigerator is visible, and an opening leads to another room, suggesting an open floor plan.

southwestern_467.jpg.title: Contemporary Shower Interior
southwestern_467.jpg.description: A modern shower interior features large, horizontal light-brown tiles, accented by a decorative mosaic border. The shower includes a built-in niche for storage, a fixed showerhead, and a handheld shower unit. Glass doors enclose the shower space, allowing natural light from a small window above the showerhead to illuminate the area. The design is clean and functional, emphasizing a minimalist aesthetic.

coastal_777.jpg.title: Elegant Bathroom Vanity
coastal_777.jpg.description: Close-up shot of a luxurious bathroom vanity featuring light wood cabinetry, a marble countertop, and modern chrome hardware. The floor is tiled in a geometric pattern of light and dark stone. The faucets are sleek and contemporary, and a stack of white towels adds a touch of spa-like elegance.

victorian_93.jpg.title: Charming Cottage Exterior
victorian_93.jpg.description: The image captures the exterior of a charming cottage nestled amidst lush greenery. The house features a distinctive design with weathered shingle siding, steep gables, and decorative trim. A covered porch provides an inviting entryway, framed by curved arches and sturdy columns. Windows with dark frames contrast beautifully against the light-colored siding. The surrounding landscape is meticulously maintained with manicured shrubs and trees, adding to the home's picturesque appeal. The overall aesthetic exudes a sense of warmth and timeless elegance.

eclectic_130.jpg.title: Eclectic Laundry Room with Colorful Accents
eclectic_130.jpg.description: This image shows a vibrant laundry area with a unique blend of patterns and colors. A stacked washer and dryer unit stands to the left, partially hidden by a louvered door. Behind the door, a colorful wallpaper with a pattern of trees and animals serves as a backdrop to a small sink with a red basin. A woven basket sits below the sink. To the right, there's a built-in white shelving unit with decorative items and a vase of wildflowers on top of a counter. A blue hexagonal tile wall with decorative patterns surrounds a window.

modern_863.jpg.title: Elegant House Entrance
modern_863.jpg.description: An inviting view of an elegant house entrance at dusk, featuring a grand arched doorway framed by stone pillars and a dark-trimmed overhang. The entrance is accentuated by warm sconce lighting and flanked by large windows providing a glimpse into the interior. Modern landscaping with potted plants and pathway lighting completes the sophisticated curb appeal.

asian_115.jpg.title: Eclectic Bedroom with Red Accents
asian_115.jpg.description: A stylish bedroom featuring a large painting with a red background and a portrait, a bed with white linens and a red patterned throw, and a swing seat by the window. The room is decorated in an eclectic style with a mix of textures and colors.

scandinavian_192.jpg.title: Modern Coffee Bar Nook
scandinavian_192.jpg.description: A modern coffee bar nook featuring white cabinetry, oak accents, and a marble backsplash. The setup includes a built-in beverage cooler, an espresso machine, and open shelving.

coastal_987.jpg.title: Elegant Dining Room with Blue Accents
coastal_987.jpg.description: This image showcases an elegant dining room with a cohesive design scheme. The focal point is a large, wooden dining table with a reflective surface, surrounded by upholstered dining chairs in various shades of blue. A standout chair with a patterned fabric in white and blue sits at the head of the table. Above the table, a stunning cluster of glass pendant lights in varying shades of blue and clear creates a visually appealing fixture. A wine cellar with glass doors is built into the wall, adding functionality and luxury. The room also features white built-in shelving and cabinets, further enhancing the space. The color palette of blues and whites creates a calming and sophisticated atmosphere.

mid-century-modern_716.jpg.title: Modern Home Exterior with Wood Accents
mid-century-modern_716.jpg.description: This image captures the exterior of a modern home nestled within a wooded area. The house features a striking combination of materials, including dark gray siding, natural wood paneling on the left side, and a matching wooden garage door on the right. A red front door provides a vibrant contrast. The design incorporates a large triangular window above the entrance. The landscaping includes a concrete planter with low greenery, mulch, and small rock areas, enhancing the house's curb appeal. The driveway is paved with asphalt, leading to the garage.

mediterranean_412.jpg.title: Elegant Kitchen with Island Seating
mediterranean_412.jpg.description: A well-lit, elegant kitchen features dark hardwood floors and contrasting light cabinetry. The focal point is a large kitchen island with a marble countertop and three dark wooden bar stools. Overhead, wooden beams span the ceiling, complemented by three pendant lights. A custom range hood is centered above the cooktop. The kitchen includes recessed lighting and built-in appliances, showcasing a blend of rustic and contemporary design elements.

eclectic_118.jpg.title: Red Bedroom with Bay Window
eclectic_118.jpg.description: A bedroom featuring a bold red wallpaper with a repeating motif, complemented by a large bed dressed in neutral tones. Sunlight streams through a bay window, illuminating the hardwood floor and a detailed area rug. A dark wood dresser stands to the side.

shabby-chic-style_706.jpg.title: Charming Bathroom Interior
shabby-chic-style_706.jpg.description: A view of a stylish bathroom featuring a blend of classic and modern elements. The focal point includes a vanity with a glossy blue countertop and a vintage-inspired sink and faucet set. Above the sink, there's a pair of sconce lights flanking an oval mirror. A vase with purple flowers adds a touch of color, while designer toiletries are neatly arranged. The wall is adorned with patterned wallpaper in shades of blue and white, contrasting with the plain white door. A glass-enclosed shower is visible to the right, and the floor is covered in beige and brown square tiles. Natural light filters through the slatted window blinds on the left.

eclectic_4.jpg.title: Kitchen Coffee Station with Built-In Cabinet
eclectic_4.jpg.description: The image showcases a well-organized coffee station integrated into a kitchen cabinet. The cabinet features shelves holding various mugs, travel tumblers, and a coffee maker with a grinder. A small metal arm with hooks is mounted on the side, possibly for hanging utensils or accessories. The exterior of the cabinet is painted a neutral gray, complementing the kitchen's brick wall visible near a window. A bowl of citrus fruit sits on a round table near the cabinet, adding a pop of color to the scene.

farmhouse_963.jpg.title: Elegant Kitchen with Large Island
farmhouse_963.jpg.description: A bright and airy kitchen featuring a large marble-topped island with seating. The kitchen boasts white cabinetry, a herringbone tile backsplash, and stainless steel appliances. Pendant lights hang above the island, adding a modern touch. A breakfast nook with a dining table and chairs is visible in the background, leading to a green painted wall.

asian_673.jpg.title: Japanese Garden with Stone Lantern
asian_673.jpg.description: A serene Japanese garden featuring a stone lantern as a focal point, surrounded by a variety of plants, rocks, and a small stream with clear water. The garden is lush and vibrant, with a mix of green foliage, colorful flowers, and textured stones, all contributing to a peaceful and aesthetically pleasing environment.

scandinavian_838.jpg.title: Cozy Apartment Interior
scandinavian_838.jpg.description: Interior view of a small, well-lit apartment featuring a dining area with a white round table and a white woven chair, complemented by a picture frame and a wicker pendant lamp. The adjacent hallway leads to a white door and includes a full-length mirror. A compact kitchen area is visible with blue lower cabinets, wooden countertops, a microwave, and white upper cabinets, adding a touch of color to the neutral palette.

french-country_180.jpg.title: Elegant Bathroom Interior
french-country_180.jpg.description: A spacious and luxurious bathroom features a freestanding white bathtub positioned beneath a large window that offers a view of a wooded area. Next to the tub is a glass-enclosed shower with a chrome handle. The floor and walls are clad in light marble, creating a bright and clean aesthetic. Above the tub hangs a modern geometric chandelier. To the right, a long vanity with multiple sinks and drawers is topped with a large mirror adorned with sconces. The overall design is elegant and well-lit.

mediterranean_360.jpg.title: Landscaped Pathway
mediterranean_360.jpg.description: A winding pathway constructed of stone pavers leads through a lush garden. The path is flanked by vibrant red and white flowers, neatly trimmed grass, and mulched areas. Low-profile landscape lights illuminate the path. A stone bench and a large boulder add natural elements to the garden design.

farmhouse_16.jpg.title: Serene Bathroom Design
farmhouse_16.jpg.description: A bright and airy bathroom features a freestanding bathtub with silver-toned fixtures, a wooden bath tray holding candles and flowers, and a small wooden stool with a brush and bottles. The shower has a glass enclosure and white subway tiles with marble herringbone accents. A window with a striped shade offers a view of the landscape.

mid-century-modern_702.jpg.title: Stylish Modern Kitchen with Breakfast Nook
mid-century-modern_702.jpg.description: An interior shot reveals a modern kitchen and breakfast nook. The kitchen features wooden cabinets and a long white countertop island with black sink fixtures. Two bright yellow bar stools sit in front of the island. The backsplash is a black and white patterned tile. Overhead are pendant lights in varying designs. To the left is a breakfast nook with a round white table, tulip chairs, and a built-in wooden bench against a slatted wooden wall. The floor is hardwood throughout.

mediterranean_406.jpg.title: Elegant Kitchen with Dark Blue Cabinets
mediterranean_406.jpg.description: A well-lit kitchen features a mix of light and dark cabinetry. Dark blue base cabinets are paired with white upper cabinets, some of which have glass fronts. The backsplash is a white subway tile with a slightly iridescent finish. A large farmhouse sink sits beneath a window, and a black range hood with gold trim hovers over a professional-style range. Decorative floral patterned tiles cover the floor, and the ceiling has exposed wooden beams.

traditional_742.jpg.title: Organized Handbag Storage
traditional_742.jpg.description: This image features an organized handbag storage solution. A white shelving unit is utilized to neatly arrange a collection of purses and clutches. The left side of the unit features shelves where handbags are stacked vertically, showcasing a variety of colors and textures, including yellow, teal, orange, and leopard print. The right side of the unit has a rod with hooks, from which tote bags and larger handbags are hung, including designs with black and white patterns and orange and white stripes. Decorative items such as flowers in a blue vase, a small gold box, and a gold-framed mirror adorn the top of the shelving unit, adding a touch of elegance to the organized space. The arrangement appears to be part of a closet or dressing area.

rustic_683.jpg.title: Stylish Laundry Room with Gray Cabinetry
rustic_683.jpg.description: A well-organized and stylish laundry room featuring gray cabinetry with sleek gold hardware. The room includes a dark countertop, floating wooden shelves, a stacked washer and dryer unit, and a woven laundry basket beneath the counter. The backsplash is white tile, and plants and artwork add a touch of warmth to the space. A partially visible wooden door is on the right.

asian_101.jpg.title: Luxurious Bedroom Retreat
asian_101.jpg.description: This image showcases a bedroom designed as a tranquil retreat, blending indoor comfort with outdoor serenity. The room features a high, vaulted ceiling with exposed wooden beams, adding a rustic yet sophisticated touch. Large windows offer expansive views of lush greenery, creating a sense of connection with nature. The neutral color palette, with shades of beige, cream, and soft browns, contributes to a calming atmosphere. A plush bed adorned with textured throws and pillows serves as the focal point, while a small seating area with a sofa and coffee table provides a space for relaxation. The room is decorated with subtle artwork and unique lighting fixtures, enhancing its overall aesthetic appeal.

scandinavian_186.jpg.title: Modern Kitchen with Light Wood Accents
scandinavian_186.jpg.description: A bright and modern kitchen features light-colored cabinetry accented with light wood shelves and a matching island. The sleek design includes built-in appliances and minimalist hardware, creating a clean and functional space. The color palette is subdued, with neutral tones that enhance the natural light.

asian_671.jpg.title: Luxurious Dining Room with Rich Textures and Colors
asian_671.jpg.description: A vibrant dining room featuring a dark wood oval table set for a meal, surrounded by upholstered chairs with detailed backs. A colorful rug with floral patterns lies beneath the table, complementing the patterned wallpaper and gold-toned ceiling. The room is illuminated by a rectangular chandelier, and a buffet with decorative art pieces adds to the opulent atmosphere.

french-country_196.jpg.title: Elegant Dining Room with Patterned Curtains
french-country_196.jpg.description: This image showcases an elegantly designed dining room featuring a dark wood dining table set for a meal, adorned with yellow bowls and plates on gray placemats. A wooden planter filled with greenery serves as a centerpiece. Above the table, a decorative metal chandelier hangs, adding a touch of sophistication. The backdrop consists of arched French doors covered with patterned blue and white curtains, which provide natural light and visual interest. Two framed pictures hang on the wall, contributing to the room's overall aesthetic.

eclectic_6.jpg.title: Bohemian Bedroom with Hanging Chair
eclectic_6.jpg.description: A cozy and stylish bedroom features a rattan hanging chair with a patterned pillow and white cushion, illuminated by soft fairy lights. The walls are adorned with hanging planters showcasing succulents and trailing plants. A vanity area with a white furry chair sits adjacent, completing the bohemian aesthetic. The bed, partially visible in the foreground, is draped with a textured blanket in muted tones.

shabby-chic-style_704.jpg.title: Charming Garden Shed Interior
shabby-chic-style_704.jpg.description: A quaint garden shed is pictured with its purple door swung open, revealing a cozy interior setting. The shed's exterior is constructed from weathered wood planks of varying widths, giving it a rustic and charming appearance. Above the wooden walls, a translucent roof lets in plenty of natural light. The interior features a small dining table draped with a white tablecloth, set for a meal with a bouquet of white flowers as a centerpiece. Shelves on the back wall display various decorative items and plants. Outside the shed, potted plants are arranged on tiered stands and in a wooden cart, adding to the garden atmosphere. A light blue chair sits to the right of the doorway. The ground is a simple concrete slab. The overall scene is one of peaceful, rustic comfort.

mediterranean_410.jpg.title: Bright and Airy Modern Bathroom
mediterranean_410.jpg.description: A modern bathroom featuring a freestanding tub under a window, a glass-enclosed shower, a vessel sink on a wood vanity, and decorative floor tiles. The bathroom is bright with natural light from a skylight and the window.

traditional_754.jpg.title: Modern Bathroom Shower
traditional_754.jpg.description: A modern bathroom shower features a glass door and enclosure. The walls are tiled with a marble-like pattern, and there is a built-in bench seat inside the shower. A small window above the shower area provides natural light. The shower is equipped with multiple shower heads and faucets. The floor is covered in small, rounded tiles. A toilet is visible outside of the shower.

coastal_985.jpg.title: Outdoor Kitchen with Stone Accents
coastal_985.jpg.description: This image showcases an outdoor kitchen setup with a built-in grill, a sink, and stainless steel storage components. The kitchen area is constructed with textured stone blocks, adding a rustic touch to the space. The flooring is made of irregularly shaped stone pavers, creating an interesting pattern. In the background, there are raised planters with greenery, contributing to the overall outdoor ambiance.

mid-century-modern_714.jpg.title: Modern Living Room with Green Sofas
mid-century-modern_714.jpg.description: A modern living room featuring two green sofas, a yellow coffee table, and large windows. The room has a light wood floor and a brick accent wall. The design is clean and contemporary, with a mix of textures and colors creating a welcoming atmosphere.

french-country_828.jpg.title: Elegant Bathroom with Freestanding Tub
french-country_828.jpg.description: A well-lit bathroom featuring a freestanding white bathtub as a focal point. The room is painted in a light neutral tone, complemented by light beige tiles. Natural light streams in through a window above the tub, and the space includes frosted glass doors, a wooden cabinet, and a glass-enclosed shower area.

scandinavian_190.jpg.title: Chic and Rustic Bar Nook
scandinavian_190.jpg.description: This image showcases a beautifully designed bar nook in a rustic yet chic setting. Sunlight streams in through a window, illuminating a marble countertop where a variety of cocktail glasses and bottles are arranged. A framed piece of art hangs on the wall, adding a touch of elegance. The wooden beams and accents complement the natural light, creating a warm and inviting space.

modern_861.jpg.title: Modern Backyard with Sliding Glass Doors
modern_861.jpg.description: This image showcases a modern backyard with a well-manicured lawn and a patio area. Large sliding glass doors seamlessly connect the indoor and outdoor spaces, offering a clear view of the interior. Inside, there is a glimpse of a modern kitchen and office space. The outdoor area features a built-in grill, a seating area with comfortable furniture, and clean lines in the architectural design. The lighting suggests it's either dusk or dawn, creating a serene ambiance.

southwestern_459.jpg.title: Sleek Modern Kitchen with Open Layout
southwestern_459.jpg.description: A modern kitchen with a focus on natural materials and an open layout. Wood cabinetry is paired with concrete walls and countertops. The kitchen features a large island with a farmhouse sink and a view of the outdoors through large windows. The dining area is visible in the background with a wooden table and abstract art on the wall.

scandinavian_184.jpg.title: Modern Open Concept Living Space
scandinavian_184.jpg.description: A bright and spacious open concept living space features a modern design with rustic accents. The room includes a kitchen with a large island, stainless steel appliances, and bar stools. A living area is centered around a brick fireplace with a mounted television. The space is unified by dark wood flooring and exposed wooden beams on the vaulted ceiling. Pendant lights and other fixtures add to the contemporary feel.

modern_875.jpg.title: Modern Kitchen Design
modern_875.jpg.description: This image showcases a modern kitchen design with a focus on clean lines and a minimalist aesthetic. The kitchen features a large island with a dark countertop and light wood cabinetry. The flooring is a colorful terrazzo style, adding a playful element to the otherwise sleek design. The cabinets are white with simple hardware. A stainless steel range hood stands out against the gray tiled backsplash, while the rest of the kitchen is bathed in natural light from a nearby window. The overall atmosphere is one of understated elegance and functionality.

asian_103.jpg.title: Cozy Kitchen with Warm Tones
asian_103.jpg.description: This is an image of a cozy and inviting kitchen. The walls are painted in a warm shade of red, and the cabinets are made of a rich, natural wood. A tiled backsplash adds texture and visual interest to the space. The island is topped with a dark wood countertop and features two bar stools. A modern pendant light hangs above the island, providing ample illumination. The kitchen also includes a stainless steel range hood and other appliances.

rustic_681.jpg.title: Modern Rustic Kitchen
rustic_681.jpg.description: A well-lit modern kitchen features a central island with seating, stone countertops, wooden cabinetry, and overhead beams. Two pendant lights hang over the island. Large windows offer a view of the landscape.

mediterranean_404.jpg.title: Outdoor Living Area with Fireplace and Pizza Oven
mediterranean_404.jpg.description: An inviting outdoor living space featuring a large, white stucco fireplace with a rustic wooden mantel. A metal fire screen covers the firebox. To the right is a matching pizza oven and outdoor kitchen area with a grill and food preparation space. Comfortable wicker sofas with plush cushions surround a weathered wooden coffee table topped with snacks and wine. The area is surrounded by lush greenery and trees, creating a private and relaxing atmosphere.

traditional_740.jpg.title: Teal Bedroom with Coffered Ceiling
traditional_740.jpg.description: This bedroom features teal walls, a dark wood floor, and a white coffered ceiling. The bed has a gray skirt and a patterned duvet cover with a matching bench at the foot. A silver-framed oval mirror hangs above the bed on the left, and two black and white floral prints adorn the right wall. A doorway leads to another room with a glimpse of white furniture.

mid-century-modern_700.jpg.title: Modern Kitchen with Stainless Steel Appliances
mid-century-modern_700.jpg.description: This is a well-lit modern kitchen with light wood floors and cabinets. A stainless steel range with a stainless steel range hood stands against a white tile backsplash with decorative mosaic accents. A long countertop spans across a window, providing space for a small seating area with two bar stools. The kitchen also features a built-in wine fridge and a dark-colored door leading to another room. The overall ambiance is bright and inviting.

rustic_859.jpg.title: Rustic Log Cabin Bathroom Interior
rustic_859.jpg.description: A rustic log cabin bathroom showcases a blend of natural elements and classic fixtures. A glass-enclosed shower with a curved archway features stone and tile accents.
